row.name: Beneath The Cherry Blossom Tree
row.detailed_description: Dive into what lies below in “Beneath the Cherry Blossom Tree” an immersive visual novel where every choice carves a path through a tapestry of mystery, romance, and intrigue. Unravel a story that intertwines destiny, personality, and local folklore About This Game: * In “Beneath the Cherry Blossom Tree,” you assume the role of a high school student, in a vibrant and dynamic school. Beneath its playful facade lies a web of secrets waiting to be uncovered. Navigate through a narrative where your decisions not only shape the story but also define who you become. Key Features: * Branching Narratives: Your choices matter, leading to multiple endings and unforeseen consequences. Every decision opens new paths while closing others. * Rich Storytelling: Delve into a deeply engaging plot set against the backdrop of a mysteriously captivating town, full of characters with hidden agendas and stories. * Mysteries: Unravel complex mysteries that challenge your wit and reward your persistence, each unlocking new mysteries and lore. * Atmospheric World: Explore environments, from the haunting woods to the vibrant school halls, all brought to life with unique art and a captivating soundtrack. * Dynamic Relationships: Build or burn bridges with the school’s students. Your interactions with them can provide crucial clues or lead you astray. * Hidden Secrets: Discover collectibles and secrets hidden throughout the game, each offering glimpses into the town's true history and lore. Who Will You Become? * In “Beneath The Cherry Blossom Tree” you're not just solving a mystery; you're shaping the very fabric of its narrative. Will you uncover the truth that lies buried beneath, or will dark secrets consume you? The choice is yours. Special Note: * This game contains mature content, including themes of sexual assault, drug and alcohol abuse, self-harm, psychological elements, and choice-driven consequences that may not be suitable for all audiences.

row.name: Immunity Wars
row.detailed_description: Fight off your body's invaders using the combined strengths of your immune system's defenders! Immunity Wars is a turn-based tactics, classic hex grid, strategy game. Wield your units together effectively to fight off all kinds of bacteria, viruses, and even your own corrupted cells. Classic Hex Grid Tactics Immunity Wars is a classic hex grid tactical experience. You'll use each battlefield's terrain to your advantage, play against your enemy's weaknesses, and take all the time you need to plan your every move. With each passing level, your foes will truly put your tactical skills to the test, with likely multiple plays needed to defeat the toughest of enemies. Combine the Strengths of Your Immune System Throughout the game, you'll unlock access to more of your immune system's defenders. Its up to you to understand each unit's strengths and determine how to best put them into action, working them in tandem to achieve victory on every level. By nature, the immune system's components must work together to survive, or die trying. Battle Against Real Diseases This game uses real research to determine how your immunity units and the enemy pathogen units will act. This means you must use the real processes that your immune system goes through to stamp out a variety of invaders, with every new enemy encounter throwing a wrench in the carefully balanced system.

row.name: Jurig Escape
row.detailed_description: Escape the Nightmare Jurig Escape is a 15-minute Free Third-Person Survival Horror game . You will play as the unnamed high-schooler trapped in a looping nightmare: An 'empty' school with a revolver in your hand. Shoot the ghost and collect lost souls and escape this never-ending nightmare . Game Features Classic Asian Survival Horror In this third-person survival horror, you are awake without knowing how you got there. Deprived of choice, you must explore and find a way to escape the area. Be careful because a threatening aura fills the entire place. Classic Asian-Indonesian Theme From Indonesian High School to Pocong (an undead being), The whole experience is enveloped around an Asian-Indonesian setting that hits close to our home. Defeat Enemies The Conventional Way Shoot anything threatening in your way, Collect their souls, and find the escape door. The Genesis Of Asian-Indonesian Horror Made in 2010, this is our first prototype. As a first attempt in the game development journey, this demo serves as an experiment and blueprint for the birth of the DreadOut Series. We unearthed this long-lost game build quite recently. To commemorate DreadOut 10th Anniversary, we released it on Steam for your convenience. Please be mindful of the imperfection since this is an unchanged build from decades ago. We hope you enjoy this relic from the past.

row.name: Lil'Johnny Watermelon Smash
row.detailed_description: Lil Johnny finally made it home. Version one of their game, “Lil Johnny Goes Home,” had just been released, and the sun dipped below the horizon, casting a warm glow on the quiet suburban street. His worn-out backpack slung over one shoulder, Lil Johnny trudged up the driveway, eager to unwind. But Lil Johnny’s peace and quiet was short-lived. Somehow, the evil dragon named “Steve” had found its way into Lil Johnny’s world—a world that had been blissfully calm until now. Steve’s scales shimmered with malevolence, and his eyes glowed like smoldering embers. The once-tranquil neighborhood now echoed with the dragon’s roars. Lil Johnny armed with determination and a watermelon gun (yes, Lil Johnny had a watermelon garden and an endless supply of watermelons!), he set out to protect his home. The dragon’s lair lay hidden in a faraway land within Lil Johnny’s world. To reach Steve, Lil Johnny would have to fight through nineteen rounds of timed levels. Each level required him to shoot targets, beating the ticking clock to advance. All this target practice would prepare him for the ultimate faceoff against Steve. As the sun dipped lower, Lil Johnny stepped into the forest. The dragon’s roars echoed through the trees, shaking leaves loose from their branches. His heart pounded, but he remembered the countless hours spent coding, designing, and playtesting. This was his moment—the culmination of creativity and hard work. In the end, it wasn’t about pixels or high scores. It was about courage, watermelons (lots of them), and relentless target practice. Lil Johnny’s legacy would be etched in watermelon juice and code—a testament to imagination, teamwork, and the magic that happens when a small group of students believes in the power of both. Play your cards right, and Lil Johnny would face the evil dragon Steve, sending him packing for good. And so, in the heart of Ottawa, Canada, Lil Johnny’s Watermelon Smash became more than just a game—it became a legend. Panther Game Design Studio, a small high school class from Ottawa, poured their hearts into creating this Lowpoly world, a year long project run in their game design program.
row.short_description: Lil Johnny, armed with a watermelon gun, defends his tranquil world from the malevolent dragon Steve. To reach Steve’s lair, he faces nineteen timed levels, honing his skills through target practice. Panther Game Design Studio’s legacy is a high school class from Ottawa Canada.

row.name: 公主×观众
row.detailed_description: 公主与观众是一款live2d美少女游戏，玩家需要扮演一位记者，通过问答的方式揣摩公主的想法，以获得公主的信息从而完成一篇成功的报道。 神秘的公主殿下 上下逆转的采访 终年冰雪的国家——霍米托，那里气候恶劣，人民却生活的欣欣向荣，而带领他们的是一位神秘而又强势的公主殿下，包括国民在内，所有人都对她充满了好奇…… “她是一位强大而又美丽的女性”“她是一位铁血而又无情的铁狼”“她天天与企鹅为伴（？）”“惹怒她的人都没能活着回来！”…… 无数的流言在坊间传播，而你——一位名不见经传的无名记者却在偶然之间获得了一次独家专访的机会！你将有机会亲自面对公主殿下并向她发出提问。你必须得好好把握，这不但是一次难得可贵的机会，也肯定是一次重要的人生转折点…… 你精心准备了很多个问题，一步步走向了觐见的房间，公主就在你的面前！正当你打算提问，公主却开口了： “老是你问我可太无聊了！你来回答我的问题吧！” 阴晴不定的情绪 原来真实的她是…… 在游戏过程中，玩家会与公主开展对话进行采访，采访的过程中公主会不断的向玩家进行提问并坦率的说出真实的想法，如果能够顺利通过公主的提问，这次的采访一定会大获成功，但如果公主不能获得满意的答案，玩家则会步入不可想象的深渊！ 答错就有可能立即进入结局！紧张刺激的访谈游戏开始！ 丰富的结局 精美的插画 本作收录有十个不同的结局，每一种都会有单独绘制的CG插图！ 你是打算顺利完成采访？还是试着收集所有的惩罚？ 如果能够在不冒犯公主的情况下，一口气完成所有的提问，可能会有意想不到的收获哦！ 紧张刺激的问答游戏，一起了解公主的真实面目吧！

row.name: Astral Hound VR
row.detailed_description: There’s no other way! The astral plane becomes his only waking reality. Forced to live a nightmare cunningly orchestrated by BIO, an organization driven by the so-called greater good but at what cost? Hiding its practices under a suit of normalcy. Struggling, you play as Dr Howard, who leaves all certainty behind in a deadly quest to find the secrets hidden in the depths of the astral plane and to save humanity. Unknowing of what’s yet to come, the horrors of reality dawn on him as he finds fragmented memories and uncovers truths about Allie and Leilah that have been  hidden for years. Dr. Howard floats effortlessly in the vast expanse of the astral plane. Leaving him with the sensation of weightlessness that is both liberating and unnerving. Here, in this place is where the laws of physics hold no sway. The Grab System : Your Lifeline. The astral plane is another dimension. Reach into the void and pull yourself through the chaos, each grasp clawing you closer to the unknown. Every movement is a gamble: precision and resolve are the only things keeping you from drifting into the abyss. Propulsion Gloves: Defy the Current. With advanced propulsion gloves, you can fight back harder. Surge forward with bursts of speed, slicing through hostile currents in a desperate race against time. Your tools are your lifeline, but mastery of them is the difference between survival and annihilation. Astral Gems : Hunt for the truth.  Allie’s memories are not freely given. Scattered across its vast expanse are astral shards—glowing fragments of forgotten memories. These radiant shards pulse with eerie light, each one a key to unlocking the truth. But the shards are guarded, hidden in the plane’s most treacherous reaches. Dare to seek them out, and brace for what watches from the shadows. Astral Projectors: Unleash the Power. The astral shards serve a greater purpose. Machines known as astral projectors lie dormant, waiting for the shards to awaken them. When activated, these towering devices explode with light, carving through the void to reveal fragmented visions. These haunting glimpses of a forgotten past are your guide. But beware—some memories are better left buried.
row.short_description: Become The Astral Hound, play as Howard, a man who can project himself into the astral plane, as he traverses the Astral Realm to find and rescue Allie who has been kidnapped by a supernatural organization BIO.

row.name: Stairway

Observe the levels carefully for a successful exit. If everything is consistent in the level with the baseline state, proceed. If you observe any anomalies, turn back! Once you're out of the building, you can start the game all over again to experience all the anomalies! --- Attention! This game is a result of learning Unreal Engine. row.name: Esports Godfather: The Legend Begins
row.detailed_description: Official version About the Game 'Esport Godfather' is a management simulation card game that revolves around the theme of MOBA esports. In this game, you will play a role of a coach in an esports club and personally build your own team! Starting from scratch, what kind of playstyle will you devise for your team? In a constantly evolving meta, can you derive a unique understanding of what it takes to win? What style of play will you devise for the team? Trident or 1-carry? Is the main focus on the top lane 1v1 battle, or the ultimate coordination between Mid laner and Jungler? In the ever-changing version environment, can you come up with a unique understanding of victory and lead the team to success? How will you inspire those outstanding athletes you carefully selected and mold them into superstars? And finally, can you overcome countless obstacles, lift the championship trophy, and write your own esports legend? Create your team logo You can not only customize your team's name but also create a unique team logo using the tools provided in the game (you can also import local images). Then you can see the flag with your logo waving on the battlefield, in the community, and in the most liked team vote each month! Build your hero draft The match has already begun before 00:00! Engage in a BP game with your opponents, picking your draft from over 50 heroes. Based on the version and your players' proficiency, choose a lineup that crushes your opponents and makes victory inevitable! Card Command your players through cards: your jungler is ready to initiate a team fight, send him to the bottom lane to ambush the opponents. Or if the enemy heroes are supporting elsewhere, take advantage and push... Command your players towards victory based on your hand and the situation on the field. Player Development As a coach, you need to create training plans for players based on their traits, arrange hero pools reasonably, and build tactic card decks to guide them to become superstars! Version Rules Change You can't be invincible with just one strategy because the version is always changing. Each version change will replace available equipment, alter the pace, and change various aspects of gameplay. Learning the version and adapting is the key to being a perpetual winner! Pre-match and Post-match A highly popular match hasn't started yet, but all enthusiastic viewers have already gathered for lively discussions. After a match, they will cheer for the MVP based on the player's excellent performance! Every week, every month, every season, outstanding players and teams will appear on the leader board and gain their fans! Enjoy your own flowers and applause! Journey of the King Ultimately Leads to... Starting from an unknown semi-professional team, through various leagues, ultimately entering the forefront of the world. But is this the last stop of the conquering journey? Your goal is believed to be the champion of The Worlds!
row.short_description: E-sports Godfather is a Deck-building game simulating MOBA e-sports. You will play a role as team coach and build your team. You need to train players and make strategies in various game versions, beat other teams and finally, take the Champion of the World. Be nobody, or lead your team to dominate!

row.name: Union of Gnomes: Prologue
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME About the Game Is this just the beginning or the end? The boundary blurs and the tale unfolds like an old map, its edges worn by time. But what is happening? The question echoes through the caverns of forgotten lore. In the basement’s darkness, where cobwebs cling to to wooden beams like the memory of a lost loved one, dreams and truths entwine. The world lies far, far away — its secrets veiled. What has happened to it? Or perhaps, what would have happened? This dream, a fragile tapestry, unravels against the cosmic loom of life. All is weird The Master’s will, an iron decree, governs the broken kingdom of Gnomes. A dark mission, veiled in shadows, beckons only in the Prologue’s hallowed pages. The ink smells of ancient forests, and the parchment cradles forgotten oaths. See what the Kingdom will become, should you falter. The Gnomes’ destiny rests upon your trembling hands — their hopes, sorrows, their whispered lullabies. And there, amidst the gnarled roots, a voice in your head murmurs cryptic riddles. Is it memory or prophecy? Listen closely. Escape from the nightmare, dear wanderer. Traverse the labyrinth of ink, blood, and imagination. Finish the prologue, and perhaps — just perhaps — you’ll glimpse something else: a door ajar, a glimmer of forgotten magic, a path diverging into the unknown.
row.short_description: The Prologue of the Union of Gnomes awaits your daring and brave gaze. Twisted and broken, it stands — a reflection of what was never meant to be. The threads of destiny fray, and reality splinters like a shattered mirror.

row.name: Trilingual

row.name: Brutal Bible Bloodbaths
row.detailed_description: Brutal Bible Bloodbaths is a controversial first-person physics-based game. It involves a few sandbox levels that you can play around in. These levels include things mentioned in the Bible passage, such as fruit trees that God says not to chop. Cleanse the promised land Based on Deuteronomy 20:16-20 from the Bible, you have to kill everything that breathes and you can order soldiers to help you. Your victims include animals, children, babies, and sexual worship assistants. The Bible justifies this by explaining that God hates the way the people worship their gods. The End Times In a level it's the future and things have changed. The soldiers initially disobey your cleansing command and say 'Jesus will come and judge the world'. They also quote Psalm 11:5 which says 'God hates people who love violence'. With or without blood and gore In the initial warning screen you can choose whether you want blood and gore or not. This allows you to change the game mode to 'Unbrutal Bible Bubblebaths'. Fully dynamic chopping Using your magic laser sword, you can chop people, animals, and many other objects however you like, until they are in tiny pieces. Precision chopping quest An optional quest gets you to chop people and animals in specific ways such as chopping their leg, arm, or tail. When finished you can return to the box to see how obedient you were. The Sinful Temple In a level you can explore a temple containing things God hates like child sacrifice and sexual worship assistants. You can worship the god/goddess idols in the temple but this will cause the soldiers to target you as well. Tidy up the bodies A level has you tidying up the clutter in the promised land after cleansing by pushing chopped up bodies into a pit. Chase and chop In a level you have to chop people who are hiding and running for their lives and try to get a low enough cleansing time. The Body Hacker This weapon allows you to hack the matrix in the game to make the targeted body part break into pieces. Holy Hand Grenades Blow all of the people and animals to kingdom come in slow motion. Other things in the game You can also ride horses, get drunk on fermented fruit, build ladders to get over city walls, and chop just about everything including flowers and talking robots from the future.
row.short_description: Based on a profound Bible passage, use weapons like your magic laser sword to cleanse the promised land with optional body chopping and blood splatter.
row.notes: This cartoony game is based on a Bible passage telling you to kill everything that breathes in the promised land. You do this by chopping them up with your magic laser sword causing blood to spray everywhere. There are also sexual worship assistants who stand around in their underwear. The Bible passage says that God hates the way the people worship their gods.

row.name: PrepPipe Compiler - Visual Novel Development Tool
row.detailed_description: The visual novel development tool allows you to use a script format closer to natural language (e.g., English) writing and create demos with minimum effort, enabling visual novel development with a smaller feedback loop (effort to outcome). What you need to feed into the tool: Story scripts (docx/odt documents, markdown, plain text) (Optional) assets (backgrounds, character sprites, music, etc) What you can get from the tool: Game engine project files (scripts and converted/generated assets) Statistics & Reports (WIP) We currently support Ren'Py and WebGal (experimental) as backends. This is a free-and-open-source project. We also had a paper,  'PrepPipe: Prototyping Compiler for Attainable Visual Novel Development,'  DOI: 10.1109/CoG60054.2024.10645615 WARNING: This tool is still under development. This store page is not in its final shape, and we will update it during the development. The current release is mainly for testing. USE THIS TOOL AT YOUR OWN RISK. We will try hard to fix issues ASAP, however.
row.short_description: Visual novel development tool with a natural-language-oriented script format for fast prototyping and iterative development workflow

row.name: Goblin Kart Rescue
row.detailed_description: On no, the local heroes have kidnapped the goblin princess! It's up to Braker and Booster to save the day with their trusty karts! Buckle up and race through exciting obstacle courses to free all the princesses in Goblin Kart Rescue! Goblin Kart Rescue is a top-down racing game, with 24 short but challenging tracks against a CPU opponent. After saving all the princesses by winning in story mode, try beating your own time in Time Attack, or see how many races you can clear in the difficult Endless mode!
row.short_description: Goblin Kart Rescue is a top-down racing game, with 24 short but challenging tracks against a CPU opponent. After saving all the princesses by winning in story mode, try beating your own time in Time Attack, or see how many races you can clear in the difficult Endless mode!

row.name: Ultimate Hero: The Legend of Flurry Playtest
Magic Lantern Festival
row.detailed_description: ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~【Invitation】~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Dear high witchness, The Lanternville is glad to inform you that the next Magic Lantern Festival will soon be held. Everything you need to participate is thirst for wisdom and a nice little familiar. Under the name of The Great Witch, let us praise every single drop of knowledge! Sincerely yours, Magic Lantern Festival Committee ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ To newborn witches, the Magic Lantern Festival is a feast held in Lanternville every time the committee feels motivated. This time, the rule is very simple; let your familiar survive a bullet hell of magic for a certain period of time. Each witch you encounter in Lanternville will continuously emit magic while giving random quizzes on their field of specialty. Not answering or making mistakes on the given quiz will result in tough penalty... Don't think about doing so on purpose! ----------------------------------------------------------------------- On a pixel-designed 2D stage, you will have to survive a bullet hell for a certain time period. Not only that... you also need to answer quizzes simultaneously in order not to let the bullet hell become more and more dense. During the Early Access, players can access to 9 genres of quizzes, each of them with an Easy mode and Hard mode. There is also a practice mode where you can only practice solving the quizzes (without the bullet hell).
row.short_description: Magic Lantern Festival is a hyper multitask 2D bullet hell. Players are required to recreate their brain in order to dodge all the magic bullets and answer random quizzes simultaneously.

row.name: Royal Quest Online
row.detailed_description: Royal Quest Online is a free-to-play MMORPG that seamlessly combines elements of captivating fantasy and futuristic technology. Begin a crusade against the forces of evil! Defend your kingdom, earn titles, hoard riches and conquer castles ! THE CHOICE IS YOURS Imagine a team consisting of a sniper armed with support cannon, a mage casting defensive shields, a mercenary assassin throwing poison bombs, and a crusader spreading the holy light while riding an armored wolf! Royal Quest Online offers these and hundreds of other roles for you to fulfill. Discover a world full of goblins, werewolves, vampires, orcs and even dragons. Visit enchanted living forests, dungeons full of deadly traps, magnificent palaces, hulking fortresses, forlorn laboratories and even islands in the sky. Get to know this magic world and then conquer it ! Lands of Elenia truly are a sight to behold and they’re just made for adventure! Join magic orders and clandestine organizations, meet the native inhabitants of Elenia and dig through the echoes of past civilizations, ravaged by the horrendous cataclysms. All that and more leads to thousands of quests replete with valuable rewards. YOUR PATH TO GLORY There’s no single right way to the top. Play, aim big , and never stop, until you get what you want! Become a wandering monster hunter or a mercenary doing regular jobs. Sign up for Royal service or make a fortune selling rarities. Vanquish competition in the arena and wrest yourself a castle. Go as far as your imagination allows you! GUILD CLASHES You live in the kingdom — you follow its laws. Become a member of an existing guild or create your very own to then fight other guilds over massive fortresses . Owning a castle is not only honorable, but also highly profitable, as castles generate regular income. Start with one castle and keep expanding your holdings!
row.short_description: Fantasy comes alive in this vast yet cozy free-to-play MMORPG! Choose between 4 classes and 8 subclasses, explore hundreds of locations, thousands of quests, dive into varied PvE and PvP modes, enter the unique vibrant world, and trade with other players. Play, explore, fight and be victorious!

row.name: Banana Cowboy
row.detailed_description: About Banana Cowboy is an adventure platformer set in a fruit-themed universe. You are the Banana Cowboy, the outcasted son of the king of the Banana Planet. However, your tyrannical twin brother has taken control of the fruit worlds with his evil blender, and it is up to you to liberate the universe. Save your scattered people from the Orange Bikers and Blueberry Pirates using your trusty lasso! Swing Your Way Through Use your trusty lasso to swing on different objects ranging from soda cans and bottles! Throw Enemies and Bombs Grab hold onto objects and throw them to break barriers or fight the bosses! Explore Fruit Worlds You will make your way through 5 fruit themed planets, the Prickly Pear Cowboys, the Orange Bikers, the Blueberry Pirates, the Strawberry Mafia, and the Banana Kingdom!
row.short_description: Play as Banana Cowboy and adventure in fruit-themed universe, rescuing your people from your evil twin who has taken over the Banana Kingdom. Use your trusty lasso and spaceship horse to travel to the Orange Biker and Blueberry Pirate planets and save the universe from the Evil King!

row.name: Wandering Stars
row.detailed_description: 우주 사이를 유랑하던 쌍둥이 『별』은, 우주의 질서를 어지럽히는 혼돈의 공격을 받아 낯선 【별】에 떨어지게 되었습니다. 쌍둥이 별은 혼돈을 무찌르고 우주에 평화를 되찾기 위해 모험을 시작하게 되었습니다. 별의 유랑은 두 명의 플레이어가 온라인 협동을 통해 퍼즐을 풀며 앞으로 나아가는 2인 협동 퍼즐 어드벤쳐 게임입니다. 협력을 통해 성공적으로 모험을 끝마치세요! 별들 사이를 유랑하세요! 온라인 협동을 통해 친구와 함께 우주에 펼쳐진 별들을 모험하세요! 당신을 공격한 혼돈이, 모험의 끝에서 당신을 기다리고 있을 것입니다. 별의 부탁을 들어주세요! 당신이 방문하는 별은 모두 갖가지의 고난을 겪고 있습니다. 별과의 이야기를 통해 별의 고난을 알아내고 별의 부탁을 들어주세요. 별의 부탁을 들어준다면 별은 당신이 다음 별로 나아가도록 도와줄 것입니다. 신비한 별의 힘을 사용하세요! 모험을 통해 플레이어는 신비한 별의 힘을 획득할 수 있습니다. 사출, 조작, 동화, 투영 네 가지의 능력을 통해 퍼즐을 풀고, 적을 무찌르며 앞으로 나아가세요! 사출 : 막대한 양의 에너지가 담긴 별의 힘을 내보내, 물체를 활성화합니다. 조작 : 별의 힘이 깃든 물체를 움직입니다. 동화 : 별에 물들며 별의 자취를 따라 이동할 수 있습니다. 투영 : 잠시 별의 이야기를 빌려, 일시적으로 검과 활을 사용할 수 있습니다. 혼돈을 무찌르세요! 모험의 최종 목표는 우주의 질서를 어지럽히는 혼돈을 무찌르는 것 입니다. 지금껏 별의 유랑하며 쌓아온 노하우로 혼돈을 무찌르세요!
row.short_description: Become a twin star and go on adventures in various stars. In the adventure, you are reborn as a absolute star, leaving a number of stories. Collaborate with your companion, take chances, and leave a story!

row.name: Ghostbane: Prologue
row.detailed_description: The free version of Ghostbane, Ghostbane: Prologue to experience the core gameplay and get a taste of what's to come in the full version. Don't forget to add it to your wishlist! ' Ghostbane: Prologue ' is a multiplayer horror game that you can play with your friends. Detect paranormal activity, collect evidence of ghosts, hunt ghosts by rituals, and conduct detailed investigations about ghosts in your main base. Go to the area of paranormal activity. Use the unique Ghostbane equipment to identify the type of ghost. Ritualise the area to capture the identified ghost and hunt it with the ritual. This is an experience that will push your horror limits. We've prepared it with carefully designed unique scenes and superior graphics. Meticulously crafted environments and eerie details will draw you into the atmosphere. You will feel tension in your bones. Ghosts captured as a result of paranormal research and hunting activities can be observed in capsules at your main base. These capsules allow you to analyse a ghost's history, personality, manner of death and relationship to paranormal activity.
row.short_description: 'Ghostbane: Prologue' is a multiplayer horror game that you can play with your friends. Detect paranormal activity, collect evidence of ghosts, hunt ghosts by rituals, and conduct detailed investigations about ghosts in your main base.

row.name: Galaxy Idle Clicker
row.detailed_description: Embark on an EPIC Journey through Space with Galaxy Idle Clicker ! Upgrade your Spaceship with countless enhancements as you explore 5 vast Universes , each containing 4 Galaxies , 4 Solar Systems per Galaxy, 6 Planets per System, and 9 Areas per Planet. (4.320 Areas!) Conquer each Area by defeating enemy ships, collecting resources, and rescuing prisoners. Experience four unique reset systems and three thrilling Mini-Games! With offline farming and astronomical numbers, automate your adventure and achieve the ultimate Space Conquest in Galaxy Idle Clicker !
row.short_description: Embark on an interstellar journey with Galaxy Idle Clicker! Conquer galaxies, upgrade your spaceship, and face off against a myriad of enemy ships. With engaging minigames, powerful upgrades, GIC delivers an unparalleled idle space adventure. Join the cosmic conquest today and dominate the universe!

row.name: Manludo
row.detailed_description: You wake up on an alien space station. To leave, you need to win at manludo/hand game (rock, paper, scissors) against three aliens. You can leave your fate up to chance, exploit your opponent's weakness, or bluff your way to victory. Be careful with bluffing, the more you bluff the more likely you are to lose everyone's trust: making bluffing more difficult in the future. Gameplay: Use mouse or touchscreen. Click or touch the blue arrow ➡️ to move forward in dialog. When making a decision click on the text you would like to do. During the hand game click on the hands, either rock, paper, scissors, or bluff. Icons show the number of wins you have in a match 🏆, the number of coins you have 💰, and your trust score ⚖️ (how much people trust you). The higher your trust score the more likely you are to successfully bluff. If you lose turn you get an option to talk to your opponent 🗣️, you might find a weakness you can exploit. The game can be completed in about 5 minutes. --- Esperanto --- Vi vekiĝas sur ekstertera kosmostacio. Por forlasi la stacion, vi devas venki tri eksterteranojn en ludo de roko, papero, tondilo. Vi povas lasi vian sorton en la manoj de la hazardo, ekspluati la malfortecon de via kontraŭulo, aŭ blufi por venki. Estu singarda pri blufado; ju pli vi blufas, des pli probable vi perdos la fidon de ĉiuj: tio igas blufadon pli malfacila estontece. Uzu muson aŭ tuŝekranon. Klaku aŭ tuŝu la bluan sagon ➡️ por antaŭeniri en dialogo. Kiam vi faras decidon, klaku sur la tekston, kiun vi volas elekti. Dum la manludo, klaku sur la manojn por ŝtono, papero, tondilo, aŭ blufi. Ikonetoj montras la nombron de viaj venkoj en matĉo 🏆, la kvanton de viaj moneroj 💰, kaj vian fidindecon ⚖️ (kiom multe homoj fidas vin). Ju pli alta via fido-poentaro, des pli verŝajne vi sukcesos blufi. Se vi perdas vicon, vi ricevas opcion paroli kun via kontraŭulo 🗣️; vi eble malkovros malfortecon, kiun vi povas ekspluati. La ludo povas esti finita en ĉirkaŭ 5 minutoj.
row.short_description: Play rock, paper, scissors to get off an alien space station. Esperanto: Vi devas ludi papero, tondilo, ŝtono por forlasi eksterteran kosmostacion.

row.name: Fluffquake Fury
row.detailed_description: Join Pippa Pillowfeather in her bid to escape the Fluffquake Fury before Bedtime! She must use her pillow to whack, spin and jump her way through various bedroom skirmishes before the lights go out! This is the debut release from novice developer JustAlexGames! Play as Pippa Pillowfeather, the cute and feisty young pillow whacking girl who's dressed ready for bed - but has no intention of closing the curtains until she's defeated all the baddies in the bedroom! Lights are out soon, so she has to use her pillow to whack 'em fast before its too late! She starts off in her own bedroom and once the Mousey is defeated a new room will be unlocked. The challenges get tougher and tougher as she unlocks more rooms until the corridor is complete and she's granted with a new Pillow Spin ability! The next world is her Mum and Dad's room - she really shouldn't be in there but there's many, many new baddies to conquer first! Next is a hotel - with some really tricky situations in the rooms and corridor! There's even a lift you can use to explore the basement, stock up on health and strength and escape from the nasty green smoke that comes when you throw one of your new poison pillows! If you survive all that, then there's one final boss to conquer! He is armed with devastating exploding pillows and is weaving in and out of falling beds as he runs to the finish line! Enjoy playing this simple, quick, light hearted game - the debut game from JustAlexGames. Music composed by the developer - I challenge you to keep the theme out of your head!
row.short_description: A light-hearted, fun, simple RPG where you play as bedroom hero Pippa Pillowfeather and try and beat lights out by using her Pillow to defeat any monsters in the bedroom! Use new pillow attack abilities as she progresses to different bedroom scenes.

row.name: Metal Slug: Awakening
row.detailed_description: [New Season: Adventure Begins - Version Update Content] - New Gameplay - Treasure Cave: In this season's Abyssal Rift, commanders will venture into a new rift zone where the ocean and land coexist. In this dangerous yet treasure-filled area, embark on a new journey alongside your clubmates! - Gameplay Upgrade - Joint Operation Abyss Mode: In the new season of Joint Operation - Abyss Mode, commanders will head to the newly introduced Morden Army Base. The Curse Demon has taken control of Morden Army's soldiers and armor, and the curse is spreading rapidly. Unlock new mysterious powers to help break the curse and defeat your enemies. - New System - Growth Boosting: Growth Boosting allows commanders who are falling behind to earn more development resources by participating in daily gameplays. Additionally, level boosts are available to help those lagging behind catch up to the average level of the main group. - New Weapon - Laser Gun: Combining stable firepower with the potential for an energy explosion, the Laser Gun is the epitome of destructive force. High-pressure pulses surge within the energy core, the gun is always ready to wreak havoc! - New Character - Eiserner: Although Eiserner was just an ordinary girl with no military training not long ago, her remarkable strategic abilities quickly elevated her to become Blackfire's youngest senior commander. Striving for victory with 'minimal cost,' Eiserner gives the command: Attack! - Collaborative Character - Kyo Kusanagi: The P.F. Squad accidentally enters the World of Fighters, where Kusanagi teams up with Marco to KO the evil villains! Kyo Kusanagi possesses extensive fighting experience and exceptional combat skills. Join our official communities for more information. Discord: X: @MetalSlugAwaken YouTube: @MetalSlug_Awakening ©SNK CORPORATION ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.
row.short_description: Metal Slug: Awakening continues the classic gameplay loved by fans, with exciting new features like World Adventure, 3-player Team-up, and Roguelike challenges. Join forces with your friends online to take on powerful bosses anytime, anywhere!

row.name: Anna: The Magic of Words
row.detailed_description: It’s a challenging 1980s like platformer game with a serious story. For the Nintendo Entertainment System® and Famicom. Game in active development. Demo download below. The story of the game The magic of words gave you everything and suddenly took everything from you. A little sad and disappointed you make your way through a dangerous world. Embark on the difficult journey through dangerous caves, deep forest and icy landscapes. Collect scrolls and combine their words, face your fear and the ticking clock. But whatever happens, never forget your most important goal: find Anna. The deeper meaning of the story The game is more than a typical 1980s platformer. The game itself is just a shell. The shell for a process of self-discovery, healing, motivation and the strong will not to give up. The character embarks on an arduous journey and search for Anna. Even if you’ve already guessed it, Anna doesn’t have to be human or animal. Anna can just as well be representative of a favourite place, a feeling, family, being at home, feeling good or the satisfaction of a completed task or with yourself, but of course also a single person. There is no right or wrong answer to the meaning of the game title. You decide. You are also welcome to simply ignore the psychological aspect and concentrate fully on playing this challenging platforming title. Just pay attention to the little hearts and the ticking clock. ;-P Game controls After the first game start, there is a standard keyboard layout configured already: D-Pad: W-A-S-D Select button: K Start button: L B button: , A button: . You can configure your keyboard or gamepad directly via Settings > Controls menu.
row.short_description: It’s a challenging 1980s like platformer game with a serious story. For the Nintendo Entertainment System® and Famicom.

row.name: Welcome to the Ungdung Cafe
row.detailed_description: * This game does not support basic English. Once a teacher, ChoonSam attends a reunion at Dongil High School, where he worked as a teacher. There, he hears the news about Lee Jinwoo, a student he especially cared about, and he runs a hip cafe because he meets Jinwoo through an accidental opportunity... Survive from pouring menu orders! [/h2] Protect the store from the real people! Until we collect the target amount! . *This game is a 15-year-old user with violence, sensationality, and language violence.
row.short_description: Once a teacher, Choon-sam Choi attends a reunion at Dongil High School, where he worked as a teacher. There, he hears the news about Lee Jin-woo, a student he especially cared about, and he runs a hip cafe because he meets Jin-woo through an accidental opportunity...

row.name: NETHER HEROES
row.detailed_description: Dive into the depths of Nether Heroes , an exciting action-platformer with roguelike elements that challenges you to conquer danger-infested dungeons. In this dark world, you will have to face menacing monsters and ruthless bosses that will test your combat skills. Dungeon Exploration: Adventure through several levels, each with its own layout and unique enemies. Diversity of Weapons and Items: Unlock and master a variety of weapons and items to demolish your enemies. Character Progression: Earn money and experience to upgrade your hero in the rest areas, where you can recover health, acquire advanced equipment, and purchase new weapons. Deep Customization: Use the character editor to create a unique hero with custom skins or your own designs. Arena Mode: Show your bravery and face endless waves of enemies in an ultimate survival challenge, where the only objective is to survive as long as possible. Every game in Nether Heroes is an opportunity to demonstrate your skill and strategy. Are you ready to brave the depths and reveal the secrets hidden beneath them?
row.short_description: Immerse yourself in Nether Heroes, an intense action-platform roguelike game. Conquer challenging dungeons, face menacing creatures, and defeat powerful bosses on your epic adventure.

row.name: Blue Land
row.detailed_description: To summarize, Blue Land is a 2D, Open World game, with a more chemistry-based twist on the survival genre. PLOT You find yourself in a world full of dangerous entities distilled from the periodic elements of our universe, brewed up by the essence of pure evil. Like tumors, your world is filled with little biomes, with elemental entities, ready to take your life. These entities may be harvested for elements of the periodic table, and may be crafted into fierce weapons, to aid you in facing harder and harder entities until you are finally ready for the final challenge; THE ELEMENTAL KING ... In Blue Land, you can fight the clock to try to get your fastest time , or you can explore and inquire ins and outs of the Blue Land World in this survival game. In any case, you can - Craft - Fight - Explore The choice is yours... Credits and Special Thanks to: -Xiaoyi 'Ethan' Pan (Ethanbaby66) - Artist -FishUser - Musician
row.short_description: Craft, fight, explore! In this Open-World experience, you can do that all! The choice is yours...
row.notes: This game features a unique and immersive system where various substances, including illegal drugs like steroids, unconventional items such as gasoline, and legal substances like cigarettes and strong alcohol, act as "potions." These items can either boost or negate specific player stats, adding a strategic layer to gameplay. Additionally, players can discover hidden Easter eggs that lead to unexpected and sometimes fatal consequences for certain NPCs.

row.name: Raid On Rift
row.detailed_description: Early Beta Access This game is in early access, full game release is coming soon! About the Game Raid On Rift is a video game featuring a turn-based strategy system with customizable teams made of unique characters. Our game centers on the fearsome and rugged Space Pirates as they face off against the militant and legendary Galactic Navy, fighting on an alien mining outpost to fight over a coveted and extremely valuable source of ore. Our game also includes lan multiplayer capabilities so that players can play with their friends across separate devices. Furthermore explore the legend of the characters and learn their unique move sets within our games tutorial, story, and helpful UI features. Raid on Rift features an extremely dynamic playstyle, as their is draft phases, placement phases, and neutral zone phases before the game even begins. Challenge your friends and learn new strategies and army's to master your playstyle! Whether your interested in the lore or the infinite strategy variants and opportunities, our game has something to offer to gaming enthusiasts alike.
row.short_description: Be prepared to defend your Ore in this multiplayer turn-based strategy game! Take control of the Imperial Navy or the dreaded Space Pirates, and use a variety of crewmates to take your opponent's Ore before they take yours!

row.name: Miner Tower Defense
row.detailed_description: Background Story When the miners were digging underground, they accidentally opened some channels, inside which a continuous stream of monsters that would attack the precious energy crystals emerged. Fortunately, the miners have mastered a technique of using ore to synthesize defense towers. In order to resist the monster's attack, an adventure journey of mining and building defense towers begins! Gameplay Features 1.The combination of mining and tower defense You need to plant defense towers by mining and gathering minerals to resist monsters' attacks. I believe this innovative game mode that combines mining and tower defense can give you a different experience. Mining: Place defense towers to resist monsters: 2.Learn to utilize terrain There are intricate underground channels, and by modifying these channels to create favorable terrain, you can pass the levels more smoothly! 3.Rich gameplay This game includes 42 regular levels, 9 unique entertainment levels, 3 boss levels, and 3 endless mode levels. In addition, you will gain various tools and talismans on your adventure journey, which will make you even stronger! In short, the rich gameplay makes mining never boring! Unknown Minesweeper Mode: Powerful BOSS: Hope you enjoy this indie game!
row.short_description: This is a game that combines mining and tower defense elements. Players need to build defense towers by digging and gathering minerals underground to resist a constant stream of monsters!

row.name: DeepWeb Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: ADD FULL VERSION TO WISHLIST! SEE ALSO ! About the Game This Prologue allows you to immediately start your dark trade with the limited version of Deepweb Simulator. Complete your fun deep web experience by adding the full game to your wishlist! Deep Internet Classifieds Players will be able to post classified ads for various categories of illegal goods, from banned foods to drugs. Illegal Goods Expand your inventory by sourcing illegal goods. Airplanes invisible on radar Covert procurement of goods. Goods Delivery Make deliveries to hidden compartments and individuals in alleyways.
row.short_description: DeepWeb Simulator: Prologue and start your dark trade! Start running your own dark world now. Source, process and sell illegal goods. Expand your inventory and take the restricted step of your dark trade empire.
row.notes: The game deals with themes such as the buying and selling of illegal goods, but these elements are not shown in any disturbing or inappropriate way. The game presents these themes in a light and fun way, providing an enjoyable experience for players.

row.name: 誘拐犯 Kidnappers
row.detailed_description: *ding-dong* You're playing at your friend's house when you hear the doorbell ring. His parents are coming home late today, so your friend has to go look. ■About the Game This is a horror game where you must escape while avoiding the enemy and collecting specified items. There are elements of being chased, but no jump scares (sudden loud noises or scary images). The expected playtime is around 15 to 20 minutes. There are 3 endings: BAD (Game Over), NORMAL, and TRUE. The game does not feature a progress-saving function (only mouse sensitivity and volume settings are saved). ■Controls WASD: Move L Shift: Sprint E: Interact Esc: Menu ■Regarding Video Streaming Streaming and Let's Play videos are permitted without requiring permission. If possible, please include the game's name in the title of your stream or video, and include a link to the Steam page in the description.
row.short_description: 誘拐犯 Kidnappers is a horror game where you aim to escape without being caught by mysterious visitors while retrieving the game you lent to your friend.

row.name: Impostor Online
row.detailed_description: Impostor Online is a murder mystery and social deduction game inspired by classics like Werewolf and Town of Salem . In each match, players are assigned random roles within three competing factions: Civilians (good guys), Impostors (bad guys), and Zombies (infection). Civilians win by eliminating all Impostors and Zombies, Impostors win by outnumbering Civilians, and Zombies win if they're the last faction standing. Impostors are the main murderers. Each night, they can see and communicate with one another and select one player to eliminate. Ghost Investigators play a crucial role on the Civilians team. Each night, they can communicate and choose one player to investigate, revealing their role and guiding the team's strategy. Jester  can either vote to kill a player each night or hide to conceal their identity from investigators. Nurse  can inject players each night. Their injections heal players targeted by Impostors, but will kill any player after two non-consecutive treatments. Nurse can instantly eliminate Zombies with a single injection. Zombies can infect one player each night to convert them to their team. However, they can't identify fellow Zombies, and accidentally targeting another Zombie results in that Zombie's death. During the day, all players gather to debate who they believe is guilty. Through voting, they can lynch a suspect. Civilians must collaborate with Investigators to eliminate the Impostors and Zombies to secure their victory. FEATURES: Multiplayer : Play online with 6 to 16 players. You can play with your friends or join other players. Written and vocal chat : Communication is key in Impostor Online, as you have to either accuse suspicious players or defend yourself against their accusations! Multiple unique roles : Special roles and abilities across three competing factions – Civilians, Impostors, and Zombies. Customization : Personalize your character from head to foot. Progression and statistics : Earn experience points and rewards from every game you win. As you level up, unlock new titles and cosmetic items to showcase your rank and style.
row.short_description: Inspired by party games like Werewolf and Mafia, Impostor Online is a 6-16 player online game of murder, deception, and infection. Join friends and play as a Civilian, Impostor, Zombie, Nurse, Jester, or other unique characters to strategize your way to victory!

row.name: Fruity Friendz Adventurez
row.detailed_description: Fruity Friendz Adventurez is a cool FREE TO PLAY casual game with action, adventure, educational features and humor. It's all taking place in a beautiful environment including forest, rivers, lakes, mountains. The story is about Peter Pear, paint artist and creator father of the Fruity Friend Benny Banana, is kidnapped by the Villainz and taken hostage into the Villainz castle.  Benny will have to explore the big world and face many challenges like trap holes , pendulums and mazes. In the entire world annoying Crumbleez (cookie crumble creatures)  appear from everywhere and challenge Benny to battle them, that will decrease his energy life bar, but can be filled up by collecting fruit.  On his quest to find Peter and free him, he has to defeat the end boss Keki. But only with enough collected coins and defeated Crumbleez.
row.short_description: Are you ready to help free Peter Pear, creator of the Fruity Friendz, who is locked up in a castle, by defeating Villainz and annoying Crumbleez, face many challenges and collect coins and fruit to earn one of a kind items?

row.name: Vribyss Refuge™ The Escape
row.detailed_description: A rare breed of starfish with healing properties known as 'Vribyss' was recently discovered and exploited by the Kexxrans. This created the greatest refugee crisis the world has ever seen. While fleeing from the Kexxrans, Isla falls deep into a cave. As she searches for a way out, she encounters mysterious beings trapped there that may be able to help her get out. Features: • Short story-driven game • Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment (DDA) based on one or more factors: current health, enemies (if any) defeated, and time to complete specific tasks. • 1st/3rd person perspective • Strafing mode • Downloadable PDF strategy guide • Downloadable documentation for 'Non-Official PS5 DualSense Support' • Alternate ending if the player pursues a mysterious object during a 'time-sensitive' situation.

row.detailed_description: Mouse Killer is a 100% Free to play bullet hell game. This game is a pure Mouse only game! Use the mouse to move, left button is for shooting, right button is for aiming. row.name: May's Journey
row.detailed_description: Embark on an engaging adventure with 'May’s Journey', a 2.5D puzzle game that seamlessly integrates programming concepts into its gameplay. Navigate through a maze-like environment and employ the game’s intuitive pseudo code to manipulate various objects and overcome challenges. Designed as an interactive learning experience, 'May’s Journey' immerses players in the fundamentals of programming, emphasizing logical thinking and object-oriented abstractions. Set in a crafted fictional world thrown into disarray, players assume the role of the guide and helper of May, the determined protagonist on a quest to restore balance and uncover the enigma behind her world's fracture.
row.short_description: May’s Journey is a 2.5D puzzle game where players use pseudo code to solve environmental mazes and learn programming basics, guiding protagonist May to restore balance in a fractured, fictional world.

row.name: Volcanewt
row.detailed_description: Mass destruction and newt goodness awaits you in Volcanewt ! Play as the Volcanewt, a volcanic salamander ready to destroy the World Wide Defense Force(WWDF) for leeching off his volcanic energy. In this action packed city destruction game, you go across the 3 Hawiwi Islands, a tropical archipelago that on any other day would be a tropical paradise to visit. These three islands are Beginners Bay, a tourist hotspot where our newt makes their humble beginnings, to Hawiwi Resort, a beautiful resort with a more mustered militia to defend against the Volcanewt, to Mamba Metropolis, a metropolis that also acts as the WWDF's main headquarters. In Volcanewt , to complete each level you must fill out your destruction meter, a tool to determine how much of the city you have annihilated, and claim back your thermal energy from the clusters of the WWDF in the form of destroying powerplants. Doing so will further unlock the Volcanewt's dormant powers. These powers consist of a thermally powered charge, a fireball projectile, and a beam for destruction on a massive scale. The WWDF won't allow their cities to be destroyed that easily though, as they droves of soldiers to fend you off, and the creations of General Hugh Gexplosion to further halt the Volcanewt's Advance. Play as the massive Volcanewt, destroy the cities to progress, and unlock abilities that will aid in the total destruction of the WWDF!
row.short_description: Volcanewt is an action city destruction game where the goal is annihilation. Destroy the city, defeat the WWDF and their creations, and save? the Hawiwi Archipelago.

row.name: Summoned By Accident
row.detailed_description: Summoned by Accident is a text based rpg focused mainly on m/m content with character driven plot. In it, you explore and run into inhabitants of the world. Some friendly, some foe. Inspired by other text based games and some videos. You play as a visitor to the world who's trapped here till you can get a way back home. Luckily, your first encounter is with a short blue fox that seems to have the hook up. Able to get you a place to stay and even a new job as you wait. This, much like the inhabitants of the world, is something more than what first comes to eye. As you meet new people and learn what exactly you're being set up for, you'll be forced to choose who's allegiance you stand for. Even if that is mainly for one other person than group. At first, you'll be restricted on what you can do. Exploring and finding about the little part of the city you stay at, but as you progress further in the story, so too does your freedom along with others. What starts out as you learning about the world and meeting new people, will evolve into you changing yourself to fit the occasion. Whether it's changing your looks for the right guy to be interested in you or people to give you the time of day. The way you fight so you can stand a chance against something you're dragged in to. Or just to do it so you can see that something special only a certain few can, you won't be leaving this world the same way you came into it.
row.short_description: Summoned by Accident is a text based rpg focused mainly on m/m content with character driven plot. In it, you explore and run into inhabitants of the world. Some friendly, some foe. Inspired by other text based games and some videos.

row.name: Light Reforged
row.detailed_description: Loki, the god of trickery, is up to his grandest scheme yet and to see it to fruition, Baldr, the god of wisdom and light, must be out of the way. Slain by Loki, Baldr is cast to the underworld. Loki uses this opportunity to his advantage to introduce intoxicating technology to the Aesir and dwarves, which the dwarves embed into the world causing an imbalance. Reborn by Hel, Baldr must restore balance to the world and regain godhood. Over Light Reforged, the player travels between four of the realms of Norse mythology. These include Helheim, the home of the dead; Asgard, the home of the Aesir; Vanaheim, the home of the Vanir; and Svartalfheim, the home of the Dwarves. The Realms: Vanaheim - realm of the Vanir and nature – is the last stand between Ivaldi and his goal of technological takeover. As such, it’s the most naturalistic and least steampunk in visual design. Asgard - Asgard is more technologically advanced than Vanaheim. The Asgard arena is a sacred battleground, but small glimpses of technology can be seen around the outer rim of the arena. Svartalfheim is home of the Dwarves and ruled by the Sons of Ivaldi. The city is the most corrupted realm, void of any lush nature. The water and sky are stained red from use of the magic cores. Roads, sidewalks, and large buildings are dirtied by the smog that persists through the city. Located in the city are three cores that power the city. Throughout the game, the player has multiple combat mechanics at their disposal for fighting different enemies throughout the levels: a dash, a melee attack, projectile weapons, the Prismatic Light Meter, and special actions. Use The Elements To Fight: As you fight you increase your Prismatic Light Meter. Prismatic Light allows you to use the elements to the advantage. There are three elements that can be chosen from. Fire, Ice, and Wind. Each of these elements has three tiers. Each elements offer a variety of offensive and defensive capabilities. You can get burn damage on your enemy over time, freeze them in place, or blow away large groups of enemies. Hack N Slash Your Way Through: Light Reforged focuses on hacking and slashing your enemies. Use fluid combat to strategically dodge enemies and gain the advantage on your foes. Challenge bosses and a variety of enemies throughout the realm that require you to think before you jump. If you feel overwhelmed, use your cannon to clear waves of enemies. Use your dash to mow through hordes and slash enemies as they try to surround you.
row.short_description: Light Reforged features Baldr, the god of wisdom and light, as he travels the Nine Realms to rid the world of technology that was designed by Loki and is slowly bewitching the realms. Exploring vibrant and technological worlds while defeating a variety of opponents.

row.name: terminal connection
row.detailed_description: terminal connection is a metaphor for doomscrolling. You fly a plane. Stay close to surfaces to keep your engine running as hyperreal landscapes flood your senses. You find yourself in a cozy airplane hanger, seated in a cockpit. As you attempt to start your flight, a glowing cave fades in around you. You go through the standard flight checks, testing your controls, and begin to glitch through overwhelming and disorienting spaces. Terms and conditions fly by you, the love you've never had is advertised – demanded – of you, your interests are weaponized in your workplace, and you're forced to see visceral vulnerability. Finally, space seems to collapse onto itself, threatening to overpower you, but you find yourself flying into a never-ending void. Will you end your terminal connection? terminal connection is an observation of the resting state of capitalist-hyperreality. Capitalist-hyperreality is a phenomenon brought about by the exponential growth of hyperreal influences within a capitalistic structure. Hyperreality is – the abstracted and self-referential understanding of reality that comes about as a result of human communication and, more relevantly, mass media. It identifies the distance we have created between our subjective realities and objective reality as a result of our construction of experienced reality based on the subjectivity of others rather than what actually might be real. If a rare flower were to be found in the modern day, a hyperreal construct of the flower would be created through language, videos, images, songs, artworks, and poems of said flower. The average person’s understanding of the flower would almost certainly be based on the hyperreal construct of the flower, and more hyperreal constructs would be created based on the existing hyperreal constructs. This perpetuating web of abstraction extends until the real flower itself is nearly forgotten. Only a minute few would have ever actually seen the real flower. terminal connection diagnoses the consequences of when hyperreal abstraction is driven by monetary incentives. This game is a metaphor for doomscrolling and expects to simulate the emotions brought forth by ever invasive social media, in a critical space. We hope to accentuate the adverse consequences of capital incentives on the otherwise natural processes of abstraction spreading throughout mass media. We've attempted to depict some of the relational cycles of oppression/oppressing present in capital driven social media and provide the player with the first step out of the cycle - the moment you choose to leave. Extensive writing about terminal connection and the process of creating it can be found on our blog, .
row.short_description: terminal connection is an experimental art game about doomscrolling. You fly a plane.
row.notes: Parts of the game include gory aesthetics (body parts, blood, etc.).

row.name: Priest With a Gun
row.detailed_description: Defeat a Demonic Outbreak A retro wave-based shooter where you and your foes become increasingly more powerful. Battle your way through hordes of demons using the power of whatever weird and magical drinks your local vending machine has to offer. Explore Your Local Park While fighting off the horde, be sure to check out everything this park has to offer! You can rescue a stray dog, get scammed by talking with strangers, support a local imp union, visit the bar, raise a pet leech, take trips to exotic demonic realms, fix teleporters to bend space and time, or make deals with a sentient piano! Keep the Fight Going After beating the game you can enter Endless mode, where enemies get exponentially more powerful with each new wave. How long can you last against the onslaught? Flex Your Expertise With 50+ achievements to get, you can show just how much of a vending machine enthusiast you are! And those who unlock all achievements get a special Completionist achievement (which soon will get your name/nickname on an in-game leader board). Get Involved As a first-time solo developer, I am still learning lots about game-making. Reach out if you encounter any bugs or if you have your own ideas about things to add to the game. Any idea submissions added to future updates will be credited to you, so be sure to include a name or pseudonym for accreditation!
row.short_description: A late-night vending machine run is cut short when a demonic outbreak occurs in the park. Little do the demons know, Father Garcia is never unarmed.

row.name: Vanakatu
row.detailed_description: This is an open-world story about VAN CAT (that's his name, no affiliations with vehicles), a duduk player from a regular family, who tracks down his CULT-LEADING UNCLE through spacetime to talk him out of creating a WORLDWIDE DICTATORSHIP!!! Explore three surreal, immersive worlds swirling with music, light and color, inspired by the Ottoman Empire, Soviet Armenia and modern day Armenia to rescue your best friend, talk some sense to your weird, weird uncle, and destroy his time machine. This Game Includes: Unique visuals by the developer herself Beautiful music Sunlight and other cute lighting to make it feel like you're actually outside and touching grass Battling mechanics Puzzle solving, using pattern recognition to unlock doors and find hidden keys... Open world exploration, I don't want to control you :D
row.short_description: A surreal story-driven game that uses puzzle-solving, turn based battling, and open world navigation to help Van Cat track down his evil uncle and put an end to his nefarious plans!

row.name: STEAMStar
row.detailed_description: A lo largo de este juego acompañarás a Galilei a través de ocho mundos para ayudarle a resolver ocho cuestiones relacionadas con el ámbito STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering y Mathematics). En cada mundo, tendrás que resolver un problema STEM, para lo que, no solamente deberás apuntar y destruir las estrellas que contienen las variables (datos) que necesitas para poder resolver este problema, sino que tendrás que decidir si la variable (dato) que te ofrece esa estrella es realmente útil para poder alcanzar la respuesta. OJO!! Porque habrá estrellas con variables que no necesitas y estrellas con variables, que aunque te podrían ser útiles, su utilización supone un coste adicional de telescopios, es decir, se puede alcanzar la solución mediante el uso de otras variables y utilizando menos telescopios. Cada mundo tiene la posibilidad de resolver tres veces el problema planteado mediante tres combinaciones de datos diferentes. Una vez que entras en un mundo, jugarás con la misma combinación de datos hasta que alcances la solución con esa combinación… en caso de que desees cambiar de combinación, puedes pulsar el botón correspondiente a la “recarga de escena” y comenzarás a jugar con una combinación nueva. Finalmente, para destruir estrellas necesitas manzanas; si se te acaban deberás conseguir más manzanas respondiendo preguntas STEM, buscando combinaciones STEAM (incluyendo las humanidades y ciencias sociales) o jugando a juegos clásicos.
row.short_description: A lo largo de este juego acompañarás a Galilei a través de ocho mundos para ayudarle a resolver ocho cuestiones relacionadas con el ámbito STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering y Mathematics).

row.name: Xi-Portal
row.detailed_description: Unravel the Mystery of Xi-Portal Xi-Portal is a horror game where the player transfers to a new school and tries to make friends. And then things unexpectedly take a dark turn as the player has to uncover hidden secrets and face terrifying consequences.  The game features multiple storylines and choices, making each playthrough unique. The player must navigate intricate puzzles and solve riddles to uncover the truth behind the enigmatic Xi-Portal, adding an extra layer of suspense and fear.  In addition, the player must understand that every decision has no return.  Genre: Visual novel, Horror Platform: Windows, Android. Engine:  Ren'Py Languages: English, Arabic 61,000+ words Nameable MC Five characters are available. Maybe? Map feature: You can go anywhere you want. Reading time: 4 hours and 8 minutes Estimated gameplay time: +8 hours for new players Challenging puzzles 11 different endings (4 true endings  | 1 good ending | 1 normal ending | 3 bad endings  | 2 worst endings ) Point of no return game. WARNING:  This game contains flashing lights, scary images, loud sounds, and jumpscares; it's not recommended for people who suffer from any kind of phobia. (Especially those who have a weak heart.) You can contact the developer via the email:   kakamigu@gmail.com .
