row.name: Cardian
row.detailed_description: NOTE: This is an early prototype that was released to the public. Please consider this as you play. CARDIAN is a fast-paced micro dungeon crawler, set in a colorful tabletop world of adventuring animals. FEATURES A card-combining battle system inspired by the old-school ATB (Active Time Battle) JRPG combat and physical card games such as Star Realms. Three varied regions to master, each with their own enemies, cards and trinkets to find! Beautiful card artwork filled with colorful animals. Pocket-sized adventure with a playtime of around 2 hours.
row.short_description: CARDIAN is the prototype of a fast-paced micro dungeon crawler, set in a colorful tabletop world of adventuring animals.

row.name: Cyra and the Beacon Path Playtest
Phantom Watcher
row.detailed_description: Experience Realistic Immersion Delve into a realm of lifelike visuals and sounds with a clean user interface, guaranteeing an immersive experience that will keep you entertained. Encounter Distinctive Spirits Discover 10 distinct types of ghosts, each with unique characteristics, personalities, and capabilities, ensuring every investigation presents a fresh challenge. Manage Your Power Managing and overseeing the power distribution within the building is pivotal for survival. Operate the fuse box to control the power supply, which only sustains one room at a time. Maintain Your Sanity Prolonged exposure to darkness and encounters with the supernatural can overwhelm your sanity. Witnessing or hearing eerie phenomena can drive you to the brink of madness. A significant loss of sanity may prove fatal. Journey into the Haunted Depths Embark on a journey through the haunted St. Valentine's location, filled with unique twists, secret hiding spots, and intricate layouts. Modes for Every Player With four challenging difficulty levels and assorted trials, there are plenty of ways to test your skills, each mode offering distinctive rewards. Unearth the Archives Progress through the game to unlock historical archives, unravel the tales of lore, and delve into the mysteries of the past. Become the Phantom Watcher Every ghost you conquer is a step forward. The experience points you earn allow you to progress through various ranks, each more prestigious than the last. Your journey culminates in the ultimate achievement: the esteemed rank of “Phantom Watcher.'
row.short_description: Phantom Watcher is a chilling horror-strategy game. Survive the haunted hospital’s mysteries, navigating ghostly behaviors in a unique CRT aesthetic. Each playthrough is a new eerie challenge. Dare to uncover the secrets?
row.notes: The Ghost model in the game is very detailed with it's skull falling out from the head. Minimal blood on the character but bone exposure is present.

row.name: Mr Snuggles Dungeon Adventure
row.detailed_description: A quirky take on a roguelike dungeon crawler, Mr Snuggles the teddy bear is trapped in an outlandish dungeon and needs to escape using whatever he can find along the way. Slightly humorous, quite strange and hopefully a lot of fun, Mr Snuggles Dungeon Adventure is a challenging roguelike game with RPG elements and unique gameplay. NEED HELP? The game is difficult in the beginning & might be confusing so here are some hints... Collect scrap by destroying crates Hit switches & collect purple crystals though beware as some switches are traps Find a teleporter once you have a purple crystal & teleport to camp At camp unlock the storeroom - top left building / Use XP at the book to unlock more items that will drop from crates Once the storeroom is unlocked any items you put into chests will be automatically stored if you complete the current level If you die anything in the storeroom will be saved Collect as much as you can & in the beginning of the game scrap it in the inventory menu to allow you to use the weapon stand Use the weapon stand in camp to get a random weapon each run, some weapons are better than others Unlock teleporter crystals, full health potions & drill (makes destroying crates easier) in the book first & stockpile in storeroom Remember the quick slots are keys 1234 & the up/down/left/right arrows on gamepad FEATURES 100+ Items to unlock with ability stacking 15+ Weapons - All upgradeable 9 Bosses each with a unique item Craft Scrolls & Potions Player stats to upgrade Collected items can be stored for next run with persistent storeroom Collected items can transported to storeroom via chests in level Procedural (random) dungeons means every play is different Permadeath - no character save, only items in the store room are saved
row.short_description: A teddy bear alone in a dungeon, his only hope for escape is... kitchen implements? A zany roguelike adventure with 100+ unique items, 9 bosses, 15+ weapons with upgrades, potion and scroll crafting and random dungeons. Explore, fight collect loot and use pineapples to help Mr Snuggles escape.

row.name: Stellar Larceny
row.detailed_description: Embark on a cosmic heist in this zero-gravity adventure! Maneuver the galaxy as a sentient robot armed with a magnet, jetpack, and gravity boots. Your mission? Infiltrate facilities, find parts, and return life to your friend - while running from a mysterious company intent on shutting you down. Stellar Larceny is a zero-gravity puzzle-platformer where players take the role of Enness, a sentient robot under the control of the mysterious GAUSS Systems. After an unknown program frees them from GAUSS' influence, they must escape the facility and help save their friend from the brink of deactivation. Six Degrees of Freedom In these zero-gravity environments, you must use all of the movement tools available to you to deftly navigate through each facility's security systems. Use your grappling hook to cross distances quickly, your gravity boots to walk on walls and ceilings, and your jetpack to make smaller rotations and adjustments. Puzzle-Solving Use gears strewn about the facility to power on doors and deactivate traps, but take care! You might have to get creative to power on the devices in the right sequence.
row.short_description: Embark on a cosmic heist in this zero-gravity adventure! Maneuver the galaxy as a sentient robot armed with a magnet, jetpack, and gravity boots. Your mission? Infiltrate facilities, find parts, and return life to your friend - while running from a mysterious company intent on shutting you down.

row.name: SDIES
row.detailed_description: SDIES is an interactive animation that explores the duality of black-and-white thinking and contrasting emotional extremes. This visual metaphor, and the evolving gameplay which embodies themes of self-transformation and finding balance, offers a short yet impactful journey in a visually, aurally, and emotionally polarized world. Tactile point & click gameplay Monochromatic animation art style Adaptive jazz music This experience is designed to empower players to overcome mental health issues and trauma which often push people to emotional extremes. How much of our experience delving into frighteningly dark and destructively joyful places is guided by outside forces? What happens if, instead of submitting to a hostile environment which consumes and changes us, we enact the change we want to see within ourselves?
row.short_description: Explore a surreal world full of contrasts: black and white, friends and enemies, serenity and agitation. When the time comes, what we resist will persist, what we accept will transform, and through self transformation, we will discover the spectrum in between.

row.name: Steel Century Groove: Midnight
row.detailed_description: Thousands of years ago, humanity built colossal war machines to stop the apocalypse. Now they just use them for dance battles.  Groove your way across a neon city of perpetual night, build an online following, and discover the secrets hidden in an abandoned arcade. This is a free standalone story set in the world of Steel Century Groove , and can be enjoyed entirely on its own. It features exclusive content not found in the full game: unique levels, new characters, and a fully separate narrative. Additional Features: Collect and upgrade: Level up your mechs, equip them with mods, and pair them with backup dancers. Unique gameplay kits:  Each mech has their own set of abilities, mechanics, and resources. A simple starter mech builds and spends energy, while later mechs have you maintaining an army of drones or swapping between cards in a mini deck builder. Flexible rhythm combat:  Steel Century Groove: Midnight doesn't demand a specific button press for each note. Instead, pick from your mech's kit of battle abilities. No playing the metronome: Challenge yourself against interesting melodies, even when playing with your own music. You’ll never just be endlessly tapping out the beat. No accessories required: Built from the start for gamepad or mouse & keyboard.
row.short_description: Pilot mecha in rhythm-RPG dance battles in this free standalone adventure from the world of Steel Century Groove. Assemble a squad of colossal dancers and groove your way through a neon city where it's always night.

row.name: Shepherds
row.detailed_description: Here are some debug tools in case you encounter an undesirable situation: R + = : Restart the current Level R + 'numbers': Jump the a different sequence within the current level Shepherds is a 3D co-op action-adventure game that blends musical puzzle-solving gameplay. Players control the shepherd girl Zoe and the magical wolf Kin, cleverly using their individual mastery of musical melodies and unique movement styles to solve puzzles across various adventure levels. Ultimately, they will delve into a shepherd's temple at the heart of an active volcano to find a way to prevent the vengeful spirit, Black Dragon, from laying their island to waste. Interested in teaming up with family and friends for a cooperative adventure and experiencing the thrill of puzzle-solving in a game world? Join 'Song of the Shepherds' and enjoy the fun of human-animal teamwork! Tower of the Dragon The Black Dragon awakens, and the volcano erupts. By a twist of fate, shepherd Zoe and the magical wolf Kin find themselves in the ancient shepherd's temple where the Black Dragon is sealed. Despite their natural enmity, they must collaborate to venture deep into the heart of the volcano to the Tower of the Dragon, find a way to save their island, and make their escape. Spirit of Sound Within the ancient shepherd's temple, many mythical creatures dwell. Some assist Zoe and Kin on their journey, while others cunningly obstruct their path. Observing these creatures' traits and cleverly using their own abilities, players will experience an adventure of musical puzzle-solving and platform jumping. Song of the Shepherds In the temple, shepherd Zoe inherits the legacy of ancient musical magic, and the magical wolf Kin awakens the power of frost. Combining their abilities, they perform the Songs of the Shepherds, rescuing trapped music spirits, purifying the ancient shepherd's temple, and ultimately unveiling the sealed truths. Shepherds is a thesis project from the University of Southern California, developed collaboratively by Haoyun and the Team Sheep. USC Games has been known for its professionalism, diversity, and strong student teams, having produced several outstanding games. 'Shepherds' aims to be among these successful projects. Both USC Games and Shepherds share a passionate commitment to creating innovative gaming products and continuing to enrich the gaming industry. Join us for a new experience in the gaming world!
row.short_description: Shepherds is a 3D, two-player co-op musical adventure game in which players control unlikely partners - a shepherd girl named Zoe and a magic wolf named Kin. Players must cleverly combining their unique mastery of musical melodies and distinctive movement styles to solve puzzles.

row.name: Thunder Age
row.detailed_description: Thunder Age is a post-apocalyptic, science-based tower defense game that empowers players to dictate enemy paths. Harness electricity to fortify defenses and fend off adversaries. The campaign mode provides five scenarios with increasing difficulty. To beat them all, you must think fast and evolve your strategy according to the scenario specific new features, such as available building types and layout of the map. In the custom game mode, you can unwind at your own pace or seek a greater challenge in survival mode. The game boasts a unique art style within the genre, imbuing a captivating atmosphere complemented by a powerful soundtrack.
row.short_description: In the flooded future world, mankind has built floating islands where electricity is harnessed during the raging thunderstorms. This unstable energy is crucial for survival, but also poses the greatest risk in this Tower Defense game.

row.name: Monstro Maestro
row.detailed_description: Set your own pace : Play as Maestro, a conductor and his traveling troupe who must perform in a mysterious mansion. Explore these places filled with melodious rhythms in search of your musicians who have been captured by the mansion's owner, MONSTRO. Prepare to battle various ghostly monsters that inhabit these grounds and unravel the curse that hangs over this mansion. Monstro Maestro is a 2D action-adventure game inspired by the Megaman X franchise, the rhythmic mechanics of BPM, and platform/adventure games such as Celeste and Hollow Knight. Game features : Discover a mansion populated by monsters, passing through its gardens and exploring its various rooms. Explore diverse biomes, each with unique movement abilities and powers. Face off against the five enemies that live in these places. Flying, jumping, or stationary, you will have to choose the best method to eliminate them. Defeat 5 formidable bosses! Face off against the disciples and the master of the domain in unique battles where the fate of your musicians hangs in the balance. Take on the Kaiso board challenge! After collecting all the bells in the mansion, put your movement and navigation skills to the test in a whole new gaming experience. Enjoy a unique musical experience thanks to the different types of music that emanate from the location and gameplay. Original soundtrack composed specifically for the game. Fight using your wand by casting various powerful projectiles that can be imbued with the rhythm of the surroundings. Background : Monstro Maestro is a project created by second-year Game Development students. The main development of the game took place over a period of nine weeks, during which a team of 12 programming students and 11 graphic design students designed and produced the entire game. It was presented as a second-year final project in June 2025. Following this presentation, a proposal to publish on the Blacknut platform was made by its CEO. Part of the team continued development during the summer of 2025, making adjustments, fixes, and adding new content with an entire new biome. The final phase of production was completed in December 2025. On the technical side, Monstro Maestro uses a custom engine developed by programming students during the year. This game engine, called T.E.DD (Technical Engine 2D), is based on SFML, ImGui, SDL3, and C++. It is based on an Entity-Component model. This engine was developed over a period of three months.
row.short_description: Play as a conductor trapped in a haunted and crazy mansion! As a concert begins, a jealous ghost appears and takes possession of your orchestra. To free them, you must explore every corner of the mansion, complete musical challenges, and rebuild your troupe.

row.name: The Littlest Fry
row.detailed_description: Description Littlest Fry is a 2D casual, adventure game. You will play as a small fish and your job is to protect a small baby fish from various dangers . You will be swimming around in bright and colorful Finnish ponds and using various methods to pass hazards and move between ponds. Features You will be using nets to trap enemies, hideouts to conceal your presence and caves to pass predators. You will be expertly swimming around polluted patches of water to avoid an untimely doom. You will be leaping out of water to jump to another pond.
row.short_description: You are a small goldfish who has to protect a youngling while discovering how unforgiving the ponds in the wilderness are. Your objective is to defend a baby fish from predators while out maneuvering them while evading other obstacles that may be in your way while searching for safer waters.

row.name: HANEHOLO!
row.detailed_description: Overview A jump-action game where you control Hololive members and aim for the goal! All platform objects are based on Hololive members’ episodes — over 250 in total! Use the gliding action with mascot balloons skillfully to reach the goal! Includes a massive main stage and short stages for each generation. Updates will continually add new stages and objects based on the latest episodes. The free version lets you play through the entire long main stage including the story! ※ To unlock the features restricted in the free version, you need to purchase the “Standard Edition Upgrade DLC.” The options available in the free version are as follows. Selectable Holomem: Pekora Usada, Moona Hoshinova, Shion Murasaki Selectable mascot balloons: Nousagi, Moonabito, Shiokko Selectable stage: Main Stage Selectable difficulty: Normal ※ The 3D models of Holomen are official models used with permission. In the Standard Edition Upgrade DLC, you can select a total of 35 player characters, mainly JP talents. For other details and added features, please refer to the “Standard Edition Upgrade DLC.” Main Stage Story The Usada Construction duo — Pekora Usada and Moona Hoshinova — had planned an off-collaboration. When Moona was taking too long to arrive, a flustered Pekora decided to go all the way to the moon to fetch her!? Climb the under-construction New Pekora Tower , serving as an orbital elevator, to reach the moon! Hurry, Peko-chan! Go pick up Moona before the stream starts! The rabbit can only leap toward the moon! Collect “Memories” By obtaining items, you can unlock the gallery and learn the stories behind the platform objects. By the time you’ve climbed to the top, you’ll be a Hololive expert! Make the Most of   Mascot Balloons By obtaining mascot balloons placed throughout the stage, you’ll be able to use the gliding action. Gliding can be used both for progression and to prevent falling, but the number of balloons is limited — timing is everything! Ranking Compete with players around the world for the fastest clear time! There are countless route combinations — find the one that works best for you! This game is published under CCMC Corp(※1)'s Indie game brand 'holo Indie'.(※2) This game is allowed to be monetized under the examination and terms of 'holo Indie'. Please note that any monetized derivative work games that include Cover Corp.'s content outside of holo Indie is not covered by these terms and is not allowed. ※1. About CCMC Corp. CCMC Corp. is entrusted with website management (ex: Steam) including, examination, publishing and other necessary tasks by Cover Corp. ※2. About 'holo Indie' holo Indie's objective is to cooperate with hololive production fans and creators. It is a game brand that offers 'Game Creator Support Program' for the derivative work games. For more details about 'holo Indie', Please refer to the Cover Corp.'s 'Derivative work guidelines'.
row.short_description: A jump-action game where you control Hololive members and aim for the goal!! With simple controls, just keep climbing higher and higher! Play the entire story for free in the free version!

row.name: It Takes Many
row.detailed_description: Play online with up to 7 players and help Claudio, the protagonist of the story, to find the love of his life. Solve increasingly difficult tasks together with your fellow players. The more players you have, the more difficult the game becomes. You can't die in this game, but if you jump in the wrong place at the wrong time, the group leader has to restart the level and there are only a limited number of restarts. When all the restarts have been used up, you have to start all over again. It all starts quite simply, but becomes increasingly difficult over time. You can't complete the game on your own: You need a good team, communication and coordination to make it. Movement in the game is relatively simple: WASD and Space, but timing is key. The game is a bit like an escape room. You and your team have to find out what you have to do in each level and each level has new tasks. Once everyone knows what they have to do, it becomes relatively easy, then it's all about timing and skill. There are currently 2 starter worlds, after which players can decide which main world they want to enter. There are 4 main worlds and 1 secret world for those who seek a special challenge. The main world is also the end world. Each end world has a different ending, each end world has different mechanics and tasks to solve. The tasks vary in difficulty, but are all relatively simple once you know what you have to do. The big difficulty is that nobody can make a major mistake, otherwise you have to restart the level, and as soon as all the restarts have been used up, you have lost. The game is aimed more at hardcore players who are looking for a special challenge and are underchallenged with conventional 2D sidescrollers. The difficulty is not in the difficult jumps that have to be made in a short time, but in the fact that if one of the existing players makes a mistake, you lose a restart.
row.short_description: You've got a Tindermatch! Sadly she lives very far away so you decide to fly to her and take your friends with you! Plays like Super Mario, but you only have a limited amount of restarts. Play with up to 7 people. Reach the End to win the game

row.name: Prologue: Fish idle 2
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME About the Game Prologue: Fish idle 2 is a free introduction version to Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery! Crush in your rainboots and hop into your boat! We are going fishing in Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery, a unique idle fishing arcade featuring smooth graphics and intuitive mechanics. We have no time to swing a fishing rod, so let’s streamline the process! SIMPLE AND EASY FISHING Let’s start with the basics. It’s all about automation: fish start biting as soon as you approach them, and resource indicators keep you informed while you focus on managing your Fish Kingdom effectively. The game offers advantageous upgrades to enhance your idle fishing abilities, helping you become a true fish tycoon. You’ll still need to steer your boat to chase fish schools and avoid obstacles, so don’t get too distracted by your economic prowess! UPGRADE YOUR FISH KINGDOM Once your hull is full, it’s time to get upgraded! Improvements in fishing speed let you catch more and rarer species, while increased storage capacity allows you to hold more catches in your boat. Boost your boat’s speed and defense for impact protection, and enhance your fishing rods to cast multiple lines at once. It’s all about maximizing your gains in the most efficient way, so you’ll have to use your head to figure out the best way to success! MAKE IT BIG Just like in real life, becoming a fish tycoon involves various ways to profit from your catches. The Idle Fish Farm allows you to invest and get passive income, while the Black Market lets you upgrade your Fish Kingdoms beyond OSHA standards. The Bots Shop enables you to hire hunter, fisher, and cargo ships to fish and deliver catch for you, boosting your income. If day trading is your thing, there is a Currency Exchange that has some special benefits. Tax fraud is not a crime, it’s an obligation if you want to make it big. NOW GO FISH Get ready to dive into the Fish Kingdoms and become the ultimate fish tycoon in Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery!
row.short_description: Dive into the most fun idle fishing arcade game! Manage your Fish Kingdoms with automated fishing, upgrade your boat and gear, invest in passive income, and outsmart the market. Become the ultimate fish tycoon!

row.name: The Ethernal Spiral
row.detailed_description: The Eternal Spiral features challenging combat reminiscent of the Dark Souls series, emphasizing precise timing and strategic decision-making . Players must survive three intense waves of enemies, each culminating in a unique and formidable miniboss. Upon victory, the player progresses to the next level and gains a minor buff for the time being. The game’s innovative time loop mechanic ensures that each reset brings both familiarity and new challenges. The player retains the skills and experiences gained from previous cycles, allowing players to adapt their playstyle and unlock new abilities. However, The Big Boss becomes increasingly cunning, introducing unpredictable elements to each encounter.
row.short_description: The Eternal Spiral is an immersive fantasy action RPG that blends intense combat, with an interesting time loop mechanic that ensures that every time playing feels unique.

row.name: Breaking Time
row.detailed_description: Breaking Time Breaking Time is a singleplayer first-person speedrun platformer game where the player's goal is to complete the game level in record time, progressing through a world that itself is fractured in time. In Breaking Time, you race against the clock. Run, jump, grapple, or glide above the clouds atop structures to conquer time. But beware—a fall from great heights can indeed be a long one.
row.short_description: Breaking Time is a singleplayer first-person speedrun platformer game where the player's goal is to complete the game level in record time, progressing through a world that itself is fractured in time.
developers: Jani Ylimartimo, Severi Havin, Toni Viikki

row.name: Miniparty
row.detailed_description: Play single player or against up to 4 friends in various Minigames . You can design your own character and play in Party Mode or just a single Minigame. 1-4 Players LAN or couch co-op party mode NO in-game purchases, free to play personalized character controller support Game Modes Football Car race Tennis Sprint Parkour Collect-it Tower Defense
row.short_description: Play against your friends in a group up to 4 Players or as a single player to beat your highscore. Either in a LAN Party or alocal in couch co-op mode. GAMES: Football, Car race, Tennis, Sprint, Parkour, Collect-it, Tower Defense

row.name: Welcome to Dustown
row.detailed_description: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Don't die Game features : 2-4 player co-op Local voice chat [In-game camera Scary enemies Hours of fun
row.short_description: Welcome to Dustown is a single-player or cooperative horror game for up to 4 players. Play as field scientists exploring vast labyrinthine cornfields, collecting samples and evidence for a mysterious corporation. Make sure you don't get killed at the crossroads.
row.reviews: “The corn field oompa loompas were unhinged” 7.5 – TheBigBois

row.name: KEABE free
row.detailed_description: KEABE: Kill ’Em All - Bunny Edition is TPS, PvP, Online Multiplayer, and Single Player game with cute stuffed animal characters and Big Guns. KEABE – Backstory Summary KEABE is a candy-colored battleground suspended in deep space—a cluster of ancient alien arenas built from Earth’s fractured memories. Pyramids, Aztec temples, WW1 trenches, neon towers, and spaceports collide in a surreal mix of history, myth, and simulation. Created by a vanished alien race known as the Enchiladas , the arenas were once elite training grounds, populated by obedient bots and toy-like animal combatants. The bots still serve. The toys evolved. Now, five sentient plush warriors remain: a cat , a techno-cat , a mouse , a unicorn , and a bunny . They clash in three rounds of heavy machine gun fire, thunderous explosions, and bubble- and glitter-filled combat. In the final minute, the forcefields drop around the neon pyramid— King of the Hill decides everything. General Info: This is KEABE Free —a free-to-play game, version0.61D that includes the first two stages from the full game, which will be launched later. Some of the screenshots are from the full version. KEABE is an arena shooter set in a psychedelic, colorful cyberpunk world with glitching hologram surfaces and a strong dose of Red Matrix. The single-player mode with bots offers a good practice ground. You can also connect with friends or other players online via Photon. The easiest way to play with friends is by using social media to share and join rooms together. In online multiplayer, any empty player slots are automatically filled with bots. The maximum room capacity is currently 12 players. The gameplay is fast-paced and vertical, with multiple floors, jump- and warp platforms, secret pathways, hidden rooms, and lots of firepower and explosions. You can mine the map with proximity mines, take down opponents with high-powered machine guns, or fry them with a flamethrower. Prefer sniping? Settle into a good spot with a sniper rifle and wait for the perfect shot—one clean hit is all it takes. If mines are your thing, place them near item spawns or spawn points for easy remote kills, while you cause chaos with the “catling gun” and its 200-round belt—more than enough to dominate the scoreboard. Or throw in a   few sticks of dynamite— t hat’s   fun. The winner is the player with the most kills at the end of each round. In the final minute of the third round, the King of the Hill zone activates on the top floor. Game soundtrack varies from Heavy metal to Dark ambient to Retro Disco and more. Happy trails!
row.short_description: TPS, PVP, Online Multiplayer and Single Player with cute stuffed animal characters and Big Guns. Colorful cyberpunk map with hologram surfaces and Red Matrix.

row.name: THE GAP
row.detailed_description: Experience the highs and lows that come with endlessly trying to cross The Gap Mind-bending Features: Perceive The Gap Gaze at The Gap Walk around Watch the other side talk without you Be transformed by The Gap Blame The Gap for all your misfortunes Wave Bathe in the misery of The Gap Thoroughly enjoy the frustration that comes with feeling stuck on either side of The Gap Become contempt with the concept of Gap Shout Constantly question your place within The Gap Do a Flip! Try to find a way out of The Gap
row.short_description: An abstract interactive experience about a Gap

row.name: Day of Atonement
row.detailed_description: This is a first person puzzle, in which the player must use a Composition Notebook in game, that will give clues of how to navigate though the games quests. If player fails to complete each quest in order, the player will have to restart from the beginning.
row.short_description: This game is a puzzle based on the Day of Atonement. The player is the High Priest and must complete all the duties for the Day of Atonement.

row.name: HFH
row.detailed_description: Jump, dodge and flap yourself out of danger. See what distance your penguin can reach while dodging various objects as well as sharks, birds and UFOs! The aim of the game is to see what distance you can reach in metres. This requires jumping platforms and dodging obstacles and enemies such as trees, snowmen, birds, sharks etc. Collecting fish allows you to flap while airborne to facilitate dodging. Hitting an obstacle or enemy, falling into the shark infested water or getting abducted by an UFO means game over. The game is a randomly procedurally generated infinite runner so never repeats platform, obstacle/enemy positions or movement. More features coming soon.
row.short_description: Jump, dodge and flap yourself out of danger. See what distance your penguin can reach while dodging various objects as well as sharks, birds and UFOs!

row.name: Project Juggler
row.detailed_description: Project Juggler is a goofy, action-packed combination of first-person-shooter and task management game. Battling to save blockout city from enemy incursion, the player must coordinate action-packed combat with the complex controls of their mech. Players alternate between shooter combat and task minigames, trying to juggle the needs of the mech with the onslaught of evil robots. Fight off hordes of enemies in action-packed FPS combat! Repair the mech from within, putting out fires and maintaining your weapons!
row.short_description: FPS/Task Management Action Game

row.name: Five Nights at Roner's 2
row.detailed_description: Tyrone Watermelon is dead. Killed by his own hubris. You are to take his place. In this absolutely RIVETING sequel to Five Nights at Roner's, you are tasked once again with ensuring the safety of the haunted house you are assigned to. Manage your power, ensure safe function of components, upgrade your systems, and make it out alive. Repeat 5 times, and the paycheck is yours. But, of course, there's a catch... Monitor the ghosts and maintain your systems with your handy dandy GooberOS security system! With only one flimsy wooden door, you'll have to make do. You're lucky there's a bed to hide under... The clock is your greatest friend, and worst enemy. Hold out as long as you can, and hope the time expires before you do... Can you survive, for the second time... FIVE NIGHTS AT RONER'S?
row.short_description: Searching for fast money, you stumble upon an ad for a paranormal investigation. Upgrade your office, maintain your systems, and above all else: don't let them get to you. It's easy work, right...?
row.notes: Mentions of hard drug/alcohol use. Player can consume alcoholic beverages.

row.name: Red Ruins: Asymmetric VR vs. PC
row.detailed_description: Red Ruins is a student-developed asymmetric VR game that pits one player as the Demon Lord in virtual reality against at least one Hero on PC Choose your side: Will you be the Demon Lord in VR, armed with the powerful GunBlade and SkullShield, or will you join forces as the courageous Guardian, Witch, or Wizard on PC? VR GAMEPLAY: As the Demon Lord, grab the GunBlade to shoot the Heroes. Pick up the SkullShield to block fireballs from the heroes, or dodge the fireballs by moving in real life. Wipe out all the heroes to claim victory! PC GAMEPLAY: Choose your character class from these options: Guardian, Witch, or Wizard. Attack the Demon Lord with magical weapons. Plan your team strategy, collect health items to heal, and work together to defeat the Demon Lord for victory! FEATURES: 1 VR player vs. 1-3 PC players online multiplayer VR player shares lobby join code with PC players PC players input join code to join VR lobby
row.short_description: Red Ruins is an asymmetric VR game created by students, where one player becomes a Demon Lord in VR, facing off against Heroes on PC. With powerful weapons and strategic gameplay, players must either vanquish their foes or join forces to conquer the Red Ruins together.

row.name: Above
row.detailed_description: Above is a product of a collaboration between 16 students coming together to create an engaging and challenging action climbing adventure. The team developed Above at the National Film School of Denmark in winter 2023, and we are very happy to share the experience with you, the player - thank you so much for playing! - The team at Dreamful Projects THE ONLY WAY IS UP ABOVE is a challenging climbing game that pits the player against harsh vertical terrain as they ascend an enormous tower and explore a mysterious world. EXPLORE A BEAUTIFUL, MYSTERIOUS WORLD Explore breathtaking vistas and take in the uniquely crafted artstyle as you ascend the tower - All rendered seamlessly with dynamic loading. DON'T LOOK DOWN Overcome the challenges of the mountains and peaks as you fling yourself to the top - Conquer more than 10 levels and unlock timed mode to race against your own time! Enjoy tight and responsive gameplay with climbing that feels unique and offer precise controls - Climb on magical grips that appear slowly, grab on to moving platforms, and watch out for fragile rocks that will require you to go fast or fall!
row.short_description: ABOVE is a challenging climbing game set in a mysterious world. Reach, jump and grab on to rocks and moving objects as you pave your way through the vertical terrain. Experience a mysterious and intriguing world with gameplay that will challenge both your skills and endurance.

row.name: Krypta FM
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the first game by Under The Sink - KryptaFM! We're very honored to greet you all in front of your devices. We'll begin with a message after which you'll be met with plenty of useful tips, in case you'd like to start your adventure. We're going to move to Gozdary, a small village in Poland. The residents have noticed a lot of weird, paranormal things going on. The areas have been haunted by an alleged cryptid from Gozdary, who leaves tracks that are leading us to solving this puzzle. Listen to the broadcasts - valuable intel might be hidden within the messages! We'd love to invite you on our studio's social media platforms where you can share your experiences with KryptaFM! Happy hunting! . Gameplay contains: Nostalgic climate of a Polish village from early 2000s Nod to early-internet webforum era Full voiceacting of radio broadcasts! ...and much more to discover!
row.short_description: Can you solve the mystery of the Beast of Gozdary?

row.name: 就労！！わんわんヒューマン
row.detailed_description: Work! Wan Wan Human is an [ADV Novel Game of Human Gachi-Inukenka] that educates sinners and turns them into adorable dogs. Become a correctional officer in a city of chaos where humans, demons, and angels are all mixed together and get the job done. Your unique colleagues and sinners are waiting to meet you. As of 2024, only Japanese is supported. The earth has been transformed into a new world populated by angels and demons! You, the player, will work for a big white company called “Angel Enterprises” where angels gather. Work! Educate the sinners and build a world where peace can last! Work! Like a dog! Your work Your job is to educate the sinners. Listen to the conversation over the course of four turns and decide if education is really necessary. Fun labor other than education It is your duty to help other colleagues. You are also responsible for helping other co-workers. The funny characters in this game are sure to make your work worthwhile. They will surely make your work worthwhile. You Correctional Officer at Angel Enterprises. Anata, the player, can select male/female and enter a name. Bercy Lovely colleague you can count on. You'll be numb to the lines that push sinners away. Sinners of Distinctive Character They may be electrocuted or educated as needed. Colleagues with a lot of personality No current flow. Elements included in this game. Violence Bloodshed Homosexuality - Depiction of suicide About the actual situation, etc. Please be sure to include the URL of the store page.
row.short_description: Work! Wan Wan Human is an [ADV Novel Game of Human Gachi-Inukenka] that educates sinners and turns them into adorable dogs. Become a correctional officer in a city of chaos where humans, demons, and angels are all mixed together and get the job done.
row.notes: depiction of suicide Descriptions that suggest sexual intercourse, although not directly Expressions of violence, murder, etc. Expressions suggesting cannibalism drinking An expression that transforms into another creature

row.name: Hero's Survival
row.detailed_description: About the Game Heroes Survival is a game that challenges players to become the strongest heroes. Collect diamonds through play to upgrade your hero and grow into a stronger hero. Play with skill and upgraded heroes to make your hero the strongest hero in the world! Function Manual aiming mode is recommended as the default, and there is an automatic aiming option. 14 heroes and skills (Red, Brian, others) 90 items to choose from (rainbow, cheetah, and more) Acquire diamonds to strengthen your heroes You must survive each wave for 20 to 60 seconds Represent your country and challenge your hero to become a top ranker.
row.short_description: Heroes Survival is a shooting roguelike game where you become a hero, grow and survive by hunting monsters. Become the strongest hero among players by creating various builds using various skills, weapons, and items!

row.name: DeafBlind
row.detailed_description: Sensory Deprivation DeafBlind is a really cool game that takes you to a place where you can't see or hear anything. It's like nothing else out there because it tries to show you what it's like to be both deaf and blind. It's all about diving deep into what it feels like to not have your usual senses. Tip: For the best experience, we recommend using headphones or earplugs along with a blindfold (Unless you already are deaf and/or blind) Gameplay When you play DeafBlind , the screen is just black, and it's totally quiet. Winning or losing isn't the point of the game; it's more about seeing what it's like to live in a world where you can't rely on your eyes or ears, just on touching and feeling stuff. Achievements The game has these cool achievements that you get as you make your way through the darkness. They're not just regular goals; they tell a story about everything you do in the game. This game is made for anyone who's up for trying something really different. It invites you to check out a world that's hidden and silent, pushing you to get used to it and find some kind of meaning when you can't immediately see or hear what's going on. DeafBlind wants you to just dive in and experience the deep quiet and the big darkness—find out what's waiting beyond what you can normally sense.
row.short_description: DeafBlind offers an immersive sensory deprivation experience, simulating what life might feel like if you were both deaf and blind. This game invites you to navigate a world shrouded in silence and darkness, challenging you to adapt and explore in entirely new ways.

row.name: SongBird: FlingAThing
row.detailed_description: YOU THERE, GULLIBLE CONSUMER!!! Do you like platforming, slushies, grappling hooks, and other things? Then join Biboby on his journey through the bowels of a convenience store to fix a malfunctioning cash register that won't scan milk. Use the incredibly unsafe and corporate-licensed Fling-a-Thing to traverse the cavernous backrooms of the store on your journey. Features: Fling yourself in any direction through deadly levels! Find secrets in the depths of the store! Compete for the fastest time with your friends! Die multiple times! Good luck you spunky young employee and we here at Songbird believe in you! (Warning: belief is not in the Songbird company budget)
row.short_description: A unique, stylish platformer based around flinging yourself as fast as possible in any direction. Venture deep into the 'Songbird Short Stop' to fix a cash register that won't scan milk in this exhilarating precision platformer.
row.notes: Suicide, corporate dread, and death on very pixelated characters.

row.name: Escape from the Cursed Convent Playtest
Memento Mori
row.detailed_description: A game made for the ones we lost on the way. Experience a surreal, linear walking simulator that explores the themes of death and grieving the passing of a loved one. Waking up in a unknown forest, you find yourself lost and looking for answers, will you find what the clarification you have been looking for or will you find more questions then answers. Dealing with grief and loss A thing that everyone is forced to deal with for as long as humankind came into being is loss and grief. So we wanted to make a game that wasn't just special to us but that can also be special to people struggling with the same issues. A show don't tell journey Memento Mori is a show, don't tell experience that can be enjoyed by anyone and everyone no matter what language they speak due to the lack of dialogue and text. WolfWare Studios WolfWare Studios is a independent game development duo who started making Memento Mori during the second quarter of 2022. Before the production of Memento Mori both Shea Kelly (Creative lead) and Alekzandar Voynikov (Technical lead) made video games for game jams and to produce a medium they have both loved for as long as they can remember.
row.short_description: A game for the ones we lost on the way. Memento Mori is a surreal walking simulator that combines a minimalistic art style and a show don't tell story, focused on dealing with loss.

row.name: Yume Gufi
row.detailed_description: A 'game' where you visit dream worlds to collect effects. You are free to explore them at your own leisure. Some effects have special interactions when you hold 'Z'. No specific goal or a storyline; simply wander about. Interact with certain characters to gain Effects. Using these 'Effects' can change Melissa's appearance, among other effects. Reusing an 'Effect' changes her back. Made in RPG Maker MV.
row.short_description: Explore dream worlds, and collect effects. No goals, just wander.

row.name: Blood Lust
row.detailed_description: In the 1700s, Jonhatan Sauvage, a powerful, megalomaniac lord, made a pact with the devil. This pact allows him to summon powerful creatures born of dangerous rumors running through his lands, but consuming his soul. With his people terrorized, he and his mercenaries come to their rescue, winning gold and glory in the process. Blood Lust is a student project created by a team of 17 students in their 2nd year at the Interactive Art and Design school from Montpellier. The purpose was to create a Brawl Stars-like game in around 3 months, inspired by “Highwaymen” in a stylized theme. 7 environmental / props artists, 3 chara designers and 7 game designers / level designers / gameplay programmer / sound designers / quality assurance. It was decided to speed up the game and add unique mechanics to each map. The game uses the steam network to allow players from all over the world to fight against each other. Play up to 6 characters with unique skills, 3 creatures and 3 mercenaries. Choose from 4 different maps with their variants in a total of 12 maps! Fight alone against your friends in a free-for-all mode and try to get more kills than them! You can also add bots to play up to 4 players! Team up and create 2vs2 or 1vs2 / 1vs3 games to show off your teams' skills. Take a break from the violence and try to hide and survive in Hide & Seek mode from the bloodthirsty Warabouc. Try out each character in training mode to test and understand their skills.
row.short_description: Fight against your friends in this multiplayer arena combat game and choose between different characters with occult skills.

row.name: 巧|合/co|incidence
row.detailed_description: Game Introduction: After the '3059 Electronic Plague' incident, in order to prevent the expansion of the impact of electronic plague, Animo sapiens and Homo sapiens collaborated to restrict and block the development of consciousness technology, resulting in a huge change in the world landscape. Century passed, there is a legend in the world that there exists an identity called 'shade' that can capture and detain special artificial intelligence residing in specific consciousness technology products to meet any needs. And the identity of the 'shaded' can also be given or plundered. As an ordinary Animo sapiens college student, Liu Qiao never believed in these strange rumors, but did not realize that he was embroiled embroiled in a dispute about the identity of 'shaded '. From this, the story of 'Co|incidence' began... Game features: ·'Co|Incidence' is a FVN produced for Renpy. ·Combine art forms related to liminal space   (includingweirdcore,dreamcore, traumacore, poolcore, back room, etc.) with science fiction worldview. ·The game has only one storyline and a fixed couple. Warning: ·This game contains thrilling, jump scare, weird and Same-Sex Relationships，sexual assault/non-consensual sex, BDSM, self-harm, etc. ·Based on Renpy's save mechanism, the trial version and save will be directly migrated to that Steam version, but please do not read those files, otherwise there may be bugs due to content deletion. ·Based on Renpy's dialogue mechanism, saving and reading files when there is a character head in the dialog box will cause a bug where the head will disappear and appear earlier, which cannot be solved temporarily. row.name: The Origin Theory - Episode One
row.detailed_description: Origin Theory Episode One is a lighthearted story driven survival horror experience. Game has its classic bad guy, zombies, guns and nasty stuff, but the emphasis is on unraveling the mystery and not grinding down hordes of enemies and surviving bullet soaking boss fights. Ethan is an oil rig engineer on a mission with his crew mates to respond to an SOS signal originating from an uninhabited volcanic island. They soon discover that the island is not without its residents and the mission takes a bad turn. Crash landed and separated from his crew, Ethan is taken deeper into the island complex. Now alone and armed with only his ability to use duct tape, Ethan finds himself in the middle of a darkening mystery. Trapped inside the complex, Ethan must use his wits to escape, explore the shadows, fight for survival, find out the fate of his crew mates and unravel the mystery surrounding the island. Unravel The Mystery Follow a narrative experience and uncover the dark secrets behind the events taking place in the Ren island through the logs of the ill-fated staff and captives. Collect Resources To Survive Collect resources found and hidden throughout the levels to buy upgrades to your arsenal. Upgrade weapons with parts scattered along the way.
row.short_description: Origin Theory Episode One is a lighthearted story driven survival horror experience. Game has its classic bad guy, zombies, guns and nasty stuff, but the emphasis is on unraveling the mystery and not grinding down hordes of enemies and surviving bullet soaking boss fights.
row.notes: Constant dismemberment of bodyparts of zombies usually including some gratifying blood-splatter effects as an added bonus.

row.name: Woohoo!
row.detailed_description: What Is Woohoo!? Woohoo! is a compilation of casual puzzle and arcade games. Woohoo! provides a great way to kill time while you wait for a download to finish or your gaming clan mates to sign on to play. Touchscreen Support Woohoo! also supports touchscreens! Therefore It'll come in handy when you're in the car on those long family road trip vacations. (Touchscreen-enabled laptop or tablet required.) Included Mini-Games The free base game includes three mini-games called 'Balldrop', 'Memory' and 'Transit'. More mini-games are available through paid DLC add-ons. NOTE: Some of the artwork contains content from the paid DLC mini-games. Balldrop The objective is to keep the ball on the board for as long as possible. There's a leaderboard containing everyone's best time. Memory 'Memory' is a mini-game where you get a grid of random tiles. Each tile has a random color and single digit number. The objective is to find the pairs of tiles. Once a pair is found, the selected pair of tiles will be removed from the grid. The game is over when all of the tiles are gone. Transit 'Transit' is a mini-game where you get a group of nodes and connections which links the nodes together. Each connection has a timetable of when that connection runs. The objective is to get from the starting node to the finish node before the target date and time. There are 30 levels. 3 difficulties and 10 levels per difficulty.
row.short_description: Woohoo! is a compilation of casual puzzle and arcade games.

row.name: Undo The Jam Damage
row.detailed_description: Story Bruce has been craving PB&J sandwiches, but alas, he's run out of jam! With determination, he sets off into the magical forest, seeking fresh fruits to craft his own delightful spread. 'Undo the Jam Damage' is a charming 2D pixel platformer where you guide Bruce through mystic woods filled with whimsical challenges. Help him dodge dangers, gather ingredients, and return home safely to enjoy his well-deserved lunch. Will Bruce manage to outsmart the tricks of the forest and replenish his pantry? Join the adventure and ensure his culinary quest doesn’t turn sour! How to play This is a short game. The game is desgined to be somewhat what hard. Navigate through each enchanting map, but be wary—the forest is full of illusions and hidden traps. Trust your senses as you tread lightly among deceptive shadows and snares laid by the forest’s mystical inhabitants. Controls: W: Jump A: Move Left D: Move Right Space: Shoot Designed with simplicity in mind, 'Undo the Jam Damage' is also fully compatible with controllers, offering a seamless gaming experience whether you prefer keyboard or gamepad. Embrace the challenge and master the mysteries of the forest to help Bruce on his jam-making journey! Notes From Developer 'Undo the Jam Damage' is a delightful 2D platformer created in Godot, marking my debut into the realm of game development. This game combines a mix of free, paid, and custom assets to bring the enchanting world of Bruce and his jam-making journey to life. My aim was to assemble this project swiftly to deepen my understanding of game development processes. This experience has been an invaluable step towards crafting more sophisticated games in the future.
row.short_description: Bruce's love for PB&J sandwiches has entangled him in a spellbinding predicament. Venture into the enchanted forest to help Bruce lift the witch’s curse. Tread carefully, though—the woods are fraught with dangers for the unprepared. The game is designed to be difficult

row.name: Stardrop
row.detailed_description: A peaceful asteroid is soaring through space when suddenly-- BOOM! A mysterious force smashes the asteroid and leaves its debris falling towards a nearby planet's surface! Out of the rubble jumps Gumdrop, who must now venture out and collect all the star pieces that burst out after the crash. Stardrop is a 3D platformer collectathon game where you play as Gumdrop: a strange, little creature whose goal is to collect all the star pieces that fell out of their asteroid after being smashed in orbit. Make your way through a whimsical world on a quest to collect every last drop! Every last... Star... drop... eh? get it? A Little Blob On A Little Mission Sweet, expressive movement! Run, jump, dash, spring, and leap through enemies and obstacles. Expansive, open world! Choose whichever direction you'd like! The world may even open up more the further you progress. Whimsical, colorful characters! Meet a multitude of new faces on your journey.
row.short_description: Gumdrop was peacefully sleeping in their asteroid when a mysterious force smashed it to pieces above the orbit of a nearby planet. Venture through a whimsical world to collect all the lost star droplets, slivers, and shards in this 3D platformer collectathon.

row.name: Burger
row.detailed_description: THE RELAX MODE OF THIS GAME (+free demo) 🍔🍔🍔 .. ALSO TRY THIS (yes, we can make true games): About the Game Burger is a cooking game where all you have to do is click to cook delicious burgers: the more the better! It's not pizza, it's hamburger! CLICK and COOK FEATURES Colorful and cartoon style graphics. Compatible with mouse and keyboard: click or use the space bar. Compatible with game controllers: press A or X. Save your progress in each stage and with each achievement. No sounds: enjoy the relaxing silence. Cozy atmosphere. Tons of achievements: 18 pieces in total. It will make you hungry. You can reset your progress to zero; just click the middle mouse button, press the Backspace key or the B button on the controller. WARNING It is not recommended to play if you are hungry .
row.short_description: 🍔 Burger is a clicker cooking game where you just click to make burgers — more and more burgers! Thinking about pizza 🍕 or eggs 🥚? Think again, because it's all about burgers! 🍔✨

row.name: The Depths of Avalon
row.detailed_description: The Depths of Avalon is a cooperative top-down dungeon crawler where players take on the roles of Arthur and Merlin to challenge the dark enchantress Morgan La Fey. This game encourages teamwork with two players using console controllers to navigate through puzzles and battles deep within the dungeons of Avalon. Set in the realm of Arthurian legends, the story brings together characters from these stories to create a narrative that blends myth with interactive gameplay. The game's art style features a low-poly design, giving it a unique visual flair that complements its fantasy setting. Developed over 14 weeks by a group of 16 talented second-year students at Butler Community College and published by Ad Astra Studios, a local non-profit, The Depths of Avalon showcases their hard work and creativity. The game is built using Unity 2022.3.16f1 and Blender 4.0. Grab a partner and prepare to explore the dungeon below Avalon, solving puzzles and fighting bosses along the way!
row.short_description: Join Arthur and Merlin in The Depths of Avalon, a cooperative top-down dungeon crawler where you solve puzzles and battle enemies to thwart the dark plans of Morgan La Fey.

row.name: Cats
row.detailed_description: Feature List About the Game What is this game about? Cats — and that says it all. Interactive cat clicker. Click on cats for new cats. That's all, really. Features: Clicking by Cats Meow Sound Music HQ Cats Low System Requirements Black & White artworks Colored Cats Take care of the Cats, give them a good click. It feels good! We guess so...
row.short_description: Cats — and that says it all. Interactive cat clicker. Click on cats for new cats. That's all, really.

row.name: Rusts Of Corruption
row.detailed_description: Join the Community! Do you want to connect? Are you interested in the game? Do you want updates on the development? Join the Official Discord Server by clicking on the link in the sidebar and become a part of our growing community! Check out the Demo! Interested in what the experience may entail? You can play the Demo RIGHT NOW!!! This is the original version of the game built for the Pirate Software Game Jam, and gives a rough idea of what the finished game will look like. About the Game Rusts Of Corruption is a game about life, death, purpose, and meaning. It is unique Point & Click Adventure game with a heavy focus on storytelling and character interactions. Speak to each robot, learn their stories. What influence will you have on them? Rusts Of Corruption takes place on a small island on an exoplanet named Charon. Unsure of exactly how you got there, the game simply allows you to explore the island, speak to the robots inhabiting it, and learn about the troubled history of the exoplanet. Throughout the game, you will be given the opportunity to explore the island in which the game takes place on, and you will be able to speak to characters in interactive dialog trees. As you progress through the world, it slowly becomes corrupted by some kind of eldritch entity, forcing you to explore within a limited amount of time before the island ‘dies’. Each robot has their own backstory, personality traits, and quirks. Some are blissfully ignorant, others are painfully aware of their coming doom, and others ponder on the meaning of life. I believe in making games that as many people as possible to enjoy, and for this reason the game will include a large amount of accessibility options so you are as comfortable playing the game as possible. Contrast adjustments (gamma) Reduce or remove background particles Change the game font to make it easier to read Change the colour of the text to make it easier to read Enable or disable text animations Turn off screen shake and glitch effects All Of This and More to Come!!! You can play the Demo RIGHT NOW!!! This is the original version of the game built for the Pirate Software Game Jam, and gives a rough idea of what the finished game will look like. Are you interested in the game? Do you want updates on the development? Join the Official Discord Server and become a part of our growing community! The link is in the sidebar! CONTENT WARNINGS Rusts of Corruption contains themes surrounding depression and suicide, including a scene where a suicide is depicted. This scene can be turned off in the games settings if desired.
row.short_description: You've mysteriously awoken on an isolated island on an unknown world. A corrupting force spreads through the island, leaving only a short amount of time to learn about the islands mysteries... Who will you meet? What will you learn? Are you ready to see the world die?
row.notes: Rusts of Corruption contains a particular scene depicting Suicide, which may be upsetting to some individuals. This scene can be disabled in the settings at any time.

row.name: Whisker President

President, the adorable cat in a suit. Whisker President is a comedic, point-and-click simulation that draws in inspiration from Papers, Please and other political sims. PURFORM LIKE A PURRFECT PRESIDENT Experience a chaotic management environment as you wrangle your cat to stamp all of the right bills at the right time. GAIN THE ABILITY TO MULTITASK Whisker President takes players on a fun adventure filled with campaigns, distractions, and lots of stamping. Mysteriously, the president became a cat in a suit and now you have to help the cat do what he needs to do without getting him caught and distracted from the job. Discover, experiment, and stamp as you survive through various days of the presidential campaign! UPLIFTING, COMEDIC, AND BALANCED Navigate the challenges of presidential life, from a dependent economy to scandalous distractions never seen before in the oval office.

Armed with only a laser pointer and some glue, help the purresident achieve political success by making him stamp the bills, all while ensuring that distractions don't get in the way.

My builder is intended to help people create their dream whether its quitting your job and starting a food truck or building a Boondocking sleeper van and committing to a van life, i have done it all. You can use the cost fields to enter in the cost of your part you are adding so you can have a rough idea on parts and materials. I can give you an estimate on building your unit if your interested. If not feel free to use the game to help you plan out your build and do it yourself!  I'm working on several new features that will assist in planning such as the fbx export and the layout screenshot with total cost. Undo & Redo System – Easily correct mistakes or experiment with different layouts.💰 Real-time Price Calculation – Track material costs as you build

row.name: Wild West: Prototype
row.detailed_description: This game is a prototype for a Multiplayer FPS set in a Wild West environment, designed for group play on LAN parties with up to six players. The primary appeal lies in the game's unique feature: the absence of fully automatic weapons. Choose your character and jump into the action as a cowboy! Armed with just a rifle, revolver, and a knife, you'll need your wits about you to survive—because it’s going to get wild! Enter the fray in a chaotic battle where every kill counts. Be the first to take down another player, and you’ll earn a bounty on your head. But don’t get too comfortable—the real fun begins when the timer starts ticking, and everyone’s out to track you down! Survival is key, but don’t take it too seriously! If you manage to stay alive, you’ll reap the rewards. If another player takes you down, they snag your bounty, and the cycle continues until one player remains standing long enough to claim victory. Gather your friends and see who can become the ultimate bounty hunter in this goofy, competitive Wild West experience!
row.short_description: A Wild West PvP shooter for LAN parties. Drunken bounty hunters battle it out in an abandoned forest village - no automatic weapons, just grit, guts, and old-school gunfights.
row.notes: The game features mature content such as nudity, alcohol consumption, and graphic violence, including decapitation.

row.name: OneKind
row.detailed_description: JOIN OUR DISCORD COMMUNITY About the Game OneKind His game is a hide-and-seek game involving a hunter, multiple cows and rabbits. Hunter Role He has to kill the bad animals on his farm with his axe and protect his own psychology. Meanwhile, he must also consider his axe-throwing rights and make sure to hit the demonic animals. Cow Role To blend in with the AIs on the map to avoid the hunter, manage hunger and thirst bars to survive, and be the last one standing by betraying the rabbit and making it bait for the hunter. It's time to show your kicks to the hunter. Rabbit Role Your aim is to mix with the AIs on the map, avoid the hunter, slow down the hunter, survive by controlling the hunger and thirst bars, and reveal the cow to the hunter in order to be the last one standing.Your footprints are so cute, but don't leave yourself thirsty!
row.short_description: Onekind is a 3-10 player social deduction game set on a farm. Among the peaceful animals, there are evil creatures hiding, causing chaos and messing with the hunter’s mind. Luckily, there’s a hunter, a former wizard, ready to hunt them down. Get ready for some fun!

row.name: Let's Learn X̱aad Kíl
row.detailed_description: Let's Learn X̱aad Kíl A Study Tool for the Alaskan Haida Language X̱aad Kíl is not a language of the past—it is a language that still belongs here , though history has tried to take it away. Within the last century, boarding schools, government policies, and systemic efforts to erase Indigenous languages nearly silenced Haida in Alaska. Speakers were punished. Generations grew up without access to their own language. Even today, those who seek to learn face an uphill battle—limited resources, lack of institutional support, and a world that too often treats Indigenous languages as unimportant. Let's Learn X̱aad Kíl is here to push back against that. This interactive study tool was created to support Haida learners in reclaiming their language. As part of my work with Central Council Tlingit and Haida , I knew that Tlingit was not the only language our tribal citizens needed a space to learn. Haida deserves just as much support, recognition, and opportunity to thrive. This tool is not a corporate project or an outsider’s attempt to document something for history—it is meant to be a living, breathing resource for those who want to learn, speak, and carry X̱aad Kíl forward. Features: Explore the Language – Walk through immersive spaces where Haida words are paired with everyday objects. Interactive Learning Games – Strengthen your skills with puzzles, memory challenges, and concept-matching exercises. Visual Dictionary – Connect words with images for easier recognition and retention. Real-Time Dictionary Search – Navigate the Haida language with an intuitive search tool designed for self-study. Call and Response Practice – Engage in simple conversations through interactive dialogue prompts. This is more than just a study tool—it is a way to support Haida learners in reconnecting with their language and making sure X̱aad Kíl continues to be spoken in Alaska.
row.short_description: Let's Learn X̱aad Kíl (Alaskan dialect) is an interactive self-study program designed to help those curious about Haida and to help them be as familiarized as possible. It includes games, activities, and a picture glossary.

row.name: Spectral Realm

Players need to play as an astronaut who has just landed on a different planet, install weapons on the spacecraft, resist incoming alien native creatures, and obtain the gemstones contained in their bodies to strengthen their equipment. Game updates Welcome everyone to watch the content of self media. row.name: Contingency Plan
row.detailed_description: In Contingency Plan, you and up to 3 crewmates will use immersive VR interactions to pilot, repair, and upgrade a highly capable combat frigate to complete contracts and make money. Use salvage and rewards during your journey to fund upgrades and purchases, skillfully pilot your ship to avoid enemy fire, use the physical-movement-based ship turret controls to shoot down enemies, and board enemy outposts with your crew to loot what you can find, solve puzzles, and take out any opposition! This is a final project developed by a small team of students in a short time. You may encounter bugs or unfinished gameplay. Regardless, we do still plan to support this game post-launch. Features: 4 player online multiplayer Immersive VR flight controls Multiple levels, linked by a unique warping mechanic Immersive environments filled with interactive elements Hectic gameplay requiring teamwork Physically controlled ship turrets Dock to enemy outposts to complete missions, eliminate enemies, and gather loot Ship upgrades Multiple on-foot and flying enemy types
row.short_description: Take control of a capable combat frigate with your friends in Contingency Plan, a VR multiplayer co-op sci-fi spaceflight game about taking contracts and making money.

row.name: Armadillo Assault
row.detailed_description: Armadillo Assault is the perfect game to play with friends and enjoy some casual, action-packed fun! Armadillo Assault re-creates that classic local multiplayer experience, online! Armadillo Assault was inspired by many diverse game experiences and has influences from old school local multiplayer games, classic retro platformers and family friendly fighter games. Armadillo Assault features support for online PvP multiplayer, with port forwarding enabled for the host player, with up to 8 players in a game lobby, with gameplay designed to be easy for everyone to play. Each match features a classic arsenal of weapons to be collected, as well as powerful and fun power-ups spawning throughout the map to keep things fresh and interesting. Armadillo Assault includes classic features of some of those great old school multiplayer experience like Death Match, King of the Hill and Capture the Flag!
row.short_description: Armadillo Assault is a multiplayer, action-platformer shooter, inspired by the glory days of couch multiplayer fun. Re-creating the magic of local multiplayer in an online environment, Armadillo Assault offers a unique experience for players looking to have action-packed group fun with friends!

row.name: Ruiga Pirates: Cursed Seas
row.detailed_description: PLAY FULL GAME About the Game Ruiga Pirates: Cursed Seas is a survival-themed adventure. Immerse yourself in hellish seas where pirates abound and sea creatures lurk at every turn. Engage in relentless battles, seizing all you can and leaving nothing behind. Collect gold on each journey to unlock upgrades, acquire new ships, and recruit skilled captains. Prepare yourself for the challenges of the seven seas! In the prologue of our game, players are plunged into a realm of high-seas piracy, where the ominous presence of ghosts casts a foreboding shadow. Amidst relentless struggles for survival, they must skillfully navigate perilous waters, confronting both earthly and otherworldly dangers. With heart-pounding action and gripping encounters, the prologue lays the foundation for an epic journey brimming with excitement and danger. Select your vessel and captain wisely in Ruiga Pirates: Cursed Seas. Tailor your enhancements to suit your style. Your decisions will determine your survival and combat prowess. Keep enemy ships at bay, evade fires, and beware of traps. Conquer challenges and uncover hidden treasures as you chart your course through perilous waters. Embark on various missions in Ruiga Pirates: Cursed Seas, from bombing islands to pursuing notorious pirates. Brace yourself for encounters with legendary creatures such as krakens, mermaids, and beyond. Get ready to delve into the depths of myth and mystery on the high seas!
row.short_description: Defeat legions of pirates and marine beasts to emerge victorious in Ruiga Pirates: Cursed Seas! Adventure with survival elements. Customize your ship, prepare for barrages from myriad foes, and navigate the perilous waters of a monster realm. Embark on this thrilling journey and Play for Free now!

row.name: Quest Of Peril

Quest of Peril is a Roguelike, with turn based combat and auto exploration. Fight monsters to improve your skills and journey across dark dying worlds to defeat Ifaris, the lord of evil and darkness. row.short_description: Create your own machine. Engineer it!

row.name: 机械恋心
row.detailed_description: 故事简介 世界大战的硝烟远去，新千年的钟声敲响，人们再也不用为生存而担忧。 能源、医疗、机械，各个领域的科研人员共同建立了国际科学城，将人类的科技推向新的高峰。 在科学城光鲜温暖的外表下，冷酷的优胜劣汰是这里的法则，只有真正的天才和强者得以留下。 年轻的研究员陈京，凭借聪明与努力，终于进入了国际科学城人工智能领域的顶级实验室。 然而等待他的是优中选优的淘汰制度，谁都不会关心旁人的去留。 陈京的科研工作遇到重重阻挠，他也明白这并不是他想要的生活。 幸运的是，有一位慷慨的雇主，给他带来了另一份梦寐以求的工作。 以此为契机，陈京终于和“那位少女”相遇了…… 角色介绍 游戏说明 《机械恋心》是Lunatic Works的第二部作品，游戏类型为文字冒险。玩家将选择故事走向，达成不同的结局。全篇剧本量约25万字，分为10章。 我们的美术和演出都比首作《青箱》有了不小的提升。相比《青箱》中的无选项单一路线，这次我们有三条主要路线可供选择。 角色的配音目前还没有制作完成，将会在后续版本中添加。 我们自研并开源的框架Nova，相比《青箱》时也有了更多的功能与优化，其他使用Nova制作游戏的朋友可以通过《机械恋心》来体验Nova能够扩展的各种功能。比如我们在设置界面中增加了更多可供玩家自定义的内容，在鼠标菜单中也加入了更多功能，并且支持了手柄操作。 Nova的发布地址为GitHub上的 Lunatic-Works/Nova 。 本制作组微博和b站账号为LunaticWorks，QQ群为876212259，欢迎关注并反馈问题和建议。 制作人员 剧本：17x、街心公园、akarin~ 美术：Pu_HT、Karaz、Solicey、小小童鞋、bestillstill、woctordho 音乐：冬勺 演出：woctordho、小小童鞋、人果角虫、Ibukilin 音效：Gliese 程序：小小童鞋、zhouhy UI设计：匣中猫 主催：coco 关于免费发布、游戏更新、捐款 《机械恋心》将始终作为免费游戏发布。我们希望任何玩家都可以不受障碍地下载游玩这款游戏，因此我们把它在各个平台免费发布，并且将持续更新。同时我们也提供可以直接下载运行的程序包，欢迎大家互相转发。 《机械恋心》抢先体验版的百度网盘下载链接：（请在链接前加 pan点baidu点com斜杠s斜杠 ） Windows电脑：1k7ppqEGo0Oi7ZLAhoj1B5g?pwd=9nhs 苹果电脑：1lZTx75-D7ME8oJWKThbTbQ?pwd=v73w 安卓手机：1jE6qMfbI-rV0QEmM4yofsQ?pwd=qred 苹果手机（可用AltStore等工具安装）：197wWK2xaII_o-szH_pM-GQ?pwd=kyvs Linux设备（包括Steam Deck）：1DSdsDNRtN7J-J2kVJ2mFOQ?pwd=6gg4 我们采用免费发布的原因是，我们认为一部游戏在玩家心目中的价值不应该由一个定价来决定，而应该由玩家自己在游戏中收获的体验而决定。 玩家可以向我们的收款二维码自由捐赠任意数额，以代表这部游戏给自己带来的价值。所有收到的捐款都会用于后续作品的开发。我们会在新作中向捐款人予以感谢，所以如果方便请在捐款时备注自己的ID和联系方式。 如果有很喜欢我们作品、愿意支持我们工作的朋友，也可以联系负责人QQ 735890664了解捐款的相关事宜。感谢大家的喜爱与支持。
row.short_description: 当科技突破伦理的局限，当天才的火花和机械的纯洁相遇，当积久的矛盾与必然的巧合共鸣，不受祝福却被期待的恋爱就此展开......

row.name: Electro Havoc
row.detailed_description: Enter a neon-charged battleground where survival meets explosive energy in this retro, space-themed twin-stick shooter! As you dance through waves of geometric adversaries, each defeated enemy leaves behind a deadly debris field—lure other enemies into these hazard zones to trigger devastating chain reactions and score multipliers. Snag powerful upgrades that temporarily boost your ship's offensive and defensive capabilities while you craft the perfect storm of destruction, turning enemy movements into opportunities for spectacular combos. Set your own pace in this sleek, modern take on classic arcade action, where minimalist design meets pixel particle effects in a sea of vibrant colors. A NOTE ABOUT EARLY ACCESS During Early Access, you'll be playing World 1 that consists of 10 waves of increasingly difficult and numerous foes. I will be creating new Worlds and the ability to transit between them. You can also expect the following when the game comes out of EA: Enemies already have different movement patterns and stats (speed, health), but they are of just one type. Expect lots more variety and maybe a refactor of the existing ones. I'd like to add impact damage if you slam into a wall at high velocity. Equally, I'd like to add a ship 'thrust' upgrade to allow you to plow into the enemies, inflicting collateral damage. More power-ups, ship upgrades and possibly roguelike additions. I'd love your suggestions in the Steam discussion forums, the support website, or via email/social below. SIMPLE CONTROLS Mastering Electro Havoc is easy: Use the two joysticks (or WASD+LMB) to control your ship and spray bullets in the general direction of your foes. YOUR SHIP Take control of the Starfighter X-7, a lightning-fast combat ship that comes equipped with devastating weapon systems, perfect for carving through waves of geometric baddies. Just... don't let them touch you. SHIP UPGRADES As you progress through the levels, you'll spot offensive and defensive power-ups that last for a few moments in-game -- listen for the audible cue that they're running out. Grab them on the map before they disappear! Defensive Power-ups Health: Regen your ship's health:  Regenerates one of your Ship's health bars. Shield: Grants temporarily invulnerability:  Take a breather and enjoy the briefest of reprieves. Offensive Power-ups Tri-blaster: Broader spray pattern:  Just aim in the general direction in the ultimate spray 'n pray armament. Mega blaster: Faster rate of fire and a larger projectile:  Take down enemies with ease as this weapon absolutely shreds your adversaries. ENEMIES In World 1, you face off the pointiest of foes: The Shard . As you advance through the waves, they'll grow in size, health and possibly speed but will also introduce new attack patterns like flanking, waving about, and pulsing, to name a few. Stay vigilant!
row.short_description: Electro Havoc: A retro twin-stick shooter set in a neon-charged battleground where you'll face waves of geometric foes. Lure more enemies into debris fields to trigger chain reactions, and grab power-ups to boost your multipliers.

row.name: Soul Brave
row.detailed_description: Soul Brave is an online action RPG in a fully 2D world with 3D characters and anime graphics. From now on you will enter a world full of magic, mystical creatures and face constant dangers. Are you ready to gain powers and become one of our warriors? -Choose your Favorite character. -Take on Epic Quests with a variety of different monsters and Bosses. -Raise your Lv and Increase your power! Strengthen your equipment. -Defeat Your friends in a legendary PVP. -Create pets and make them stronger! They will be your great companions on your journey. -Customize your character with wonderful Equipment! The newest MMORPG with 3d and 2d multiplayer graphics.
row.short_description: Soul Brave is a multiplayer action platform MMORPG with anime-style graphics.

row.name: OutRoad Fury
row.detailed_description: OutRoad Fury is a top-down action-rogue-lite game where you play as Leina, a metal singer. Following a demonic pact that ended badly, she sets off in search of a missing piece of her instrument ! Your playground, your rules In Toxi City, use the ambiant chaos as your advantage ! Throw furniture at your enemies, push them back over barbed wire and loot buildings containing weapons and resources ! Slaying waves from the underworld Sledgehammers, guitars and even traffic cones... Leina is spoilt for choice when it comes to smashing demons ! Each weapon has its own attack pattern, which can be combined with tapes that have an effect on Leina's performance ! Every road-trip is its own adventure New surprises await you at every turn ! Travel through three districts of Toxi City, in which each zone is random and offers different events that can be resolved by force... or violence ! Unleash your fury Spend your collected souls in a demonic teleshop to gain power and unlock content ! Make noise with picks, ultimate skills that can turn battles in your favor !
row.short_description: Fight demonic hordes and drive your van in search of weapons and resources to destroy the gate of hell, all in a metal atmosphere !

row.name: There's no dragon !
row.detailed_description: There's no dragon is a strategy game in which you build and manage colonies against waves of invaders.
