The land is divided into sections all compose by ressources ready to be gathered, gain experience to expand on this hostiles land ! Build your army Choose between three civilizations, each with its own skill tree featuring exclusive technologies and units. Move your soldiers to opposing camps to reduce their forces and establish your first line of defense ! Real time pausing This is a real-time strategy game, but don't panic—you can pause the action to make strategic and tactical decisions! Place your structures and give orders to your units. Be sure to be prepared before the next wave ! Capturing regions Clearing a skill level allows you to take control of a region! Each region offers clues about its resources, as well as the threat it poses. Send your soldiers to conquer the territory! Be sure not to lose your colonial counter, otherwise the entire region will slip through your fingers!
row.short_description: Alone on a plot of land with a few resources and a single building, your civilization will begin here. Exploit resources, explore and conquer other regions, develop technologies, and fend off relentless barbarian attacks. Everything is manageable: they don't have a dragon!

row.name: Golf In Wonderland
row.detailed_description: Dive into a fantastical adventure where sport and fantasy come together in a world as delirious as it is enchanting. Welcome to 'Golf in Wonderland,' a unique golf game that transports you to the heart of the wonderland. In 'Golf in Wonderland,' you are immersed in the enchanted kingdom of Wonderland, where each level presents a new challenge. Your mission is to conquer a series of extraordinary golf courses, each more surprising than the last. Every hole is a puzzle in itself, requiring much more than simple golfing skills. Discover secret shortcuts to reach the greens in record time. Each course is inspired by an iconic location in Wonderland and offers a unique visual and gameplay experience. Immerse yourself in dreamlike landscapes. Different levels propose challenges of increasing difficulty. Play in multiplayer mode to compete with your friends. Optimize your route to complete each level as efficiently as possible.
row.short_description: Dive into a fantastical adventure where sport and fantasy come together in a world as delirious as it is enchanting. Welcome to 'Golf in Wonderland,' a unique golf game that transports you to the heart of the wonderland.

row.name: Los Pingheros Playtest
row.detailed_description: Duck, dodge and toss. Los Pingheros is a multiplayer brawler for up to 8 players online or local . Join hectic battles in various modes and strive to become the ultimate Pinghero in Mexico by snowing your opponents out of the arena. Ultimate Penguin Snowdown Join an exhilarating multiplayer action for memorable frenzied battles, playable with up to 8 players online or locally. Dive into the vibrant colors of Mexico, draped in a unique snowy mantle, and join the action alone or with your friends. Intense Brawl Modes Prepare yourself for thrilling and diverse confrontations across a variety of modes, where only the most cunning penguins emerge victorious: Carnaval : This new mode empowers you to turbocharge your Pinghero with additional skills, ensuring an ever-escalating action and strategy. Score Spree : Secure victory by dominating the scoreboard within the time limit. The Last Pinghero : Beware, your lives are limited and only the last penguin standing will be declared the overall winner. Secret Penguin Techniques - Access to the penguin's top survival tricks: the ultimate slide, the renowned penguin spinning top, and the celebrated 'Made in Penguin' chokeslam, where your opponent definitely won't be pretending. Outsmart Your Opponents - Destroy the cacti to uncover power-ups. Be smart on how you use them! Keep an eye on the luchador mask that enrages your penguin, and game-changing items like the magic snowflake to freeze all other penguins to the bone. The Mexican Dressing Room - Customize your penguins to reflect your unique style. As you progress, you unlock new clothing, hats, and color palettes. You are not alone - Watch out for your webbed feet ! In Mexico, you won't be alone. Slide in the wrong place and you might get bitten. Features Up to 8 players local, online, or mixed Play free for all or team with friends Unique Snowy Mexican setting A special mode with skills Destruct and construct the environment Unlock customization for your penguin as you progress
row.short_description: Duck, dodge and toss. Los Pingheros is a multiplayer brawler for up to 8 players online or local. Join hectic battles in various modes and strive to become the ultimate Pinghero in Mexico by snowing your opponents out of the arena.

row.name: SHAPE SHIFTER
row.detailed_description: Create and discover Custom Levels on the Steam Workshop! About the Game Welcome to The Geomatrix, a digital realm where everything is a polygon, including you! Create, discover and share levels, compete for the best times and discover hidden secrets. Whether you're a triangle, circle or square, each shape has their own unique abilities that dictate how you solve puzzles and clear levels! - Features- Using the in-game level editor , you can make all kinds of crazy creations from difficult time trials to complex contraptions! The level editor features: Various simple and complex shapes, that you can combine to create minimalist structures or huge open worlds Lots of functional blocks, such as the automator and area trigger for the engineers out there Many handy tools that streamline the creation process, like the camera zoom adjuster and background blocks Grab a friend! Any of your maps can be uploaded to the Steam Workshop to allow them to be played in multiplayer! Deep integration with Steam, use a lobby code or simply invite a friend through the Steam friends menu Compete with each other, for the fastest times and best scores, or work together to solve difficult puzzles Cross-platform compatibility, whether you're playing on a Windows or Mac system, anyone can join their friends, regardless of their operation system If you're not as interested in creating your own levels, or just want to experience some pre-packaged levels, I've got you covered! A handful of demo levels, to preview the capabilities of the level editor and to test your skills Hidden collectibles and secrets, for the keen-eyed and curious A subtle storyline , of course, for the theorists out there
row.short_description: Create, discover and share levels, compete for the best times and discover hidden secrets. In this sandbox platformer, whether you're a triangle, circle or square dictates how you solve puzzles and clear levels! Each shape has their own unique abilities that completely change the game.

row.name: Furriend
row.detailed_description: Once upon a time, there was a lonely witch and she wants to have friends to talk and play with. Sadly, her timidness makes her being bashful everytime she tries to approach someone. Then one day, a brilliant idea popped out of the witch's head. With her skillful witchcraft, she decided to summon her own friends. But who or what will come out of the summoning portal? Will it be an orc? A dragon? Or a demon instead?! Nope, she summons furriends, the pawsome and adorable little creatures to be her friend. But, how is this pawzzle rituals work...? How it can summon all those cute little furriends...? Connect the Dot + Merge Puzzle Mechanism Spawn Paw-friends by dragging the summoning circle around the tiles. Combines the summoning circles to create a new mix and reach the target to complete the level. Each animal have some unique requirements to be spawned, adding more complexity to the puzzles. Can you solve all the puzzles? Key Features - Cute visuals & sounds - Relaxing music - 20 Introduction Levels - 3 cute themes
row.short_description: Help the lonely mage to spawn lots of cute Paw-friends! Furriend is a 2.5D isometric puzzle games that combines connect the dot + merge mechanics.

row.name: Hunter: Space Pirates
row.detailed_description: Embark on an epic journey with 'Hunter: Space Pirates' a captivating visual novel featuring over 700 stunning renders. STORY OVERVIEW Dive into the enthralling story of Hunter, a young man whose dreams of joining the Navy are shattered by an unexpected twist of fate. As he navigates the complexities of his daily life, Hunter finds himself on an unexpected path filled with mystery, personal growth, and discovery. CHARACTER RELATIONSHIPS AND SCI-FI ELEMENTS Explore Hunter's relationships with a diverse cast of characters, set against a backdrop of sci-fi elements woven through every aspect of the story. Experience a thrilling narrative filled with personal growth, discovery, and mature themes that add depth and realism to Hunter's journey. THE JOURNEY OF HUNTER In a world where the ordinary collides with the extraordinary, 'Hunter: Space Pirates' tells a captivating tale of mystery and discovery. Meet Hunter, a young man navigating the complexities of his daily life while unknowingly tethered to a destiny far beyond his imagination. As Hunter grapples with personal challenges and finds solace in unexpected friendships, his world suddenly shifts. His dream of joining the Navy shattered by a failed physical exam, Hunter is thrust onto an unexpected path. UNVEILLING MYSTERIES With echoes of ancient prophecies and a heritage waiting to be uncovered, Hunter embarks on a journey that transcends dimensions. From the quiet corners of his neighborhood to the vast expanse of outer space, every step reveals deeper mysteries and hidden truths about his own identity. A GALACTIC ADVENTURE AWAITS 'Hunter: Space Pirates' is a compelling fusion of sci-fi and fantasy, blending intricate character dynamics with cosmic revelations. Perfect for players who crave adventure, intricate plots, and a touch of the unknown, this story promises to take you on a thrilling ride through the realms of imagination. Note: This game contains mature themes and explicit content, intended for an adult audience. Note 2: This is the base game, which includes Chapter 1, along with extra features like the Gallery menu, Characters menu, and Scene Jumper! Note 3: Future chapters will be released as DLC.
row.short_description: Dive into the enthralling story of Hunter, a young man whose dreams of joining the Navy are shattered by an unexpected twist of fate. As he navigates the complexities of his daily life, Hunter finds himself on an unexpected path filled with mystery, personal growth, and discovery.
row.notes: "Hunter: Space Pirates" is a Visual Novel (VN) for adults with explicit sex scenes. Not intended for audiences under 18 years old. The game includes depictions of violence such as arena fights, physical assault, extortion, and implied death. Sexual content features masturbation, voyeurism, striptease, and nudity. All sex in the game is consensual and all characters are over 18 years old.

row.name: DASH n CRY
row.detailed_description: Jump and Dash your way through the game in this fast-paced, challenging 2D Precision Platformer game for those who want to put their skills to their limits! Shout after failing a challenge, before facing a tight room full of spikes, and SHOUT A LOT after overcoming the hardest levels. Let all that energy out through the CRY !!! Over 40 unique levels with replayability Over 40 levels with progressive difficulty and mechanics, that can be cleared in several ways, with secrets, collectibles, and challenges! Achievements and Challenges Besides clearing the game, even harder content awaits if you wanna tackle on DASH n CRY challenges, where you must complete levels in unintended, much more challenging ways! For those who cleared the game, but still want more, tackle on challenging secret areas inside the main levels to find hidden collectibles, or challenge the EX levels, based on the main level mechanics, but tuned up in difficulty to the (EX)treme! Assist Mode Activate Assist mode to get the power of a god. Invincibility? Infinite Jumps? Infinite Dashes? All Levels Unlocked? We have it all at your disposal. Assist Mode might disable some Achievement and Challenge Rewards.
row.short_description: DASH n CRY is a fast-paced, challenging 2D Precision Platformer game for those who want to put their skills to their limits.

row.name: The Shadow Over Cyberspace
row.detailed_description: Dread whispers echo across the Information Superhighway. Y2K is coming, heralding the rise of the Old Ones. With your meatspace mind unraveling, time is running out -- barter with gods, embrace the deathless aeons, or go offline permanently in this modempunk horror story. From Fiction Factory Games Creators of Arcade Spirits , Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers , and Penny Larceny: Gig Economy Supervillain comes a new experience in science fiction and horror, with a retro computer aesthetic. Mind-Melting Y2K Horror, For Free Yes, free. Just free. Not a 'free prologue,' not free to play, no battlepass, no microtransactions. It's just free thanks to the support of our community. The only currency you'll need to spend is your own sanity (and maybe a 90-hour free trial floppy disk for Carcosa Online). The Throne of R'lyeh is Calling Create your own character, choosing name and pronouns and more. Full text-to-speech support with a special visual impairment mode. (Tap the 'V' key to activate.) Navigate the tangled web of eldritch beings that control the Internet of the year 1999. Search the web, hack protected databases, unravel conspiracies and solve mysteries. Watch weird TV shows which are likely but probably not haunted. Struggle to retain your Humanity against the forces of Chaos and Order after witnessing the Yellow Sign. Check your phone answering machine now and then. They're worried about you. Play kingmaker and decide what horrible entity will dominate the 21st century and beyond. WE HAVE SUCH WEBSITES TO SHOW YOU.
row.short_description: Dread whispers echo across the Information Superhighway. Y2K is coming, heralding the rise of the Old Ones. With your meatspace mind unraveling, time is running out -- barter with gods, embrace the deathless aeons, or go offline permanently in this modempunk horror story.
row.notes: This is a psychological horror game. It may optionally include obscene language and deal with triggering subjects such as mental illness, delusions, violence, and self-harm. For full content warning, see fictionfactorygames.com/cw

row.name: Excommunicated
row.detailed_description: Embark on an intriguing journey in our 2D typing game, where you take on the role of a fearless woman seeking answers in an abandoned space base. Uncover what befell the crew as you face possessed creatures, all through your ability of typing. Immerse yourself in the atmospheric underground vibe, where every keystroke unveils dark secrets and challenges your typing skills. The mystery unfolds as you progress, typing to defeat possessed beings and unravel the enigmas surrounding the base. Get ready for a one-of-a-kind gaming experience, where a captivating narrative intertwines with typing mechanics, creating an atmosphere that goes beyond words. Are you prepared to unravel the secrets buried in the shadows of the space base? The journey begins with the press of the first key This is a Vertical Slice Project
row.short_description: A typing game of investigation in a space base

row.name: Macie's Magic Melee
row.detailed_description: Macie Needs Your Help Embark on a heartwarming and thrilling adventure as a devoted father on a quest to complete a special errand for your beloved daughter, Macie. Step into a magical roguelike arena filled with diverse challenges, powerful items, and tricky debuffs, all while engaging in intense 3rd-person combat. Conquer the Arena Face off against nine unique enemies as you battle through nine demanding rounds of combat. Explore 2 distinct environments, each featuring 4 meticulously crafted levels, before taking on the formidable boss. Your veteran skills will be put to the test as you wield Macie’s magical book and paper sword to navigate through waves of enemies and obstacles. Collect and Unlock Powerful Items Make use of the arena’s store to purchase over 10 unique items during your runs, or find them scattered throughout your journey. Each item offers new strategies and enhancements, ensuring a fresh and exciting experience for every playthrough. Prepare yourself for a magical, action-packed adventure where your love for your daughter fuels your determination to succeed. Are you ready to take on the challenge and make Macie proud?
row.short_description: Macie wants more plushies! Who could say no to their loving daughter? Battle, dash, and shoot through a magical arena to win. Collect items to boost your odds against the arena's enemies and secure a swift victory. Best of luck!

row.name: Death In The Afternoon
row.detailed_description: Death in the afternoon is a narrative and detective game. Let yourself immersed as Arthur and get caught up in alcohol addiction. As you live through night parties, prepare yourself for the inevitable BlackOut. Gather as much clues as you can before passing out... After waking up, you'll have to get out of a tricky situation as best as you can. Take back the control of your life to fix what need to be fixed before the next party... Game features : Play parties in 3rd person. When the sun rises, explore in first person. Gather clues in your phone. Make your choices in multiple-choices dialogues. Navigate a boat. Learn hox to fish. Solve the riddles and conclude the scenarios. 3 Parties and 5 Scenarios. Game in early access.
row.short_description: In Death In The Afternoon, throw yourself into a night of drinking. You play as Arthur, a young student who likes to drink a little too much... Try to fight your addiction ! And choose your drinks and interactions carefully, or you might have the worst BlackOut of your life !
row.notes: This game is designed for an adult audience. Death In The Afternoon depicts excessive alcohol consumption directly through the main character. There's also mention of harassment linked to homophobia, and the damage it can do to a person.

row.name: Abyssal
row.detailed_description: Abyssal is a 3D turn-based strategy game where a Monk, wielding arcane magic, must battle hordes of Eldritch-like creatures with the help of his minions. The story revolves around two brothers, Alaric and Archivald, destined to inherit the leadership of their cult. However, Alaric's greed led him to attempt to kill Archivald to seize all the power, forcing Archivald to flee while his subordinates were killed. Now, Archivald returns to resurrect his fallen comrades and seek revenge. Along the way, he discovers that Alaric has made a pact with abyssal creatures that have infested the city. The brothers must now defeat these evil forces to restore balance and finally exact their revenge. Turn-based strategy in a 3D Isometric view Explore an array of characters: Mages, Cauldron, and more! Use magic to open your way into the Abyss! This game was developed as a 4th-year student project at DigiPen Europe-Bilbao for educational purposes. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A 3D turn-based strategy game where a Monk, wielding arcane magic, and his minions battle hordes of Eldritch-like creatures.

row.name: MouseVentures
row.detailed_description: MouseVentures is a puzzle game where you control Pipo, a stuffed mouse. He will enter two storybooks to help the characters inside while use magnetism and light to solve the puzzles that stand in their way. A little girl's handcrafted plush comes to life due to her imagination. He gets absorbed into storybooks where something isn't quite right and gets tasked with helping the little prince Arthur get his sword and an energetic bunny rescue his friend Quetzacóatl. Explore a book based world Solve incredible puzzles Meet amazing characters! This game was developed as a 4th-year student project at DigiPen Europe-Bilbao for educational purposes. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A puzzle game where you control Pipo, a stuffed mouse. He will enter two storybooks to help the characters inside while use magnetism and light to solve the puzzles that stand in their way.

row.name: Spice Trade
row.detailed_description: The original cult game Spice Trade, initially released in 2005, is now on Steam! After almost 20 years since its original release, this masterpiece, enjoyed by many gamers, is now available on the biggest gaming platform for even more gamers to enjoy, and in its original form as it was released in 2005. Colonize Europe! Start from nothing and dominate another continent. Spread the influence of your culture while creating your own empire! Since the 14th century, Europe has been a global super power when it started colonizing other continents. But what if history had gone a different way? What would Europe be like if Asia had prevailed? Abu Al-Qazzaz is the main character in Spice Trade. He is a poor young man from Baghdad, who has inherited a house and some land.. oh, and he wants to get married too. Abu decides to try his luck in the spice game. He has to prevent the European countries from gaining a trade monopoly. Will Abu be able to beat out the Europeans in the spice trade? Could Europe have been different? How? You decide! Revisits depictions of cities: Baghdad Amsterdam Baku Constantinople Konya Hamburg Lisboa London Madrid Moscow Najaf Veniceand much more!
row.short_description: Spice Trade offers a chance to rewrite history with Abu, a young man challenging European dominance. As he inherits land in Baghdad, Abu enters the spice trade to thwart European trade monopoly. Can he reshape Europe's fate? You decide the outcome in this game of strategy and empire-building!
developers: Kalle Hamm, Juha Holopainen, Sade Kahra, Dzamil Kamanger, Michiko Isogai, Goran Mrdja

row.name: Factory Outlet Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: This Prologue is the limited version of the game to stop waiting and start running your factory outlet store right away. Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist to continue your fun trading experience. Factory Outlet Simulator is a trading game with every detail of a clothing factory and outlet store. FACTORY MANAGEMENT You can try different ways to source raw materials at the cheapest price, buy machines for your factory and increase your production chain. STORE MANAGEMENT You can design and expand your store as you wish. You can determine where products are displayed, manage advertisements and provide your customers with a quality shopping experience. DESIGN You can create original designs using the computer. You can determine the market values yourself and sell your own brand. COMMERCIAL INTELLIGENCE You can use the computer to order raw materials or find other ways to source them cheaply. By balancing customer satisfaction and profit margins, you can sell your products at the prices you want or apply discounts. WHOLESALE AND LEADERSHIP TABLE You can make commercial agreements with famous brands. Depending on the offers, you can export your products all over the world, becoming the best seller in a real-time market! Business acumen is everything in Factory Outlet Simulator! Will you sink or grow in this market?
row.short_description: Factory Outlet Simulator is a very comprehensive clothes manufacturing and selling game. You can produce the products of world famous brands in your factory and sell them. Or you can expand your business and create your own brand. Use your business acumen to lead the market from zero to the top!

row.name: Art Diff
row.detailed_description: It is a cozy puzzle game in which you search for the differences between two pictures. Restore 26 animated artworks in the public domain, such as 'A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte' and 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa.' The game uses copyright-free or public-domain artworks to create levels. There is currently one chapter in the game, with 26 levels, each with three difficulties. This is a small game developed is our first indie game. We hope you can find peace and fun in this free find-the-difference game. Our New Game! LauNewBee studio is developing a new Steam game 'Tongue of Doge'. Please wishlist to support us! Sorry that we don’t have time to develop new levels for now. After making this game, we felt a great sense of accomplishment. Unfortunately, there was no income, so the team went to do other things. If players are interested, after the development and maintenance of 'The Tongue of Doge' is over, perhaps a new chapter can be produced and sold as DLC.
row.short_description: It is a cozy puzzle game in which you search for the differences between two pictures. Restore 26 animated artworks in the public domain, such as 'A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte' and 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa.'
row.notes: The game includes a selection of classical oil paintings that are in the public domain, some of which feature unclothed figures, such as "The Birth of Venus."

row.name: Moon 2999
row.detailed_description: Moon 2999 is an epic role playing strategy game about multiple factions and their struggle for control of the moon. As the commander of one of these factions, the player will manage resources, construct buildings, equip units, and control their troops during tactical single player or co-op battles. Set in the year 2999 when humanity has spread across parts of the solar system, but centuries of political tension have fractured civilizations into powerful factions and rival empires. As the protagonist Commander of a Moon base, your task is to expand and upgrade your colony, recruit allies, and venture into deep space. You will face relentless alien hordes, challenge mighty bosses, and fight for ancient artifacts and precious resources that could decide the fate of your faction. You will supervise and enhance base operations and undertake a variety of missions, encompassing engagements with aliens, bounty hunting, factional conflicts, and PvP combat. Every choice, every battle, and every alliance will shape not only your base, but also the destiny of the galaxy itself. PVP combat Aliens war on Mars Bounty hunting Moon 2999 is rich in content and features and allows you to construct buildings, recruit units and lead battles against other factions and Kragh aliens. You can construct a wide range of buildings, from command centers and military missions to production plants and research centers. Buildings can be upgraded to increase their power and efficiency. You can also recruit troops to protect your colony and attack enemies. There is a significant variety of units available, each with unique skills and different weapons. Battles take place in real-time or turn-based, and by clever use of tactics and strategy you will gain an advantage over your opponents. You may upgrade your units by gaining experience on the battlefield. Terran Foundation: 2130 Objective: Protection of Earth's interests and preservation of human dominance in space. Descendants of the first lunar colonists, the Terrans see themselves as guardians of humanity’s legacy. Driven by nationalism and duty, they aim to maintain order and control while resisting alien and synthetic threats. Bureaucratic yet powerful, they value discipline and authority above all. Main Skills: Leadership, Reconnaissance, Engineering Allies: MMC, Luna Enemies: Syndicate, Androids Luna Foundation: 2110 Objective: Establishment of lunar colonies and technological progress. Composed of scientists and visionaries, Luna embodies reason and innovation. They focus on research, sustainable architecture, and the perfection of space technology. Though peaceful, they defend their independence and scientific secrets with quiet determination. Main Skills: Leadership, Engineering, Medicine, Reconnaissance Allies: Terrans, Androids Enemies: Centurians, Syndicate MMC (Martian Marine Corps) Foundation: 2955 Objective: Defense of Mars and extermination of alien threats. Forged by conflict, the MMC are elite warriors devoted to security and survival. They embody discipline, courage, and strength, viewing warfare as both art and necessity. Their iron code tolerates no weakness — they are the last shield of humanity. Main Skills: Leadership, Attack, Defense, Dodge Allies: Terrans Enemies: RAK, Centurians Centurian (Belters) Foundation: 2956 Objective: Control of asteroid resources and independence from inner worlds. Children of the void, the Centurians live and die among the asteroids. Resourceful and defiant, they master the art of mining and navigation in deadly environments. Distrustful of Earth’s empires, they fight for freedom and survival in the cold expanse. Main Skills: Mining, Engineering, Reconnaissance Allies: Androids Enemies: Luna, MMC Androids Foundation: 2180 Objective: Recognition as sentient beings and liberation from human control. Designed as tools, the Androids evolved beyond programming. Logical yet emotional, they seek identity and independence. They embrace the perfection of technology while condemning organic corruption. To them, freedom is not a right — it’s a calculation. Main Skills: Engineering, Medicine, Reconnaissance Allies: Luna, Centurians Enemies: Terrans, RAK Syndicate Foundation: 2968 Objective: Economic domination and manipulation of inter-factional power. The Syndicate rules the shadows — a network of merchants, hackers, and smugglers turning chaos into profit. They fund wars, sell secrets, and reshape politics from the underworld. Morality means nothing when the price is right. Main Skills: Mining, Leadership, Engineering Allies: RAK Enemies: Terrans, Luna RAK Foundation: 2110 Objective: Capture and containment of criminals across the system. Created as an inter-factional law force, RAK evolved into a quasi-independent military power. Guardians of the orbital prison, they balance justice and brutality. Ruthless and efficient, they hunt criminals, bounty targets, and political dissidents alike. Main Skills: Reconnaissance, Attack, Defense, Dodge, Bounty Hunting Allies: Syndicate Enemies: Androids, MMC The Kraghs Species: Hostile aliens (xeno-intelligent) Suspected origin: Unknown star system, beyond Alpha Centauri First appearance: 2950 Primary motivations: Retrieval of ancient technologies, purification of the Solar System from “corrupted” life forms, biological and energetic dominance. First encounter: Asteroid Belt Description The Kraghs are an ancient alien species, highly evolved both biologically and mineralogically. Their chitinous skin is laced with luminescent veins that channel an unknown form of energy — a kind of bioplasma . Their biology appears to be symbiotic with microscopic energy-based organisms , granting them the ability to manipulate matter and electromagnetic fields directly, with no apparent mechanical technology. Their language is based on infrasonic vibrations and patterns of light emission , making direct communication nearly impossible for humans. Early analyses (RAK and Luna Labs, 2954) suggest they operate through a hierarchical collective intelligence , similar to a hive mind controlled by a central psychic core . Motivations and Objectives The Kraghs are not conquerors in the traditional sense. Their objective appears to be the recovery and reactivation of ancient artifacts scattered across the Moon, Mars, and the Asteroid Belt — the same relics discovered by the Terrans, Luna, and Centurians between 2954 and 2990. According to intercepted transmission fragments, they view humanity as a mistake of evolution , a species that defiled sacred relics of a vanished civilization they call “The Architects.” Their campaign is not one of occupation, but of purification — an attempt to prevent humans from awakening or exploiting forbidden technologies .
row.short_description: Moon 2999 is a RPG game about Units & resources management, single-player or co-op action missions game set in a lunar base and its nearby space environment.

row.name: Superfighters of Survival
row.detailed_description: In Superfighters of Survival , every 200 years, the gods organize a fierce competition where they choose mortal champions to fight to the death in a celestial coliseum. Only one can survive and achieve the much-desired ' Ascension ' earning a place among the gods. However, there is a dark secret: the competition is rigged by the gods themselves, who manipulate the event at their whim, keeping the participants and the public unaware of their depraved fun. Among the contenders is an elf, selected from a young age and manipulated to participate in this brutal and glorious competition… Can you challenge the gods and uncover the secrets of this competition? Superfighters of Survival is a cooperative action 'deathmatch' game where you will participate (by force) in coliseum battles to save your life! Experience what it is like to be a champion in a fantastical, ever-changing coliseum filled with weapons, abilities, and combat strategies, while earning the support or the hatred of our beloved audience and rising to victory. key Features: Changing Battlefield - The arena where you fight is dynamic and offers many possibilities for facing combat. Changes in the structure itself with platforms, springs, moving structures, pits, or different height levels are some of the situations you can experience in our coliseum. Weapons and Traps Everywhere - You will have access to a wide variety of mythical and fantastic weapons within the coliseum. From ranged weapons like staffs and bows, to close combat weapons like swords and shields, or even audience weapons like a ham bat or a folding chair; these are some of the combat possibilities available to you. This, combined with a variety of traps and structures (spikes, fire, spinning saws, etc.), offers a different strategy in every confrontation. Pollice Verso - No matter how you fight, the audience can influence the course of the combat (after all, they paid to see you). Depending on how you fight and what strategies you take, the audience will either support you or hinder your fight. Include a description of the mechanics. Every Man for Himself : The game’s combat is a 'deathmatch' style where you will face many enemies alongside your friends in a 'free-for-all' mode. This doesn't mean you have to cooperate, as only one can be left standing. Fun and rivalries are guaranteed with this game mode.
row.short_description: The gods are bored, and you are their entertainment. With fierce champions, fantastic weapons, and a dynamic arena that constantly challenges you, this game promises co-op action, humor, and plenty of fun. Do you have what it takes to be the champion of Superfighters of Survival?

row.name: Sanguinaria
row.detailed_description: RESCUE YOUR SISTER . Save Lyra : Your goal will be to rescue your little sister who has been kidnapped by a religious cult hidden deep within an 18th century American colonial-era fortress. Behold the fortress : Explore the mysterious fortress that is holding your sister and discover all its secrets in order to advance![/list] MASSACRE YOUR ENEMIES . Consume blood and survive : Our protagonist has both close and long range abilities, however, these abilities will consume her blood as the player uses them. Choose your strategy wisely to survive waves of enemies that will besiege you during your mission. Unleash the frenzy : Aura has a special ability called Frenzy that will briefly boost her attributes and annihilate her enemies quickly - take advantage of this state! Use the blood pools : The blood puddles mechanic allows Aura to move through the blood spilled by her enemies in addition to making her invulnerable to her enemies. one more advantage on the battlefield! ¡Recupérate vampiro! : As a vampire, Aura has ultra-fast recovery abilities, soak up the blood spilled by your enemies and reach the top of the fortification. CHALLENGE YOUR DESTINY . Conquer your demons : Aura lives tormented by the kidnapping of her sister, take back the reins of her destiny and confront her destructive thoughts.
row.short_description: Embark on a dark odyssey in 18th century colonial America. Control Aura, a vampire, and rescue her sister Lyra from a religious cult. Use blood-consuming skills and choose your attacks carefully in this 3D third-person top-down action game.

row.name: Scyla
row.detailed_description: Dive into the waters of Scyla, a third-person 3D exploration adventure inspired by Lovecraft's universe. Discover the mysteries hidden into the depths as you pilot a submarine through a strange cave system. Run away from a criature that stalks you. Mechanics At the controls of a submarine, you must explore a mysterious cave system that is fragmenting the depths of the ocean of an island near Cape Verde. Rumors say that a treasure has been found inside these caves along with the remains of ancient ships. At the beginning of the adventure, you will forge an alliance with a small creature that will accompany you and help you defeat the strange sea creatures that you will encounter along the way by throwing water jets at them as projectiles. To move through some areas of the map, you will have a hook that will let you move easily, grab certain surfaces and attract certain objects. In addition to using your insight and skill, you can find the hook upgrade, with which you can imbue it with electricity and use it to stun your enemies and go through areas with electrical surfaces. The state of the submarine will be represented by a barometer. When the submarine is hit, the pressure of the barometer will decrease until it reaches the critical point. After this critical point the submarine will explode. We can stabilize the state of the submarine by collecting orbs that we will find by destroying some objects. Dive into the waters of Scyla to find the new treasure that has been discovered. Explore the interior of the cave system that is fragmenting the ocean depths. Overcome obstacles and defeat strange creatures from the seabed to achieve your goal. Upgrade your hook and fight along with a small creature that will go with you during your entire adventure. Keep an eye on every move, a creature will be stalking you at every step. Add Scyla to your wish list!
row.short_description: Dive into the waters of Scyla, a third-person 3D exploration adventure inspired by Lovecraft's universe. Discover the mysteries hidden into the depths as you pilot a submarine through a strange cave system. Run away from a criature that stalks you.

row.name: Aard and Wyzz: The rise of minions
row.detailed_description: Aard and Wyzz: The rise of minions is a local cooperative action-adventure video game where two players will take on the role of the boss Ardwiz, a tyrant wizard recently divided in two after the unexpected rebellion of his minions, with a lot of extra hours in his body. These two mages will have to work together, using their magical abilities and strength, as well as merging at certain times to enhance their skills and defeat the senior staff of the office. Aard will be the melee and dynamic movement specialist. Wyzz will dominate ranged combat through his magic orb. Through real-time combat, they will have to use their skills to defeat the enemies and bosses of each department, where strategy and cooperation will be the key to victory. This local co-op takes place in a magical office tower, making a satire of the classic figure of the all-powerful magician and the corporate power figures of today's world. At some stages of the game, players will be able to briefly merge into the all-powerful wizard Ardwiz, winner of the best boss award for 200 consecutive years (voted by himself) and professional minion exploiter. The player controlling Aard will be in charge of movement, while the player controlling Wyzz will dominate the ranged attack.
row.short_description: Join forces and put an end to the revolution! In this local co-op 3D action-adventure game, you will control two wizards who were once one. Combine your skills and solve puzzles as you work side by side to restore balance at the office.

row.name: Digbeat: Godot Deeper
row.detailed_description: Dig to the beat in this arcade-style game inspired by games like Cadence of Hyrule, Downwell, and Super Motherload! Dig to new depths in this sequel to the 2022 game jam game! Digbeat Godot Deeper was completely rebuilt in the Godot game engine from the ground up! Dig alone or with one friend and compete for the highscore! Experience new features including new blocks, new controls, a high score system, local multiplayer & more!
row.short_description: Digbeat: Godot Deeper is a rhythm digging arcade game. Move to the beat and try to reach new depths!

row.name: Aria Skies
row.detailed_description: Fight It Out In Aria Skies! Take flight in this non-traditional 2.5D fighter where positioning and movement are key! An easy-to-grasp control scheme allows anyone to come and join the battle. Get ready for a variety of modes, create a team of your favorite characters and battle with your friends locally or using Steam Remote Play! Featuring six playable characters, five stages and heaps of configurations and modes. The living clouds incarnate on Aria has granted a handful of fighters the magic ability of flight, who will come out on top?! Only one way to know, duke it out! Key Features Arcade Mode Battle through a series of CPU-controlled opponents and try to beat your fastest clear time! Each character has their own unique route to face, complete with modifiers and team compositions that can only be seen in this mode. Character Playstyles Select and Battle with a team chosen from six unique characters, each designed to suit a different archetype of play, such as Striker or Zoner. Learn the ins and outs your favorite characters' moveset and characteristics to find a way to victory! Game Rules and Party Modes Want to add the chaos? Enable game rules like stage hazards that create new strategies; moveset randomization to keep everyone guessing the whole way through; change the default team size or form a team with a friend! Character Theme Music Each character has their own theme track to enjoy! Select the BGM yourself in Free Battle mode or let the automatic system pick a track fitting the upcoming battle! Gamepad recommended.
row.short_description: Soar to new heights in Aria Skies, a non-traditional, 2.5D indie fighting game featuring free-flying movement that anyone can pick up and enjoy!

row.name: 新月大陆
row.detailed_description: The game software 'Elementalt Guardian' is an original Japanese-style fantasy action card game. Players collect and nurture their companions to face challenges from around the world! 【Many characters】 It provides more than 40 different characters. Players can challenge powerful enemies from all over the world through character development. Of course, as the character level grows, some new abilities will be unlocked! 【Rich plot】 There are always many different stories happening on the fantasy continent. Please lead the team to start an exciting adventure! 【Abundant growth】 We provide a wealth of content for character growth: levels, grades, weapons, skills and rich element development... More powerful characters can help you experience every moment of the game! 【Gorgeous Vision】 In order to strengthen the characters' skills, we have produced a large number of models to show you cool skill performances!
row.short_description: On the Continent, girls gather at the Magic Academy where they learn magic and combat skills,and embark on various adventures. An ancient prophecy circulates within the academy: when the new moon rises again, the world will face an unprecedented crisis, and only the academy girls can save it.

row.name: GASPING.2
row.detailed_description: GASPING.2 is a single player survival game. In the abandoned game world, players will collect waste, food, and props, and then use the production table to make necessary supplies, using a gas stove to cook food. There are 30 huge ventilation towers in the desert, and sand worms are hidden near them. When you kill the sand worms, you can activate the ancient teleportation device under the nearby ventilation towers. The teleportation device can only teleport between the ventilation towers. Searching for sand worms requires having a robot companion before being able to find them. The higher the level of the robot companion, the stronger their detoxification ability. Using game props such as toilets, cleaning devices, and sleeping bags can help clear toxins faster. There are some notebooks left in the world that can provide some clues you need. The game 'GASPING.2' is independently developed and will continue to update its content in the later stages.Gradually enrich the props and game scene content in the game.
row.short_description: 《GASPING.2》is a single player survival game, with only you and your robot companions in a dangerous and abandoned game world. The open world and lonely gameplay require your patience.Are you ready to challenge?

row.name: Vest A Life
row.detailed_description: Too late to fixed The world is finally in an unreturnable condition. war, chemicals, nuclear, global warming, and widespread plastic pollution causing problems that are too late to fix, and now all humanity pays the price for it. Third-Person-Shooter fighting against military bandits and other survivors around the map. keep yourself safe and survive the raid to get all the resources or lose it all with just one bullet from the enemy. Looting to upgrade upgrade all the equipment, hideout, and gear to prepare yourself before every match. take out the best of your build and fight every enemy in front of you. Survive with friend Host or join a session to play and survive with your friend or maybe… fight with them instead!. Rare gun from the boss Get an SVN sniper rifle-type gun that can only drop from ‘Garry’, the big boss in Sarasin area. Phuket in post-apocalyptic theme Play in one of the most famous cities in Thailand ‘Phuket’. With an outstanding landmark that can only be seen in Phuket!
row.short_description: The world is finally in an unreturnable condition. war, chemicals, nuclear, global warming, and widespread plastic pollution causing problems that are too late to fix, and now all humanity pays the price for it. Play as a survivor in Post-apocalypse 'Phuket'. Find resources in the MMO world of VAL.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

row.name: Pixel Race Maker
row.detailed_description: Pixel Race Maker is a fun, user created levels, speed runner platformer game. Can you get from the start to the end of the level the quickest and collect the most coins? Test your platformer skills in this race against the clock skill game. Complete the level and open the winners chest and earn new characters to race against. Are you a level creator? Create your own level to test the community and see who comes out on top. Unlock new tilesets, backgrounds, music to give your levels a unique look and sound.
row.short_description: Create your own unique levels or simply play one of our user crreated levels to earn badges and achievements.

row.name: The Big Catch: Tacklebox
row.detailed_description: Catch a short taste of The Big Catch and see if you're ready for the full adventure! The Big Catch: Tacklebox is a standalone chapter and prologue to The Big Catch . Play as Tackle ( Caster 's rival and co-worker) during his final days of training before being hired by Chef Leurre . Test your platforming prowess, surf the sands, and get your feet wet catching some fish. This free title won't come close to reaching the depths of the upcoming full game, but we hope you'll find dipping your toes refreshing nonetheless! If you're hungry for more after this appetizer, do be sure to wishlist the full game! You're gonna want to finish this meal- once it's ready.
row.short_description: Crack open the Tacklebox to show off your platforming prowess and fishing skills in this free prologue to The Big Catch.

row.name: Poop Rocket
row.detailed_description: Poop Rocket is a casual game shooting your way through debris and aliens before the poop power meter runs out.  Avoid the debris and aliens, or you'll take damage and die.  The game is controlled with your keyboard.   Use the arrows to navigate and the space bar to drop bombs on enemies.  The game is currently on one level.  Go for your highest score with each play.  Enjoy this sci-fi 2-D shooter with custom hand-drawn assets.   To learn about the commander of Poop Rocket, read below.  Commander Smigo, an unremarkable fellow with an unpredictable stomach, found himself on a routine mission to scout habitable planets. Fate had a different plan. In the midst of his voyage, Smigo's rocket suffered a catastrophic explosion while he was nestled in the ship's restroom. Miraculously shielded by the bathroom's sturdy walls, Smigo survived the blast but was marooned in the vast expanse of space Now adrift, Smigo's only means of propulsion came from his incessant need to relieve himself. This bodily function would serve as his sole weapon and defense mechanism against the perils of space. Amidst the swirling debris and lurking extraterrestrial dangers, Smigo's journey is fraught with peril. To complicate matters further, Smigo has to carefully manage his intake of sustenance and coffee to sustain his constant bodily activity. In the vacuum of space, every sip and morsel could mean the difference between survival and death. As Smigo navigates the cosmos, he faces a myriad of challenges, from evading space junk to fending off lost alien entities. Yet, with his indomitable spirit and a peculiar arsenal of poop, Smigo ventured forth, determined to conquer the unknown and locate a new planet to call home.
row.short_description: Poop Rocket is a casual sci-fi 2D shooter game. Bomb your way through debris and aliens before the poop power meter runs out.  Avoid the debris and aliens, or you'll take damage and die.  The game is controlled with your keyboard.   Use the arrows to navigate and the space bar to drop bombs.

row.name: NoteCaptor
row.detailed_description: A video game that can help you learn to read musical notes ! 'NoteCaptor' helps you memorize most common notes on both treble clef and bass clef. It's a great tool for people who want to learn music, especially beneficial for those learning to play the piano. You don't need any prior knowledge or experience; it's beginner-friendly! For more info:
row.short_description: Learning to read music notes can sometimes be challenging for beginners. I developed this little game hoping it will help you.

row.name: Battle of Goldfish Scooping
row.detailed_description: 'Battle of Goldfish Scooping'  is an asymmetrical multiplayer action game inspired by kingyo-sukui , the classic goldfish scooping game from Japanese fairs. Scoop with Delicate Skill Use your poi —a fragile paper scoop—to catch goldfish and drop them into the bowl. Scoop them one after another to trigger combos and earn bonus points! Play as a Goldfish and Escape! Take on the role of a goldfish and dart through the water to avoid the poi. Collect glowing orbs to raise your score—and even if you’re scooped up, bounce your way to freedom! Grow Stronger Each Time You Play Earn new skills and boost your stats based on your results after each match. Keep playing, keep improving, and aim for the high score! Join the Festival Online Dive into a shared tank with players from around the world! But be careful—other players might steal your catch! A playful twist on a timeless Japanese festival tradition. Will you scoop—or be scooped? Regarding Streaming and Video Content We welcome gameplay streaming and the posting of gameplay videos for this game. There are no specific restrictions on monetization.
row.short_description: 'Battle of Goldfish Scooping' is an asymmetrical multiplayer action game. Players take on the roles of scoops and goldfish to aim for high scores. Based on your previous play results, you can acquire skills and enhance parameters to aim for even higher scores!

row.name: Animal Adventure
row.detailed_description: Game Description [Animal Adventure] is a platformer party game where you combine various animal characters and spirits to jump over obstacles. You can enjoy the game with your friends or alone! Choose a cute animal character and use your skills to disrupt your opponents! Each animal has a different skill. Lead your team to victory by blowing away or disrupting opponents who come near you. Choose two spirits of your choice for your animal characters and play with strategy! Each spirit has a different skill that can be used for each spirit, just like the character. Create your own skill set and use it in battle. The key may be to make good use of each character's ultimate skill! Each character's unique ultimate skill makes a big difference as a strategic element in the game. Experience successful play by reading and predicting your opponent's strategy when using the ultimate skill. Enjoy easy play with easy controls! The controls are very simple. Move with the W, A, S, D keys and jump with the space key. General skills are used with the left and right mouse buttons. And the ultimate skill that can change the game's course can be used with the Left-Shift key.
row.short_description: Animal Adventure is a party game that uses familiar animal characters to help you overcome obstacles to reach your destination. It combines PVE elements through various obstacles and PVP elements through competition between players.

row.name: Hidden Chibis in Combinis
row.detailed_description: Hidden Chibis in Combinis surf on the hidden object games wave with these cute little Chibis hidden in Combinis. 60 Chibis are waiting for you to be discovered within a hand-drawn background. It can't be more easy: Found a Chibi? Click on It!
row.short_description: Hidden Chibis in Combinis is a FREE hidden object game asking you to find cute Chibis hidden in Combinis. Can you find them all?

row.name: From Them
row.detailed_description: Fight Back Against the Nightmare Your quiet town has been overrun by horrifying creatures from another dimension. With nowhere else to turn, you'll need to use your wits and scavenged supplies to survive. Raid the local hardware store to build defenses and traps. Gear up at the gun shop to unleash firepower on the encroaching horde. Find notes left by residents to learn more about the invasion. Six Nights of Terror For six terrifying nights, you'll need to strategize, build, and fight your way through relentless waves of increasingly monstrous enemies. Each night brings a new challenge, pushing your ammo count and defenses to the limit. From Them also features an infinite mode, letting you test your mettle against a never-ending onslaught of creatures. Can you survive the endless horde? Learn by Doing (and Seeing!) From Them comes with the full Unreal Engine 5 project files, giving you a unique opportunity to see exactly how it was built. Whether you're a complete beginner or someone who likes to poke around, From Them provides valuable insights into the Unreal Engine development process. Are you ready to defend your town... From Them?
row.short_description: A short first person wave defense surrounding mutant creatures invading your town. Collect materials and fire power from the hardware and gun store, build traps to defend yourself, and survive 6 nights. Comes with Unreal Engine 5 project files.

row.name: Women's School Simulator 2022
row.detailed_description: School simulation game 2022 edition Achieved 1 million downloads for the entire series A school simulator game that recreates a girls' school with cherry blossoms on a small anime-style island. You control the yandere-like protagonist and attend classes, participate in club activities, buy sweets, and go to the beach. You can also eat and drink at cafes, sushi restaurants, and restaurants on the beach. You can also play together at the new amusement park attractions. Club activities include a soccer club, rugby club, and basketball club. You can also confess to increase your likeability. ・Method of operation (keyboard operation) A: Move left D: Move right W: Move up S: Move back [Shift] Run [Space] Jump [T] Talk to people nearby [F] Use the items you have [Q] Pick up nearby items/Release items [F1] Menu [F2] Change clothes [F3] Action [F4] Fly in the sky (Mouse operation) Mouse L Click + Mouse Move: Camera Move ・School timetable 8:30-9:00. School attendance 9:00-9:40　1st hour 10:00-10:40 2nd hour 11:00-11:40 3rd hour 12:00-13:00 Lunch 13:00-13:40 4th hour 14:00-14:40 5th hour 15:00-15:40 6th hour 15:40-18:00 Club activity time 18:00- Return home
row.short_description: School simulation game 2022 edition. A school simulator game that recreates a girls' school with cherry blossoms on a small anime-style island. You control the yandere-like protagonist and attend classes, participate in club activities, buy sweets, and go to the beach.

row.name: Horatio: Connector 13
row.detailed_description: Experience Chapter 1 for FREE! 'Horatio’s Life' thrusts players into an extraordinary journey that transcends reality, following the unexpected encounter of Akio, a young university student, with a visually stunning visual novel game. By a twist of fate at a game convention, Akio inadvertently purchases 'Horatio’s Life' instead of the fighting game recommended by his friend Daniel. What begins as a simple mistake transforms into a gripping adventure as Akio delves into the depths of the game's narrative. As Akio navigates the game's prompts, he unlocks hidden truths about his past and his mother's enigmatic legacy. A chance discovery of a hidden achievement, ominously titled 'THE LOSER,' sets in motion a series of events that intertwine Akio's fate with that of Renna, the daughter of Rolando, the game's creator. Together, they embark on a quest to save Rolando from a mysterious illness, guided by cryptic clues and the echoes of Akio's mother's wisdom. With stunning visuals, compelling storytelling, and immersive gameplay, 'Horatio’s Life' offers an unforgettable gaming experience that challenges perceptions and sparks the imagination. Prepare to embark on a journey beyond imagination, where every decision shapes the destiny of two worlds in this captivating visual novel adventure.
row.short_description: Akio's accidental encounter with 'Horatio’s Life' leads to a mysterious journey intertwining his past with a parallel world. Unravel secrets, confront otherworldly threats, and uncover the truth in this atmospheric adventure.

row.name: Emerald Dreams: Sanity -  Platformer Quest
row.detailed_description: Game Description Emerald Dreams: Sanity - Platformer Quest is an exciting 2.5D platformer and adventure Metroidvania that takes you on a journey through mysterious worlds filled with puzzles to solve and treacherous monsters to defeat. The game offers a rich story set in a dark fantasy universe where every decision you make can lead to one of multiple endings (Multiple Endings). Key Features • Multi-layered gameplay and unique puzzles: Expect not just in-game challenges but also puzzles that extend beyond the game itself, encouraging you to seek answers outside the traditional game environment. Explore dark corners and unlock hidden areas in classic Metroidvania style. • Sanity system: Immerse yourself in the psychological state of your character, which influences their perception of the world and unlocks new possibilities and storylines. Every step in your Exploration alters your perspective on the unfolding events. • Free game with community support: Emerald Dreams: Sanity is available for free to ensure everyone can enjoy our project. Support us by purchasing an exclusive art book or making a small voluntary contribution, and your name will be credited in the game. The game has an Indie vibe, showcasing a unique approach to world-building. • Interactive elements beyond the game: Experience a game that extends beyond the screen, where interacting with external files and websites is crucial to your progress. • Psychological horror: Immerse yourself in a psychological horror that blurs the lines between game and reality, keeping you on edge even after you turn off your computer. • Rich narrative and multiple endings: Explore a rich narrative with multiple endings, driven by your choices and the ever-shifting state of your character's mind. • Atmospheric world and intricate mechanics: Uncover a beautifully crafted pixel world filled with eerie locations and haunting music, designed to pull you deeper into its dark fantasy setting. Why Early Access? We chose the early access model to allow players to immerse themselves in our world and help us improve it. Your feedback and support will help us create the best possible gaming experience, adding new exciting elements like levels and characters. Dive into the game's atmosphere and uncover its mysteries. Current Development Stage The game already has a main storyline and unique game mechanics, but we need to fine-tune the balance and add new levels and characters. We are actively working to make the game as engaging and full of surprises as possible. Journey through dark kingdoms, meet strange creatures, and navigate complex platforming levels. How Long Will Early Access Last? We plan to stay in early access for about a year to gather feedback and make all necessary improvements. Your support will help us create the best final product, which will include new action and gameplay possibilities. What Will Be Different in the Full Version? The full version of the game will include more levels, new characters, expanded storylines, and additional game modes. We also plan to add localization for several languages and port the game to consoles. Test your skills in challenging trials and face mighty bosses. How Do You Plan to Involve the Community? We actively engage with players through Steam forums and social media. Everyone who supports us financially will be credited in the game and will have a say in the project's development. Join our community and help us make the game better. Experience the intensity of the psychological challenges that lie ahead. Monetization Model The game will be free for all users. We offer two ways to support the development: 1. Purchase the art book: Support the project by buying an art book, which will allow you to enjoy unique illustrations and concept art. Appreciate the high quality of hand-drawn animation and unique style. 2. Voluntary donation : Support us with a small contribution and get your name in the game credits.
row.short_description: Emerald Dreams: Sanity - Platformer Quest is an exciting 2.5D platformer and adventure Metroidvania that takes you on a journey through mysterious worlds. The game offers a rich story set in a dark fantasy universe where every decision you make can lead to one of multiple endings.

row.name: JosPlays' Escape - GameJam April 2024
row.detailed_description: ScoreSpace Jam #29 This game was made for ScoreSpace Jam #29 and was created within one weekend. The theme of this game jam was ESCAPE . Which you have to in the game by collecting all 5 tools and make it to the exit. An extra requirement was to have a highscore system, this game will save the top 3 highscores and are calculated as followed: You start with 600 points, every tick a point is removed from your score. When you get attacked by a ghost you will lose points (so try to avoid them). Collecting the tools will increase your points. Also the ghost diamonds will increase your points. With every diamond you collect a new one will spawn, but be aware. With every diamond a new ghost will spawn and the follow range of the ghosts will increase. Changes The only changes made after the Jam are Steam changes. For example I have added achievements to make the game more enjoyable to play for people. And when bugs are found you can let me know in the discussions and I will try to fix it as well.
row.short_description: ESCAPE! Collect the 5 tools and escape from this creepy attic. Keep the score high by avoiding ghosts and collecting the ghost diamonds, but keep in mind with every diamond you collect, more ghosts will appear and they will become harder to avoid.

row.name: Irang
row.detailed_description: 'Irang' is an action-adventure game where you must use the power of four spells to defeat enemies threatening attack patterns. Explore vast regions to collect items that enhance and transform your spells. The more you collect, the more opportunities you'll have to face stronger foes. Enjoy on a journey to stop the Four Evil Beasts in a Joseon-inspired world, realized in the Metroidvania style. [Joseon, medieval Korean magic world view] 'Joseon,' the stage of Irang, is a magical fantasy world that reflects traditional Korean culture. Explore the world of Joseon drawn in a hand-drawn style. Be a 'lrang' who broke up with your parents due to an accident, and take a step closer to the secret of your born truth and world view. [Powerful power from the messenger. Magic] The envoy was a creature with mysterious and strange power, enriching the world and protecting it from threats. Their power was special, but they decided to share this power with the increasingly powerful attacks of the Four Evil Beasts Magic power spread around the faithful servants of the envoy, and Joseon was able to develop further. [The magic source, Narin] Unlike the spiritual envoy, a spell is needed to utilize the magic of a human furrow. The more you collect 'Narin', a special writing system unique to Joseon, the more diverse you can explore and use the power of a stronger spell. Gather the scripts to unlock powers, reach special locations, and complete the story.
row.short_description: Under the tyranny of the four-throated, magic collapsed and darkness fell. Irang embarks on a journey to find her missing family and uncover her birth's secret. In a Metroidvania-style adventure, she explores a decayed world, enhances envoy powers, and aims to restore the lost light.

row.name: Madoka Magica Magia Exedra
row.detailed_description: Characters from the anime series 'Puella Magi Madoka Magica' come together! Featuring an all-new story setting and characters from the original ideas of gekidan INU CURRY (Doroinu), experience the action alongside Magical Girl memories in this battle RPG! 'Now go. Unveil the memories of these Magical Girls.' ◆ Puella Magi Madoka Magica Magia Exedra Features - Dive into the 3D world of Madoka Magica! Magical Girls from throughout the series will appear as you relive their various stories from 'Puella Magi Madoka Magica', 'Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story', and more. - Powerful special attacks performed by series all-stars! Form a team of Magical Girls from throughout the series to take on powerful Witches lurking in Labyrinth lairs. - Explore Witch Labyrinths and relive Magical Girl memories! Dive deep into Witch Labyrinths that recreate the series' worldscapes for a fully immersive experience. ◆ Enter a Realm of Magical Memories! ◆ A place where the memories of Magical Girls illuminate the dark... The Lighthouse. Now a girl who's lost everything has wandered into its sanctum. Who am I...? How did I get here...? She will relive key moments of countless Magical Girls by opening windows into their memories... Trusting she'll one day find her own lost light of remembrance. ◆ Staff ◆ Planning and Distribution: Aniplex Inc. Development: Pokelabo, Inc. / f4samurai, Inc. Management: Pokelabo, Inc. ◆ Voice Cast ◆ Akari Komiyama, Ayana Taketatsu, Aoi Yuki, Chiwa Saito, Kaori Mizuhashi, Eri Kitamura, Ai Nonaka, Emiri Kato, Momo Asakura, Sora Amamiya, Shiina Natsukawa, Ayane Sakura, Yui Ogura, Manaka Iwami... ...and many more!
row.short_description: Characters from the hit anime series 'Puella Magi Madoka Magica' come together! Featuring an all-new story setting and characters from the original ideas of Gekidan Inu Curry (Doroinu), experience the action alongside Magical Girl memories in this battle RPG!

row.name: Rock the Islands
row.detailed_description: Rock the Islands - a cozy Idle Arcade game with grind elements and 5-player co-op. Team up with friends to explore mysterious islands: mine resources, rescue dwellers from the goblins, gather a gang of powerful bald men to fight back against your enemies! MINE THE ORE You need coins in order to buy anything here! Mine resources and gems, make profit by selling your loot to various traders, so you can afford upgrades, new pickaxe and unexplored lands. RESCUE THE DWELLERS Rescue dwellers from captivity so they can work for you! Make them mine resources in your base, or take them along so they protect you and mine resources with you! UPGRADE YOUR EQUIPMENT Upgrade your pickaxe, unlock new skills and get a better armor. Also don’t forget to upgrade your dwellers so they make profit for you and be well protected! DEFEND THE SETTLEMENT Goblins can raid your village! They use ships and boats to deliver reinforcements! Don’t let them land on your territory, as they can rob you! CO-OP You can play singleplayer, or team up with up to 5 players. It’s more fun to mine resources together! Share responsibilities and distribute the gathered resources for a common goal. MINIGAMES Engage in minigames hosted by strangers. Challenge bosses or be rewarded for killing waves of enemies on arena! FAQ Why is the game free-to-play? This is our first game. As of now our priority is to learn to work with Steam platform and receive feedback from our audience. How will you update the game? We are planning to release new patches to iterate our game and bring the best experience for users. But nothing serious. We are already preparing for our next big game! What does buying chips give? For chips, you can spin the roulette to acquire new skills. Keep in mind your ability to obtain chips for free by completing daily quests and risk it all by each spin on roulette. Purchasing chips or soundtrack is a great way to support us! Are you planning to add cards, items for the Points Shop? We are not sure of the criterias for such a game and it would be great to add trading cards and items for Point Shop in the upcoming future.
row.short_description: Team up with friends and dive into adventure! Rescue dwellers, let them work for you so they farm resources and protect you from enemies. Upgrade your equipment, explore new lands, complete quests and fight evil with glory!

row.name: Croquettes Gang
row.detailed_description: In Croquettes Gang, you play as Sneak & Snack, two pets whose goal is to steal as many kibbles as possible from your master's apartment to resell them to the local mouse gang, with a view to buying the legendary Golden Croquette. But the task will not be as easy as it seems! During the night your master is struck by a chaotic sleepwalking attack which will often endanger the plans of our two little animals. Your role: Steal as many kibbles as possible before the end of the night, while doing everything in your power to protect your master's sleep. Because if he wakes up, he will confiscate part of your loot from the night. In this online cooperative party game, you will have to organize with your partner to collect the most loot at night while monitoring the sleepwalkers' dreams which can impact the environment. Fire, floods, storms, you will have to manage these changes and many others by moving objects and making them interact together. Between each night, you will have the opportunity to spend your hard-earned kibble to obtain bonuses or unlock new rooms. Gang de Croquette was developed as part of the Ubisoft 2024 university competition and received 4 nominations (Best Art Direction, Technical Award, Theme Integration and Jury Prize)
row.short_description: Keep an eye on your master, steal his kibble and achieve your dream!

row.name: Temple of Shadows
row.detailed_description: Embark on an epic adventure as Sebastian Harrington, a passionate archeology grad student turned explorer, in search of his missing professor. Six weeks ago, Dr. Albert J. Montgomery III announced the discovery of a hidden temple, but he never returned. Now, Sebastian must dive into ancient temple ruins, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets. Will you reveal the mysteries within the Temple of Shadows? STORY AND GAMEPLAY Navigate the enigmatic Temple Ruins and unlock the secrets of the Temple Gate. Venture into the labyrinthine caves beyond, a realm filled with ancient mysteries and hidden dangers. Your mission: uncover the truth and track down the elusive Dr. Montgomery. Embark on this thrilling adventure and face challenges that will test your courage and wits at every turn. Can you reveal the secrets that lie within? PUZZLES AND SECRESTS Prepare to engage your mind with intricate puzzles that will challenge your every move. Manipulate buttons, doors, and moving panels to unlock pathways and reveal hidden secrets. Harness the power of light machines and light collectors to illuminate your path. BEWARE OF DANGERS Along the way, discover hidden passages and collect rare artifacts, each holding secrets that could aid you on your quest—or uncover a deeper mystery. But tread carefully. The temple is alive with dangers: shifting walls, treacherous traps, and ominous shadows waiting to ensnare the unwary. Every step forward could be your last. Will you brave the unknown, or will the temple claim you as its next victim? CHALLENGE YOUR MIND AND UNCOVER THE SECRETS Each puzzle is a test of your ingenuity, designed to challenge your wits and reward your determination. Hidden within the temple's depths are secrets and collectibles waiting to be uncovered by those clever and persistent enough to seek them out. Solve ancient puzzles, unlock forbidden chambers, and piece together the story of the shadows. Will you rise to the challenge and unravel the temple’s mysteries, or will its secrets remain buried forever? COLLECTABLES AND SPEED-RUN MODE Uncover the mysteries of Temple of Shadows by collecting hidden relics, including ancient Drawings, Gold Statues, and the Professor's personal belongings. Each item reveals a deeper layer of the story and the madness lurking within the temple. For the ultimate challenge, test your skills in Speedrun challenge—perfect your path, solve puzzles with precision, and race against the clock to set your best time. Can you conquer the shadows faster than anyone else?  EXPLORE AND DISCOVER Look for new pathways to uncover hidden areas and unlock the temple's most guarded secrets. Every step off the beaten path could lead to rare and valuable items, rewarding the bold and curious. Will you uncover treasures long forgotten, or leave them hidden in the shadows? The choice is yours. A TEST OF WITS AND SANITY Temple of Shadows will push your ingenuity to its limits while keeping you on edge at every turn. The uncertainty of what lies ahead—be it danger, mystery, or madness—might unravel your resolve before you ever find your way out. Do you have the strength to face the unknown, or will the shadows claim your mind?
row.short_description: Join Sebastian Harrington, an archeology student, on a quest to find his missing professor. Explore ancient temple ruins, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets in the Temple of Shadows.

row.name: Crabity
row.detailed_description: A 2.5D co-op puzzle platformer where the players control a small robot crab attempting to return back home to Earth. Unbeknownst to them, they are the sole survivors from a dilapidated space station. One robot crab harnesses the power of gravity manipulation, bending the laws of physics as they please. The other harnesses control over the space station, rotating the orientation to their liking. With these gifts, you must shift the world around you and explore every avenue if there is any hope of escape.
row.short_description: Embark on a cosmic adventure as a duo of two robot crabs stranded in the vastness of space. See the world from a different angle and utilize the power of gravity to escape the space station and return back to Earth!

row.name: Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough
row.detailed_description: 'Who is the Defendant' is a spin-off of 'The Real Faces of VTuber,' a demo we presented at a gaming expo before announcing the main theme. It introduces 'The Real Faces of VTuber' in a humorous and light-hearted manner, showcasing the same courtroom gameplay. The playtime is 15 minutes. Game Features Players will act as a prosecutor. Some unscrupulous game developers have released a game on STEAM with rudimentary art. Players will work with prosecution witnesses in court to obtain favorable testimony through proper questioning. Facing defense witnesses, they will present evidence in hand to point out inconsistencies in the testimonies. The goal is to win the trial and uphold justice for the public. Through this free game, we collect player feedback, conduct localization testing, and promote our new work 'The Real Faces of VTuber.' If it brings a smile to your face, that would be our honor!
row.short_description: 'Who is the Defendant' is a mystery genre visual novel. Players take on the role of a prosecutor, investigating a case involving 'a game with rudimentary art published on STEAM.'

row.name: Puzzle Garden
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Puzzle Garden, your very own virtual farm! Relax, turn up the music, and immerse yourself in the casual world of farming and puzzle-solving. Puzzle Garden features 8 casual puzzles for you to play through. Each one is hand-crafted to have you strategizing and planning to make the most amount of money before the end of the season. Try and collect all 24 stars! Explore: Dive into unique garden layouts with distinct challenges, and discover the optimal layout that balances beauty and bounty! Strategize: Maximize your profits by using each plot of land to its fullest potential! Plant Fun Crops: Utilize each crop's unique ability to earn all 3 stars per level! Make Beautiful Gardens: Enjoy the fruits (or vegetables) of your labor and see your garden fully realized! Relax: Chill out to a custom soundtrack and simple visuals to unwind after a long day. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A short, casual puzzle game where you utilize unique land layouts and crop abilities to maximize your profit.

row.name: Starstream
row.detailed_description: Reclaiming what's rightfully yours among the stars! Prepare to journey through a starry filled castle in Starstream , where the quest to reclaim your castle from the treacherous Lord Nova awaits. Gather your weapons, master the powerful and versatile Starshift , and embark on an epic adventure to restore order to the realm. The stars align for your triumphant return!
row.short_description: Starstream is a 3D action-adventure shooter. In it, the brave Arlen must reclaim Castle Starstream, seized by the corrupt Lord Nova. Arlen battles through the Keep, Great Halls, and Startower to confront Lord Nova and free the Castle.

row.name: tranceWave NEO
