row.detailed_description: tranceWave NEO is a classic arcade twin-stick shmup, inspired by others in the 'trance shooter' genre. Move, shoot, survive, and aim for a high score! Waves of enemies will continually spawn, and you must eliminate them before they eliminate you. The core gameplay is easy to pick up, but aiming for a high score requires focus and strategy. A full in-game guide is included, which explains everything you will need to know to top the leaderboards. Good luck!
row.short_description: tranceWave NEO is a classic arcade twin-stick shmup, inspired by others in the 'trance shooter' genre. Move, shoot, survive, and aim for a high score!

row.name: Phoenix Contract
row.detailed_description: Phoenix Contract is an exhilarating MMORPG that immerses you in a world teeming with adventure, mystery, and relentless battles. In this dynamic universe, you'll forge your legend by customizing your character, mastering unique skills, and embarking on epic quests. Engage in fierce PvP combat to prove your supremacy, challenge towering bosses for legendary rewards, and unlock the secrets of powerful heirlooms. Join forces with allies to conquer realms and shape the fate of the world. Your destiny awaits in Phoenix Contract—a realm where heroes rise, legends are born, and the adventure never ends. Gameplay: Forge Your Legend Customize Your Path Dominate Arenas Rise as PvP Champion Challenge Boss Seize Epic Triumphs Hone Expertise Unleash Mastery's Might Unite Forces Conquer Realms Together
row.short_description: Phoenix Contract is an exhilarating MMORPG that immerses you in a world teeming with adventure, mystery, and relentless battles. Your destiny awaits in Phoenix Contract—a realm where heroes rise, legends are born, and the adventure never ends.

row.name: POOBO
row.detailed_description: Are you ready to become the hero of cleanliness? In the POOBO universe, you are a tiny and cute poop trying to escape the toilet and survive! Fight against hundreds, even thousands of bacteria while creating the ultimate weapon combinations to claim victory. Choose Your Character! Equip Your First Weapon! At the start of the game, you’ll need to make an important decision: choose your first weapon! Each weapon has unique abilities—some are great for close combat, while others help you defeat enemies from a distance. You can carry up to 6 weapons, so plan strategically and pick your first weapon to begin your adventure. Level Up! Upgrade Your Abilities. You’ve leveled up! Each level gives you the chance to make your character even stronger. Choose a card to enhance your stats! If you don’t get the abilities you’re looking for, you can reshuffle the cards and try again. Equip New Weapons! You can equip up to 6 weapons and 6 items at the same time. Each round gives you a chance to renew and upgrade your arsenal. Make the right choices to boost your power and dominate your enemies! Upgrade Your Weapons! Enhance your weapons and items in your inventory to increase your strength. To do this, you’ll need at least 2 of the same weapon or item. With each upgrade, you’ll grow stronger and gain an edge against your enemies!
row.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelike where you play as a tiny and adorable poop fighting off bacteria. Upgrade your weapons and items to escape the toilet and claim victory!

row.name: Pocket Waifu: Desktop Pet
row.detailed_description: Want a cute little friend to keep you company during those long work or gaming sessions? Pocket Waifu is your new adorable 3D chibi desktop companion! She'll hang out on your other monitor while you're working, or entertain you while you play other games! Adopt little Silvy and interact with her in various ways while she hangs out on your desktop. Features: • Achievements! • Simple and easy to use UI • Gorgeous 3D model and physics interactions • Many settings options to customize your experience and performance optimizations. • Over 80 unique animations and a variety of expressions, custom props, and foods. • Compatible with all other games, software, and live wallpapers Pat her head, boop her nose, or yeet her across your screen when she gets in your way! Play video games, ride a roomba across your screen, or dance to keep her entertained! Stream, clean the screen, catch bugs and mine minerals to earn money for food, gifts and upgrades! Come back everyday, pet her head, and make her discover new food to increase her affection for you! When she loves you enough, she'll draw you a cute sketch and you'll unlock a gorgeous new background and new fun interactions! Planned Features: • CHAOS MODE (she will be very disruptive in very fun ways!) • More interactions • More gaming and work activities • Accessories, outfits, and customizations earned through gameplay • To Do list and Pomodoro timer • Other language translations
row.short_description: Elevate your desktop experience by adopting a desktop waifu! Similar to a tamagotchi, she will keep you company on your desktop while you work or play other games! Pat her head, feed her snacks, give her plushies, or go fishing. Bring a little joy and cozy vibes to your daily routine!
row.notes: Mild cartoonish sexual humor

row.name: 三國幻想戰記
row.detailed_description: 《三國幻想戰記》是一款日系角色扮演輕戰棋遊戲，身處東漢末年時期群雄割據，主公們可以尋訪招募武將，善用策略以及兵種克制來取得戰鬥勝利，感受截然不同的三國幻想之旅！ ◆壯闊絢麗的幻想『演武』 主線劇情以正史《三國志》與大量正史軼聞為基礎進行改編。 故事線囊括魏、蜀、吳、群雄等多條歷史線的發展，更在重要情節上註明典籍出處。主公不僅能看到耳熟能詳的典故，也能了解到許多三國正史上少為人知的軼聞故事，獲得全新的歷史知識。 ◆自定義你的三國『人生』 從出生開始，你的身世皆可自行選擇，甚至武器的自由搭配，都由你決定，從身世的謎團中汲取力量和智慧，塑造出一個屬於自己的傳奇故事！同時，每一次的對話抉擇都將影響你未來的志向和數值，你可以選擇保護弱者，或是利用他們來達成自己的目標。 ◆100%開放式大世界『探索』 在中原大陸上不僅可以尋找你心儀的武將，更有機會探尋三國世界地圖上的奇珍異寶、名馬神兵！遊戲中還有許多祕境迷宮與奇遇事件，處處彩蛋讓你大呼過癮。主公可以化身摸金校尉，在祕境古蹟中破解一道道難題，獲得傳世秘寶，增強己方部隊的實力！ ◆首創輕戰棋社交『合戰』 全新PVP社交玩法，玩家競技的校武場、跨服PK的點將台、1對1單挑的擂台戰，應有盡有！除了單人競技，更有公會聯盟戰，與你的夥伴們同心協力，邁向更加高級的團體獎勵吧！
row.short_description: 日系微操大世界策略戰棋SRPG登場！滿足你的幻想人生演武！重返三國榮耀的起點，見證劉關張三兄弟結拜、親身感受曹操的雄霸崛起！沉浸感、策略感十足！三國歷史由你開拓！

row.name: Reberryon
row.detailed_description: Lead a Reberryon in this casual RTS game. An action strategy war game set in a cutesy fruity wonderland that combines 3D platforming with RTS elements​ Features : 3 Troop types. Steam Achievements. 3 Special abilities. Casual RTS. Epic Boss Battle.
row.short_description: An action strategy war game set in a cutesy fruity wonderland that combines 3D platforming with RTS elements​

row.name: Up Down All-a-Round
row.detailed_description: Up Down All-a-Round is a fast paced online pvp first person shooter, where you control your player's gravity up and down and all a round! Master your gravity manipulating abilites to outwit your opponents and win the game! At the moment Up Down All-a-Round features 4 game modes, Forever Free For All, Free For All, 4v4s and 2v2s with one more gamemode being worked on! Oh there is also a training room to practice your gravity manipulating abilites! *Please note customization options shown in this gif are not available in the base game* HOW TO PLAY Speaking of gravity manipulating abilites how do you use them? Great question, Up Down All-a-Round's controls are relaltivly simple but are hard to master. You use WASD to move around and the mouse to look around, R to reload and space to jump but they are other controls to take into a count! You control your gravity left and right with the shift left and right buttons which are set to Q and E by default, and control your gravity going up and down with the shift up/down button which is set to the left shift button by default. If you are shifting your gravity left or right and find yourself stuck to a wall, you need to press the stop button which is defaulted to tab. To stop shifting your gravity left or right. Master the gravity manipulating abilites and you will have a great time!
row.short_description: Control your player's gravity up and down and all a round! Master your gravity manipulating abilites to outwit your opponents and win the game!

row.name: RAGE: Anger Management
row.detailed_description: The Realm of Rage was a secret place, hidden from the eyes of mortals and gods alike. It was created by an ancient wizard, whose name was lost to time, as a sanctuary for himself and his fellow adventures. There, they could unleash their anger and frustration on anything they desired, without fear of consequences or death. RAGE was a paradise for those who sought to vent their emotions and test their skills. They could smash, burn, freeze, or destroy anything they wanted, without harming anyone or anything in the real world. They could not die in the realm, as the wizard’s magic would heal them and restore them to life. However, they could still feel pain, and lose their items or memories, if they were not careful. RAGE was also a source of mystery and adventure, as the wizard had hidden many secrets and challenges in it. That rewarded the clever and the brave. There were also rare and powerful items, spells, and creatures, that could only be found or obtained in the realm of RAGE. Some of these were gifts from the wizard, while others were stolen or borrowed from other worlds. RAGE was a wonder and a danger, as the wizard was not always benevolent or sane. The realm of Rage, is the ultimate playground for the anyone looking to unleash your anger and relieve stress and experience destruction with out consequences. Features: - Rage does away with frustration and goes back to basics with 4 devastating attacks for each character. - Collect coins, gems, and more by smashing everything in sight. - Unlock new characters and upgrades by visiting the shop. - Unique gameplay in that there is no health bar, beat levels by reducing your rage bar in order to summon and defeat the bosses!
row.short_description: Step into the exhilarating world of *Rage*, where you smash everything in sight and gather heaps of gold coins and treasures. Perfect for unwinding after a long day or taking a break from intense gaming, Rage offers satisfying gameplay that lets you release pent-up energy in a fun-filled adventure!

row.name: THOKO
row.detailed_description: THOKO is a thrilling single-player first-person shooter platformer that combines fast-paced action with innovative movement mechanics. Dive into a world where precision, speed, and agility are your greatest allies. Master advanced techniques such as strafing, BHOP (bunny hopping), and surfing to navigate challenging environments and outmaneuver your enemies. Featuring stunning animations and cutting-edge visual effects, THOKO delivers an immersive gaming experience like no other. Get ready to test your skills and push your limits in this adrenaline-pumping adventure. 🔫 Key Features: First-person shooter platformer gameplay Advanced movement mechanics: strafing, BHOP, and surfing High-quality animations and visual effects Challenging and dynamic environments Stay tuned for more updates, and don't forget to like, comment, and subscribe to our channel for the latest news on THOKO! Join the THOKO community: Join our Discord: Please note that THOKO is still in development. I invite you to enjoy the game, test it out, and help me improve by providing your suggestions and references for future levels in the comments. Your feedback is invaluable to me!
row.short_description: THOKO is a thrilling single-player first-person shooter platformer that combines fast-paced action with innovative movement mechanics. Dive into a world where precision, speed, and agility are your greatest allies. Master advanced techniques such as strafing, BHOP (bunny hopping), and surfing.

row.name: Revenant
row.detailed_description: 'Revenant' tells the story of a chilling tradition that prevailed in medieval England: arrested criminals would be stripped of a part of their skin to make a 'human skin book' before being executed, to permanently record their crimes. These books are said to have mystical spirituality, carrying the evil spirits of their masters, leading those who wield them to destruction. Players will travel to a world full of mystery and horror. The text information in the game plays a key role in helping players understand the storyline and providing them with clues to solve puzzles and escape from difficulties. Survival Escape, that is, with plot, horror and decryption as the core. Players need to hide and escape to protect their lives, and the interior furniture in the game environment provides a great place to hide and help keep the game going.
row.short_description: Plot, horror and decryption are the core. Players need to hide and escape to protect their lives, and the interior furniture in the game environment provides a great place to hide and help keep the game going.

Insert Item Apocalypse
row.detailed_description: Insert Item Apocalypse - interactive 3D puzzle in genre 'find and click'. In the game you will find yourself in a world after the apocalypse, where everything is abandoned and devastated. You will have to fly around the map and search for various items in this dangerous world. Travel through destroyed cities, abandoned forests, and radiation zones to find all the necessary items. Explore a world full of many details, conveying the spirit of the aftermath of a major man-made disaster. Can you gather all the resources you need in this merciless world of the apocalypse?
row.short_description: Insert Item Apocalypse - interactive 3D puzzle in genre 'find and click'. Explore a world full of many details, conveying the spirit of the aftermath of a major man-made disaster.

row.name: Z Rush
row.detailed_description: Z Rush is an exciting strategic 3D game where your task is to place zombies in such a way that they can destroy all the turrets on the level. Progress through levels, fight against various types of turrets, use different types of zombies and their abilities to achieve victory. Choose the right strategies to overcome all obstacles and reach your goal. Zombies, turrets, the environment - all of this awaits you in 'Z Rush'. Are you ready for the challenge and can you destroy all the turrets with your zombies? Test yourself in this exciting strategy game and see if you have what it takes!
row.short_description: Z Rush is an exciting strategic 3D game where your task is to place zombies in such a way that they can destroy all the turrets on the level.

row.name: Survive the Squids
row.detailed_description: Nobody knows where they came from. But they are here, and they want every one of us. Survivors must band together to survive - and maybe even banish the squid menace altogether. Though the Planetary Emergency Force is too busy striking the enemy where it hurts to protect everyone, they can supply us with Weapons and Support in return for Squid Samples. All that's left is to slay the enemy and save as many as we can, before it's too late. Survive the Squids is a survivors-like focused on building a squad of survivors. Start with one survivor, and as the game progresses pick up more to add to the squad. Squad members can be armed with a variety of weapons (5 in total!). As the player kills Squids, they will drop Squid Samples - when enough of these have been collected it will trigger a level up, allowing the player to select a variety of upgrades such as Shotgun Shells, Chain-Fed Ammo, and more. Survive as long as you can to get the best high score! Recruit up to 4 squad members Collect Squid Samples to earn new gear Equip your squad they way you'd like Simple, action-packed gameplay that still scratches that squad-based, army-building itch
row.short_description: The Squids are here - but your soldiers are ready. Grow your squad up to 4 members by rescuing survivors. Obtain the best weapons, support, and equipment you can by gathering Squid Samples. Become a force to be reckoned with, one the Squids will fear for generations to come.
row.notes: There is pixelated blood and general violence depicted in this game.

row.name: Apocalypse Delivery Service
row.detailed_description: Apocalypse Delivery Service is an exciting survival and adventure game. You will enter a post-apocalyptic world where you play as a courier delivering packages. But don't think it will be easy! Your task is to find necessary items, survive, and most importantly, escape from the city. Here's what awaits you: 3D world: The game is presented in three-dimensional graphics, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the post-apocalyptic world. Item search: You will need to carefully explore the environment to find necessary items. It could be a door key, medicine, or other resources that will help you survive. So get ready for an exciting adventure where every step could cost you your life
row.short_description: Apocalypse Delivery Service is an exciting survival and adventure game. You will enter a post-apocalyptic world where you play as a courier delivering packages. But don't think it will be easy! Your task is to find necessary items, survive, and most importantly, escape from the city.

row.name: Airport Antiterror
row.detailed_description: This is an exciting 3D shooter game set in an airport that has become the center of a zombie apocalypse. You will have to fight hordes of zombies, gather resources, and build a plane to escape. But will you be able to? Features of this game: -Brutal zombie attacks: Zombies surround you. You will have to use various strategies to survive. -Resource gathering: You will need to search for items and parts for the plane. Collect everything that can be useful for survival. -3D graphics: Immerse yourself in the world of the zombie apocalypse. -Dynamic battles: Battles with zombies will be intense and adrenaline-filled. Use a variety of weapons to destroy enemies.
row.short_description: This is an exciting 3D shooter game set in an airport that has become the center of a zombie apocalypse. You will have to fight hordes of zombies, gather resources, and build a plane to escape. But will you be able to?

row.name: I Did It ALL for the COOKIE!
row.detailed_description: You are hanging out at a festive Christmas party when your eyes discover the most perfect Christmas confectionery ever! You must have it!... but someone already has it! What will you be willing to do, to get your Christmas wish? A festive visual novel for one and all. FEATURES: Quick and fun to play Visual Novel (about 2,400 words) 5 different endings It's FREEEEEEEE! Your choices matter!
row.short_description: You are hanging out at a festive Christmas party when your eyes discover the most perfect Christmas confectionery ever! You must have it!... but someone already has it! What will you be willing to do, to get your Christmas wish?

row.name: Greedy Goose
row.detailed_description: You play as a brave goose who has decided to embark on an exciting journey. Your goal is to reach the end of the level, collecting as many coins as possible. But there are several obstacles in your way: Roads: Busy roads await you, with cars speeding along them. You need to carefully cross the road to avoid getting hit. Floating logs: The goose can't swim, but luckily there are floating logs for him to use. Stand on them to cross rivers and lakes. Coins: Along your journey, you will find coins. Collect them to increase your score. Good luck in this thrilling adventure.
row.short_description: You play as a brave goose who has decided to embark on an exciting journey. Your goal is to reach the end of the level, collecting as many coins as possible.

row.name: Dull Acres
row.detailed_description: A lost soul traipses across the dull acres-- a stark, ever-shifting forest of regular clearings and uniform thickets. Encounter the zany, muddled presences who have long since lost any desire to explore. Before long, your curiosity will be depleted in turn. A tiresome, nonlinear parade of meaningless chance meetings and inexplicable sights. Your voice was the first thing you lost. There's something between the trees. Night has fallen.
row.short_description: You strayed from the path. Now you are doomed to wander the woods.

row.name: Hyperchannel
row.detailed_description: Hyperchannal is a delightful first-person endless shooting casual game that immerses players in a whimsical world inspired by the classic rubber hose animation style . This nostalgic yet dynamic visual aesthetic, reminiscent of early 20th-century cartoons, gives the game a unique charm that sets it apart from other casual shooters. With its simple yet engaging mechanics, Hyperchannal aims to bring players pure, unadulterated fun in a bite-sized package. Designed as a perfect time-killer , Hyperchannal is ideal for those short moments when you're waiting for other games to load, downloads to finish, or simply looking for a quick escape. Each round promises fast-paced action, intuitive controls, and endless opportunities to hone your skills and beat your previous high score.
row.short_description: This is a free shooting game. The game has very simple operations and beautiful graphics. Great for killing time.

row.name: COS-249
row.detailed_description: Welcome to your new job. You will be viewing a recording of COS-249. The test subject is Ë̡̻̰͍̩̱̰́-̡̳͓̹̘̰͂͋̄̏̈́͊̌͌͌́͝͝͠3̧̮͓̖̭̻͙̼̮͒̿͒͗̄͂7̤̝̣̣͓͈̻͚̗̺̪̙̈́̊̄̊͘̚͝ͅ6̛͖̟͇̩̘͕͊̓͐̃̓̈̈̈͐́̚ he will be recording his full experience in the room. The room is full of anomalous objects and entities. The only objective is to stay alive. But don't worry there is c͕̻̺̙̙͕̠͙̗̽̃͆̒͐̈́́͒͌̆̊̈̓̇̈́́̃̿̆̄̑͘͜á̧̱͍̻͙̼̝̞̭̰̼̼͓͇̤̹͍̘͈̺̻̝̭̦̠̩̞̐͌̾̀̒̀̀̑̂̍͘̕͝ͅk̡̛̮͊͆͋̉̑̍̏͊͌́̌̀́͝ę̯̘̤̟̰͇̩͙̤̹͈̝̮͙̬͓̳̗̲̤̟̮́͌̆͐̍̈́́̍͝͝ͅͅͅ at the end. row.name: The Heavens
row.detailed_description: This kinetic visual novel is a short story that will brighten your evening and perhaps make you think. Description: Not many know that angels—the young souls—live up in the clouds. There, they await their turn to be reborn into the world. Yet that fate is only reserved for the purest among them, and the corrupted angels fall to the ground with the rain. One day, Luke decides to take a peek at what's down there, on the earth, and his cloud descends. Having done that, he disturbed the peace of his brothers and sisters, and it's getting more and more difficult to keep grace in the Heavens. Will he be able to return things to normal? Game features: Short, but breath-taking story that will immerse you in a unique world Pastel-colored graphics, supplemented with animations, that will make you float in the heavens along with the game's characters An original soundtrack permeated with grace
row.short_description: Ascend to the Heavens and find out if you're pure enough to be reborn on the Earth.

row.name: For Whom the Stars Shine
row.detailed_description: 'Some stories are best told to none,' she whispered. Long ago, the stars disappeared. Then, a man returned them. Few would believe such a thing; fewer still can recall his name or how he bent the heavens' ears. It's a story of romance and tragedy that the stars themselves testify of to this day. However, you won't find the tale in books or archives—only in the hearts of those who were there. For Whom the Stars Shine is a short kinetic visual novel—a story without choices or branching paths created by New Dialog and cowritten by Pony with a Pen. Character sprites were drawn by Ruvik, and all background art was created by GoodDay.
row.short_description: 'Some stories are best told to none,' she whispered. Long ago, the stars disappeared. Then, a man returned them. Few would believe such a thing; fewer still can recall how he bent heaven's ear. However, you won't find the tale in books or archives—only in the hearts of those who were there.

row.name: GMU Blastmaster Battle
row.detailed_description: GMU Blastmaster Battle by Studio 410 is a colorful reimagining of the classic Bomberman formula with a healthy dose of GMU spirit. Play as one of four GMU-themed characters and blast your way to victory using a multitude of powerups over three beautiful stages! Here are some features to expect from Blastmaster Battle: - Fight Your Friends: Up to four players can play via keyboard or controller in local PvP or virtually through a third party such as Parsec. Only XBOX or similar controllers are supported; button 1 is A, button 2 is B. Back is the Start button. - Gamemodes: The major gameplay change that's being implemented in v1.1 is the addition of optional gamemodes. They can do many things, from changing small stuff like what drops when to big things like starting a match with no blocks or even changing bomb types every couple seconds! They can be disabled in settings for the classic Blastmaster experience. - Tutorials: We've completely overhauled the tutorial screen, adding looping instructional videos introducing the bomb types, powerups, and general ways to play. - Win Tracking: For everyone doing those sick all-night Blastmaster LAN parties, the game tracks who has won the most games with a nifty little crown floating above their character. Now you'll know exactly who to gang up on in the next match! And more!
row.short_description: Blast your way to master status in this Bomberman-style game!

row.name: SHADOWBOX: Mausoleum of Natural History
row.detailed_description: Experience the story of life on Earth like never before with SHADOWBOX: Mausoleum of Natural History , a virtual, interactive, and free-to-play museum. Explore exhibits that detail the life, death, anatomy, and ecology of extinct species containing photogrammetric scans of real fossils. Examine fossils up close, and learn how to identify long-lost species in real life. Scan QR codes to read more about the science behind SHADOWBOX . Collect songs and audio logs to listen to as you explore. Run, jump, and climb on the exhibits, if you please! As of the current version, Beta 1.5 , the following exhibits are open to visitors: Burgess Shale (Cambrian Period) Martin Formation (Devonian Period) Silica Formation (Devonian Period) Naco Formation (Carboniferous Period) Kaibab Limestone (Permian Period) Coconino Sandstone (Permian Period) Moenkopi Formation (Triassic Period) Thaynes Group (Triassic Period) Chinle Formation (Triassic Period) Blue Lias (Jurassic Period) Turney Ranch Formation (Cretaceous Period) Moreno Hill Formation (Cretaceous Period) Menefee Formation (Cretaceous Period) Green River Formation (Eocene Epoch) The Geological Eras Tour Real, False, & Phony Fossils Your input will help the SHADOWBOX development team create the most accessible, informative, and engaging experience possible. If you have suggestions, feedback, or would like to report a bug, head on over to the Steam forums.
row.short_description: Experience the story of life on Earth like never before with SHADOWBOX: Mausoleum of Natural History, a virtual, interactive, and free-to-play museum featuring 3D scans of real fossils.

row.name: 天缘传说
row.detailed_description: 关注我们 欢迎关注我们了解《天缘传说》的最新进展： 官方QQ群：921195681 唯美仙境，玄幻情缘。全新引擎打造唯美玄幻的仙侠世界。天缘传说官方网站唯美场景的身临其境，华丽技能的炫酷战斗，畅快淋漓的江湖体验，跌宕起伏的主线剧情。全自由开放的超大仙侠游戏，百人同屏自由团战，仙人指路指导前程，一刀如雷破魔万千，跃步苍天诀胜千里，御剑仙侠世界独尊。游戏内完美平衡了仙界气韵与仙侠世界的超现实感，构建了一个独属东方的修仙世界。 天缘传说特色 1、鲜明职业特色，选择你最爱的玩法 御剑手持重剑,霸气十足,利用突进快速接近敌人使用剑气对敌人造成伤害，玄灵是团队中不可或缺的输出角色，能够控制五行之力,善于使用多样的法术来进行攻击，飞羽将自身的灵气附着在每一发箭上，可造成不可思议的伤害。 2、唯美仙境剧情，开门见山呈现高潮 唯美仙境的剧情发展，开头即有高潮，进入游戏之后，有新手指引带着您开始战斗!游戏的操作感还算不错，打击感也有，最吸引我眼球的是技能特效，炫酷的技能特效增加了战斗的爽快感。 3、游戏玩法护肝，轻松休闲佛性游戏 游戏玩法十分护肝，每天完成日常活动，打打副本聊聊天，只需完成一些简单的任务即可提升玩家的等级，提高等级可以获得更高的称号并解锁更多的游戏内容，而且可以获得炫酷坐骑和稀有萌宠并肩作战。
row.short_description: 天缘传说是一款超仙气超唯美国风的武侠类的角色扮演的战斗手游，游戏以精美的东方设计了独特的武侠人物，丰富的副本剧情，来完成挑战，获取坐骑战宠，神装，精彩不停，互动结交，还可结姻缘，携手仙侣共度此生，修仙之路不寂寞。

row.name: Puck
row.detailed_description: Get ready to hit the ice in a fast-paced, physics-driven hockey simulation that puts you in complete control. Every pass, shot, and body check is powered by realistic physics, making each game unpredictable, skill-based, and endlessly replayable. Whether you're a die-hard hockey fan or just looking for a fun and competitive sports experience, this game delivers high-intensity action with fluid gameplay and dynamic mechanics. Skill-Based Controls The stick controls are designed to offer a high level of precision and depth, allowing you to execute skillful plays, react to dynamic puck physics, and outmaneuver your opponents with finesse. Team Play Puck isn’t just about skill - it’s about working together to create game-changing moments. Whether you're threading a perfect pass through defenders, setting up a teammate for a one-timer, or executing a seamless give-and-go, teamwork is at the heart of every unforgettable play. Pick Your Role Every great hockey team needs both fearless skaters and rock-solid goaltenders. Whether you thrive on the rush as a forward, dominate the blue line as a defenseman, or guard the net as a last line of defense, your role on the ice is yours to define.
row.short_description: Fast-paced physics-based hockey simulation where precision, strategy, and chaos collide. Control every move, pass, and shot with realistic puck physics, dynamic player movement, and thrilling gameplay. Master the rink with friends or team up with other Puck players for ultimate hockey dominance!

row.name: Sarah's Adventure: Time Travel
row.detailed_description: Step into 'Sarah's Adventure: Time Travel', an enchanting game that sends players on a captivating journey through space and time. This game unearths the essence of adventure by combining elements of exploration and puzzle-solving. As players navigate through various locations around the globe, they are tasked with clearing obstacles and unraveling challenges, truly engaging the player's wit and strategy. The game’s appeal lies in its interactive gameplay mechanics, where your choices dictate the progression of the story. Dive into a meticulously crafted world, build and manage resources effectively, and restore historical artifacts to their former glory. 'Sarah's Adventure' is not just a game; it's a chronicle of thrilling escapades and the celebration of human curiosity, designed to intrigue, delight, and immerse audiences in its narrative richness. Immerse yourself in the engaging tale of Sarah, a young professional from a world-class museum, who finds herself suddenly transported to the nineteenth century. Can you survive the sands of time and help Sarah find her way back?
row.short_description: This game unearths the essence of adventure by combining elements of exploration and puzzle-solving. The game’s appeal lies in its interactive gameplay mechanics, where your choices dictate the progression of the story.

row.name: Supreme Kung Fu
row.detailed_description: 【游戏背景】 清末乱世，武林盟主失踪，江湖传言《至尊秘籍》现世，引各方势力血洗武林。玩家扮演隐世门派「无极宗」末代弟子，携镇派绝学「八卦阵图」，于山门要道布下天罗地网，以功夫奥义守护武林最后的净土。 【核心玩法】 功夫塔防革新 融合咏春寸劲、太极四两拨千斤等百种武学招式，每座防御塔对应一门功夫流派（例：少林罗汉塔可召唤十八铜人阵） 敌人携带「内力值」设定，需用特定招式破招（如用「沾衣十八跌」化解蒙古摔跤手冲锋） 动态江湖战场 地图融合五行八卦机关：引雷击的「雷火台」、减速敌人的「沼泽瘴气阵」 昼夜交替影响战局：夜战需点燃火把防隐形刺客，雨天则增强峨眉剑法 宗师成长体系 参悟《易筋经》《九阴真经》等秘籍解锁经脉系统，永久强化全塔属性 收集武林轶事碎片，召唤传说侠客助战（如黄飞鸿狮头炮、叶问咏春连环掌） 【视觉特色】 水墨动态渲染 ：攻击特效采用泼墨风格，太极拳气化为黑龙，形意拳势如奔马 武侠音效系统 ：兵器碰撞声由真实武术录音采样，BOSS出场自带唢呐BGM 【社交玩法】 武林大会 ：每周限时开启跨服宗战，前10名宗门雕像刻入「武林英豪榜」 师徒系统 ：传授自创武功组合，徒弟通关后师父获「桃李满天下」称号 【开发者寄语】 '我们想让玩家感受到，塔防不仅是数值游戏，更是武学智慧的较量。每个关卡都是江湖传说——用洪拳对抗东瀛忍者，以唐门暗器破蒙古铁骑，这不止是游戏，更是对中国武侠文化的沉浸式体验。' 目标群体 ：塔防策略爱好者、武侠文化粉丝、追求高策略深度的玩家 特色标签 ：#武侠黑科技 #功夫连招塔防 #动态江湖战场
row.short_description: '我们想让玩家感受到，塔防不仅是数值游戏，更是武学智慧的较量。每个关卡都是江湖传说——用洪拳对抗东瀛忍者，以唐门暗器破蒙古铁骑，这不止是游戏，更是对中国武侠文化的沉浸式体验。'

row.name: Turbo Live
row.detailed_description: Turbo Live is a party game where you must survive in a world where drivers don’t respect anything. The concept of the game is simple: you need to guide a group of pedestrians who are a bit dumb and clumsy through traffic without getting them run over. Turbo Live can be played solo like an arcade game, or live with your community like a party game. It’s up to you. 🚶‍♂️ Save or crush the pedestrians 🚗 Send cars onto the road or from the skies to run over the pedestrians 🔔 Interact with your community or your favorite streamers, regardless of the streaming platform 💥 Combine commands and come up with the most twisted strategies to cause chaos! Are you a streamer and want to play with your community? Turbo Live is the ultimate party game to spice up your streams. Save the pedestrians or crush them via the chat, in co-op or versus mode. Grow your audience, have fun, and create connections during chaotic and unforgettable sessions! GO, GO, GO, TURBOOOOOOO LIVE!!! 🎮 Tons of Game Modes In Turbo Live, the goal is to either crush or save the pedestrians. So far, nothing too complicated. But the game modes add a twist, a challenge, and can even completely turn the experience upside down. Imagine playing street soccer in the middle of a traffic jam. Scoring goals while avoiding getting hit won't be easy. Of course, you'll have access to several different game modes (survival, zero crash, soccer, etc.), and more are coming soon (werewolf, zombie, etc.). 🎲 Embrace the Chaos Can you imagine giving full control to your community? Via the chat , viewers can use tons of commands to play, react, help, sabotage, troll, and support you if they're nice. And as if that wasn't enough, we've also planned random events combined with unpredictable physics to surprise you and create completely absurd situations. But don't worry! You have access to settings to customize your experience and ensure everything runs the way you want it to. ✨ Simple and accessible Have you ever tried to play with your community but gave up because you had to explain the game rules fifty thousand times? Relax! We’ve got you covered. Turbo Live is designed so that anyone (even your grandma) can join the game midway without needing any explanations. The rules and commands are always visible on screen, making everything super accessible. And to top it off, we’ve programmed a Twitch bot that gives tips to viewers without cluttering up the chat. The main goal is to have fun. Or to make sure your stream goes smoothly and stays dynamic. Clearly, we prefer to avoid the situation where you get lost in incomprehensible menus and endless settings. We offer two ways to play with your community: 🖥 Twitch option for a quick connection to your account and straight into the game 🔌 Keyboard option to assign chat commands to keyboard keys (a third-party tool is required) ⚙ Feel free to check our streamer guide in the announcements for more information (it’s right above) And don’t worry, you don’t need to be a pro gamer or a streamer with 1,000,000 followers. You just need a mouse, a decent computer (preferably not from the 80s), and you can even play solo if you want! 💬 A Message from the Developers We are a small indie team of two passionate people , determined to offer you a fun and chaotic gaming experience , perfect for solo play or sharing live. We don't claim to offer you a 100-hour blockbuster with endless side quests. Instead, we offer you Turbo Live, a game with a unique experience that suits you. Turbo Live is free (and always will be) and offers extensive customization thanks to DLCs. You have the freedom to install the DLCs that interest you to enrich your experience. Additionally, we are committed to continuously adding free and paid content , taking your feedback into account to improve the game over time. 💖Did you enjoy Turbo Live or want to follow the project? 💌 You can provide feedback on our Discord to improve the game 👉 You can join our social networks or share it with your friends
row.short_description: Turbo Live is the ultimate party game to play with your community on stream. Save the pedestrians or crush them via chat. In co-op or versus. Grow your audience, have fun, and create connections during chaotic and unforgettable sessions!

row.name: Body of Mine
row.detailed_description: IMPORTANT: This experience requires Vive Trackers and an HTC Vive (full minimum specs below). A standalone version is available on the Quest Store. Body of Mine is an award-winning Virtual Reality experience that allows you to step into the body of another gender and discover the stories of transgender individuals. Combining full-body, face, hand, and eye tracking with personal interviews of transgender interviews, the experimental storytelling experience allows you to immerse yourself into the skin of another, and discover lived stories of gender dysphoria and euphoria. Body of Mine is the recipient of the Producers Guild Innovation Award, the SXSW Special Jury Award, Best XR at Games for Change, a BAFTA Student Award, and premiered internationally at the Venice Film Festival. Body of Mine 'breaks through a psychological barrier that few pieces of media ever have' (WIRED), taking you on a profound journey of what it means to be a human being. This experience will not run without a specific hardware configuration and calibration, including 5x HTC Vive Trackers, an RTX 3090 graphics card or higher, and (optionally) an eye-tracking headset. Please read the README for detailed information. A trackerless, standalone adaptation is coming soon.

row.name: Dummy Guyz
row.detailed_description: Join us Our Channel YouTube: TOY Studio TikTok: TOY Studio About the Game Dummy Guyz: Multiplayer Physics Sandbox Game Welcome to 'Dummy Guyz' a quaint little multiplayer sandbox game with graphics so rudimentary they'd make a potato blush. It's a place where your grand ideas meet the unpredictable world of physics, all while trying not to fall flat on its face. The real magic happens when you team up. It's multiplayer mayhem at its finest—imagine a group of friends, each with the art skills of a distracted kindergartener, attempting to build the Eiffel Tower with nothing but spaghetti. Yep, it's that kind of party. Where you're not just a player; you're a pioneer. Here, your brilliant (or brilliantly bizarre) ideas fuel the game’s evolution. Discuss, debate, and help steer the ship through the wild waters of game development. And soon, with mods, you'll get to tweak, twist, and transform the game into something uniquely yours. Your imagination is the limit, and our Discord is the launchpad. What’s This All About? 'Dummy Guyz' is our love letter to the chaos of creativity. Inspired by the spirit of Garry's Mod, we thought, why not create a sandbox where everything doesn’t always go as planned? From building wobbly vehicles that defy gravity (for better or worse) to crafting forts that are more about character than structural integrity, we're all about the fun in the journey, not just the destination. Early Days, Humble Ways Fair warning: we're in the super early stages here. If 'Dummy Guyz' were a cake, we'd still be figuring out the difference between baking powder and baking soda. But that’s where the adventure begins, right? We’ve got the basics down: blocks, vehicle parts, and a physics engine that sometimes gets overly excited. As we grow, expect everything from minor improvements to major overhauls, all in the pursuit of crafting a sandbox game that’s as enjoyable to play as it is unpredictable. Here's a full list of features in the Early Access version: Local LAN or online multiplayer with very limited relay servers (only two nodes!) support A minimal bean-like character which you can only switch color for customization Relatively rich set of tools you can select and equip to your quickbar, including guns, swords, tools that manipulating other stuff, block building tools, car building tools and some very hacky tools that can change properties of other stuff. Some interactable objects that will respond to player interaction in different ways, such as moving, rotating, flying or simply let you take the drive seat. A few dull models that you can put together with other stuff to create your own toy. A collection of Nextbots with popular memes from the internet. A experimental feature that let you save your combination and level setups into XML file which you can load into the game anytime later. It's pretty limited feature wise but we don't add any restriction to how you can combine different objects and tools. Some of the tool effects even work on other players. So it's recommended to invite friends to play together and get either creative or stupid fun. What to Look Forward to The future's bright (we hope) with plans to introduce more building blocks, mechanical parts, better physics shenanigans, and features that YOU suggest. We're committed to making 'Dummy Guyz' a space where creativity, chaos, and community come together in a delightful mess.
row.short_description: Dummy Guyz is a multiplayer physics sandbox with no predefined rules. Get creative by building or breaking things your way. The game is bare-bones with no theme and minimal graphics, focusing solely on physics interactions!

row.name: Breadborn
row.detailed_description: Ever hear that gluten is bad for your health? Ha! Prepare to meet a SERIOUSLY lethal lump of dough! Cursed by an old hag, it's doomed to roam the earth and wreak destruction upon villages and towns. So head out on the attack, and remember—each failure only makes you stronger. Breadborn brings you dynamic and chaotic battles, set to a cheery soundtrack! Bready or not, here you come! Tear off a chunk of yourself, arm it with weaponry, and send it to fight the enemy. Nobody stands a chance against your army of crumbs—buck-toothed peasants and pesky bees alike. Even your most dangerous foe—the hungry hen—shall be defeated. Baking care of business Use a rich arsenal of melee and long-range weaponry! Grab anything that comes to hand, whether it's an ordinary stick or a top-of-the-range assault rifle—a gift from Baba Yaga, the forest witch. Even a block of juice powder or a balalaika might come in handy on the battlefield. How? Give it a shot and find out! Rise like dough! Over time, your lump will grow bigger, its army will get stronger, and its inner world will become richer. Earn achievements and unlock access to new weaponry, opponents, artifacts, and even in-game events. The sky's the limit! Your favorite recipe! Prepare your lump to your exact tastes. Use the in-game editor to give your high-carb hero its own unique style! Cause that's just how you roll! Investigate the vast and perilous world of Breadford County. Tons of varied locations, activities, and tough bosses await you. Take a plunge into the icy river Don, or battle the Deathless One in an abandoned cemetery.
