row.name: Astro Arena
row.detailed_description: Step into the ultimate 2D space arena where strategy meets action in Astro Arena! In this fast-paced, team-based game, two opposing teams clash in a dynamic battleground, each vying for dominance with a unique twist on the classic rock-paper-scissors game you know and love. Choose your character type—Rock, Paper, or Scissors—and dive into the fray. Each type has its strengths and weaknesses: chase down the enemy characters you're strong against, and evade those who have the upper hand over you. The key to victory lies in outmaneuvering your opponents and using your environment to your advantage. But it’s not just about the chase! As you battle it out, gather valuable resources scattered across the arena to gain the upper hand. Earn points for every successful match and exchange them for powerful abilities like invisibility, speed boosts, and more. These abilities can be activated for a short time during the game, giving you the edge you need to turn the tide of battle. Formulate your team’s strategy, coordinate with your allies, and outplay your opponents to claim victory in this adrenaline-pumping battle royale. Will you lead your team to triumph or crumble under the pressure? Astro Arena is a fresh take on the classic game, offering hours of competitive fun. Are you ready to rise to the challenge and dominate the arena? Features: Classic Rock-Paper-Scissors Mechanics: Experience a thrilling twist on the timeless game. Team-Based Battles: Work with your team to outmaneuver and outsmart the opposition. Dynamic 2D Space Arena: Explore and fight in a vibrant, action-packed battleground. Resource Gathering: Collect and strategically use resources to gain the upper hand. Ability Upgrades: Earn points and unlock powerful abilities like invisibility and speed boosts to activate during battle. Intense Multiplayer Action: Engage in high-octane battles with friends or players around the world. Prepare for battle, strategize with your team, and may the best team win in Astro Arena!
row.short_description: Astro Arena is a fast-paced, team-based space battleground where Rock, Paper, and Scissors clash. Choose your character, gather resources, and earn points to unlock powerful abilities like invisibility and speed. Outsmart your opponents and lead your team to victory!

row.name: Coin Eruption
row.detailed_description: Coin Eruption takes the classic coin pusher arcade experience to exhilarating new heights—literally! Set atop a majestic mountain, your goal is to strategically drop coins onto the pusher platform and watch as they cascade down, pushing more coins and prizes into your collection. Key Features: Epic Coin Pushing Action Drop your coins and watch the physics-based pusher mechanism at work. Time your drops perfectly to maximize your haul and push even more coins over the edge! Special Coins with Unique Effects Collect special coins with distinct abilities. Upgrade their effects to supercharge your gameplay. Whether it's doubling your coin output, creating explosive cascades, or triggering rare events, these special coins are your key to mastery. Unlockable Collectibles and Rewards As you play, gather unique collectibles that unlock a variety of in-game rewards. These treasures are not just for show—they can provide significant boosts and enhance your coin pushing strategy. Dynamic Volcano Eruptions Experience the thrill of a volcano eruption that showers coins onto the pusher platform. These eruptions are spectacular events that can turn the tide of your game in an instant, offering massive rewards and excitement. Autoplay Feature Sit back and let the game play itself with the autoplay feature. Perfect for when you want to relax and watch the coins stack up without lifting a finger. Avatars and Backgrounds Customize your experience by unlocking new avatars and backgrounds. Show off your progress and achievements as you level up, making your game uniquely yours. Leveling System Progress through the game and earn experience points to level up. Each level brings new challenges and rewards, ensuring that the gameplay remains fresh and engaging. Coin Eruption is not just a game; it's a captivating experience that combines strategy, skill, and a bit of luck. With stunning visuals, dynamic gameplay elements, and a plethora of features to explore, this game will keep you entertained for hours on end. Get ready to embark on an epic coin-pushing adventure and see how high you can climb!
row.short_description: Experience the thrill of a mountain-top coin pusher game in Coin Eruption! Drop coins, collect special upgrades, unlock rewards, and trigger epic volcano eruptions. Customize your game with avatars and backgrounds while leveling up through dynamic and exciting gameplay.

row.name: Teatime Samurai
row.detailed_description: Who woulda thought sipping tea would could lead to an epic battle against the forces of the undead? Not us, surely, but here we are. In Teatime Samurai, you'll journey to ancient Japan, where your old dojo has been overrun by a fabulous army of zombies, skeletons, and assorted monsters from Japanese folklore. Your host? None other than the great Nashisama, the man who taught you everything you know about slinging fireballs and drinking tea. Twin-Stick Madness : Get ready to blast your way through hordes of enemies in classic arcade action. Dust off those dusty thumbs, it's arcade time, baby. Couch Co-op : Party started and looking for co-op action? Look no further than Teatime Samurai. Up to four players can join the fray on the same screen. Retro Vibes : With hand drawn retro pixel art graphics, this game is a nostalgic sendup to the golden age of arcade shooters – but with substantially more tea. Japanese Folklore Fun : From mischievous yokai to oversized oni, the enemies you'll face are straight out of Japanese mythology. It's like a very shoddy history lesson, where the teacher gets confused half way through and starts talking about magic pizza. Legendary Boss Battles : Face off against monstrous bosses. Martial arts champions, Oni Sorcerers, and Blues Keyboardists from 80s jam bands all await you. Two Fabulous Game Modes : In Classic Mode you'll dive into relentless action and kill as many enemies as possible, facing down six bosses. Rack up your score and etch your name onto the high score board, proving yourself the ultimate Teatime Samurai. In Defend the Shrine Mode you'll hold up against endless waves of enemies hell-bent on destroying your shrine. Strategize, defend, and prove your skills in this survival challenge. Grab your friends, your gamepads, your friend's gamepads, and a hot cup of tea. It’s Teatime. And this time, it's... Samurai... Teatime... Teatime Samurai.
row.short_description: Up to four player retro arcade style twin-stick shooter featuring a colorful cast of monsters inspired by Japanese folklore.

row.name: Palm Sugar: A Village Story Playtest
No Work No Life
row.detailed_description: One day, you are suddenly abducted to a completely white space. In this place, with only a door and an elevator, gather offerings to sacrifice and survive for as long as possible. Except for you or others who were captured with you, no one else exists in this space, so if you see anyone, run away immediately. If you encounter danger or decide you have gathered enough offerings, don't hesitate to escape through the exit to return to safety.
row.short_description: This game is a roguelike horror game. Beyond the door lies a completely white space where you must pick up items, offer them as sacrifices, and survive for as long as possible.

row.name: Ashes Of Idunn: Tales Of Fimbulwinter
row.detailed_description: Far away from home, sailing through unknown waters. I ask the Gods to show me mercy. My family, my people. Consumed by the tongues of fire. I never should have left them. There may still be hope. They may still be, somewhere… Only she can help me find the way… the way home. Gods give me strength, the strength to regain what I lost. Ashes Of Idunn: Tales Of Fimbulwinter is a sneak peek into the future of the Ashes Of Idunn Metaverse. In this experience, you will follow the Berserker into battle in search of his people. After the fight with the Troll, the Berserker seeks the Voelver to get answers. The world of Tales Of Fimbulwinter is vast and offers different types of animal life and vegetation. You can choose to explore the world freely but beware, some enemies might be camping around the corner. Enemies will try to stop your search. Thankfully, with the power of the Gods and your mighty axe, you can defeat them in old-fashioned melee combat But be careful, too many enemies at once may cause your demise. Low on health? With some mix of natural ingredients found in the world and a little rest at the resting runes that will not be a problem for long. These magical runes have the power of giving great comfort to our Berserker, this way, he is able to rest and regain his strength. The path may seem straightforward, but sometimes even the greatest need a guide. The runes will serve as a guide for your travels within this realm. Just follow the runes and you will eventually find your way to the Voelver and your people. Had fun with the experience and need more Ashes of Idunn? Do not fret, there is more to come...
row.short_description: Ashes Of Idunn: Tales Of Fimbulwinter is a small sneak peek into the future of the Ashes Of Idunn Metaverse. In this experience, you will follow the Berserker into battle in search of his people. After the fight with the Troll, the Berserker seeks the Voelver to get answers.
row.notes: Violence and combat with blood are present in-game.

row.name: Beetle Ninja
row.detailed_description: STORY After unleashing an unfathomable cataclysm, Montrell Saint-Luc, the Beetle Ninja, must find a way to prevent it's inevitable arrival within two short weeks . Will you save the world, or will you spend the rest your time chilling at home? Ultimately, it's up to you. Either way, some insane cultish man on the street insists that the world is going to end soon. FEATURES 14 in-game days worth of content An ever-changing hub-world High replayablility 13 unique party members 11 different missions 70 custom music tracks by PostElvis, featuring guest compositions by Shane Mesa ( Mother 4 ) and ClassyJitto ( Frostix ) ( Pizza Tower ) Built for repeated playthroughs and varied strategies via an expansive roster of recruitable ninjas, a large selection of unique endings and secrets, and a mission-and-day-based structure, Beetle Ninja is a game that takes multiple separate playthroughs to truly appreciate! LEGACY Often called 'the biggest sleeper hit of 2020' by fans, Beetle Ninja is an RPGMaker 2003 game first released in 2020: with unique open-ended design that allows the player to simulate two weeks in the life of a vigilante-for-hire in whichever way he chooses.
row.short_description: Saving the world sure gets stressful sometimes!
row.notes: Beetle Ninja contains a handful of instances of crude humor and crass language.

row.name: Croak Crusader: Spawn of the Spore Spectre
row.detailed_description: WHAT'S ALL THIS ABOOT? Croak Crusader: Spawn of the Spore Spectre is a 2D action platformer with a real focus on speed, Tarantino-style violence, and a wicked grapple feature that lets ya zip around like an acrobat, eh! This is a prequel chapter for Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada, and the full game’s gonna have, like, five times the content of this demo, buddy! So buckle up, ‘cause you’re in for a wild one, don’tcha know! BELLS AND WHISTLES, EH? Set in North Hollywood, Canada, the game’s a real nod to the golden-age of Hollywood Z-movie director Ed Wood and those early superhero flicks, eh! What really makes Croak Crusader stand out from the other grapple-based platformers, though, is the focus on combat and action, don’tcha know! Enemies burst into fountains of red pixels and body parts when you ram 'em through or chuck 'em against walls and floors with a good ol' 'crac' or 'paf!' It's a real hoot, buddy! A REAL BEAUT OF A STORY! In this prequel chapter, players take control of the mysterious doppelgänger, Toadman, on his quest for revenge against Captain Croak—the hero of the story, eh! Now, Toadman comes to life when a poor unsuspecting leech, stuck on Captain Croak, gets run over by a car and then mutated by the bizarre wildlife in Canada’s lush, exotic jungles. At this point in our story, those jungles have been infused with some strange alien tech, cooked up by the wicked Professor Creature! With a chip on his shoulder, Toadman vows to get even with Captain Croak and kick him out of the Canadian jungle he now calls home! MISC INFORMATION Croak Crusader: Spawn of the Spore Spectre is a demo chapter for what is intended to be a much larger experience! The full game, Croak Crusader: The Champion of Canada  will star the true hero of our story:
row.short_description: Embark on an odyssey into the unknown! Behold the tale of Toadman, an enigmatic being born from alien tech and the mysteries of Radiant Verde. Witness his perilous quest through treacherous jungles to confront Captain Croak in an epic showdown! Welcome to 'Spawn of the Spore Spectre'!
row.notes: Defeating enemies in Croak Crusader produces gore particles and severed body parts, which can be adjusted via in-game menus.

row.name: Abrakajumpa
row.detailed_description: Abrakajumpa is a 2D platformer game set in a fantasy world where you have to reach the top of the level through jumping. Facing difficult jumps and obstacles, you must traverse these levels through strategy and Abrakajumpa is a 2D platformer game set in a fantasy world where you have to reach the top of the level through jumping. Facing difficult jumps and obstacles, you must traverse these levels through strategy and skill. -As you climb higher, be cautious of falling! A small mistake will cost you precious progress. -Time your jumps precisely and charge them carefully to avoid falling. -Nail-biting jumps and special platforms block your path. Learn what they do and overcome them! -Enjoy a variety of maps which include vanilla, procedural generation, and stealth. -Jump your way to the top and claim the fastest time on the leaderboards.
row.short_description: Jump your way to the top!

row.name: Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz! The only quiz to outbeat your brain! Welcome to the Extravagant Quiz! Step into Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz, a narrative horror experience taking place in an early 2000s edutainment computer game. Your mission: solve Mr. Pompy's quizzes to recover the lost golden light bulbs, all while he attempts to speak to you beyond the screen. This is a tech demo, with the full game coming soon! How It Started Congratulations! You're among the few people who received our unique cereal box copies. *NOTE: Any future giveaways of this game are to be discontinued indefinitely. Any customers to get their hands on a copy are considered a lost cause. Meet the Crew! You've got PomPom! Her lively and boisterous personality can help you solve math problems and, all in all, lift your mood. Visit her store occasionally to purchase several treats. Next is Patrick! He will speed you through all you need to know about history and science. Perhaps even to the extent where you greatly surpass him. Visit his library whenever you have some free time to learn about interesting topics. Finally, we have Mr. Pompy himself! As your host, he will ensure that you win the game with nothing less than perfection and a more positive attitude towards life. Puzzles & Quizzes Do puzzles to proceed to the quiz! Test your smarts with our amazing quizzes!! See how well you did!!! Brought to you by Light Thoughts Game Company. Discover the light within your mind.
row.short_description: Think you're smart? Prove it by stepping into Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz—an educational experience for clever kids and curious minds! Just don't disappoint Mr. Pompy.

row.name: Away To The Stars Closed Beta
Word on the hook
row.detailed_description: An exciting intellectual fishing game for one or more players, where as a “fish” you need to catch words divided into two parts. Each player gets control of a boat and a fishing rod, with which they need to catch as many fish as possible. Each fish carries only one of the two parts of a word. For example, the word “game” will be divided into two fish “ig” and “ra”. Whoever catches both of these syllables will collect the word “game”. Whichever player caught the most words in a certain time won! About the game Simple rules: each player can either move left and right (to determine where to cast the fishing rod), or lower and raise the fishing rod. To catch a fish, you just need to “hook” it with a hook. To catch a word, you need to catch two fish - parts of this word. There is a mode for 1 player (catch as many word fish as possible against time and earn more coins). There is a mode for several (2-4) players on one screen (have time to catch more fish than your friends). Support for Russian and English languages (both in the interface and in gameplay). There are 2 difficulty levels for each language (the difficulty level affects the number and complexity of words; even preschoolers know words at an easy level) There are 9 fisherman characters to choose from. At the end of each round, each player receives a prize - coins (as many coins as he managed to catch the words). There is a store where you can spend the coins you earn and buy cool nautical jewelry. Timed game. The game uses cute cartoon graphics. The game has beautiful special effects and pleasant music!
row.short_description: An exciting intellectual fishing game, where you need to catch words (as a “fish”) and earn coins!

row.name: Katto: Rising Tides
row.detailed_description: Katto: Rising Tides is a funny and dynamic platformer game! Enter the kingdom of Egatlea, face terrible Nari enemies, move and jump between floors and obstacles, and do your best to restore peace for your kingdom. In the ancient kingdom of Egatlea, the Felyn lived in peace under the protection of Kathsa, the feline deity. To invoke her in case of danger, Kathsa had given five gems to each of the five cities of the kingdom: Kathse, Macska, Qattus, Catlantis, and Cathenas. These gems symbolized unity and mutual dependence between cities. However, one day, the Nari, inhabitants of the vast ocean that surrounded the kingdom, emerged with a powerful army and surprised the Felyn, usurping the temples of the five cities and seizing the five gems. With the loss of the gems, the cities were in danger of being wholly conquered. The deity Kathsa chose the protagonist, Katto, as the bearer destined to recover the gems and restore peace to the kingdom. Even though the gems' protectors had fallen prisoner to the Nari, Katto demonstrated skill by infiltrating the temples, fighting off the invaders, and recovering the stolen gems. Now, with the five gems in the hands of the Nari, Katto must fight to recover them and gather them in the ancient amulet to summon Kathsa and receive her help to expel the invading Nari and restore peace to the kingdom of Egatlea. Embark on an epic adventure through Catlantis! In this fast-paced 3D platformer, you must jump across gaps, dash past obstacles, scale walls with agile climbs, and defeat enemies by stomping or dashing into them. Navigate through winding corridors and bustling marketplaces, using your skills to overcome obstacles and enemies. Jump over pits, dash through hazards, and climb walls to reach new heights. Defeat enemies by carefully timing your jumps and dashes, landing on them with precision. Explore the richly detailed environments. Master the art of traversal as you leap and dash your way through this vibrant and challenging adventure. Key features: 3 unique levels & an epic boss fight Dynamic and easy-to-use gameplay Beautiful greco roman-inspired art style Amazing soundtrack made by students from Berklee College of Music Valencia
row.short_description: Katto: Rising Tides is a funny and dynamic platformer game! Enter the kingdom of Egatlea, face terrible Nari enemies, move and jump between floors and obstacles, and do your best to restore peace for your kingdom.

row.name: Low Batt
row.detailed_description: Have you ever dreamed of defeating an army of robots? Low Batt is the game for you. In this exhilarating, fast-paced shooting adventure, you assume the role of Andy, a friendly robot on a mission to retrieve batteries for his robo-dog, fiercely guarded by the nefarious corporation L.E.A.D. Industries. Explore a vibrant and captivating futuristic factory, meeting intriguing characters and dispatching hordes of guards in the most inventive ways. A FORMIDABLE ARSENAL AT YOUR DISPOSAL: From Roomba-like robots to mines and even the occasional nuclear weapon, Andy is well-equipped and can utilize various traps and environmental hazards, such as ground traps or electrified floors, to handle the moderately well-trained elite corps of guards. AN UNFORGETTABLE JOURNEY FOR ALL AGES: In Low Batt, you'll encounter unforgettable characters and a bustling robot factory teeming with life. Amidst the frantic combat, take breaks to uncover amusing secrets, anecdotes, and bizarre situations in which the workers of L.E.A.D. Industries find themselves entangled. JOIN ANDY AND TRY THE LOW BATT EARLY ACCESS! KEY FEATURES: Explore 2 unique and distinct sci-fi areas Experience nice, polished and creative combat Fight against multiple types of unique enemies Meet fun and memorable NPC Use machinery and traps to your advantage
row.short_description: Step into the thrilling world of Low Batt, a heart-pounding Top Down Shooter that pits you against the formidable security forces of L.E.A.D. Industries. Navigate through intense challenges requiring a blend of skill and strength and embark on an epic robotic adventure to rescue your robo-dog.

row.name: Shelley Manor
row.detailed_description: Shelley Manor is a combination of reality and fantasy, where the time seems to have stopped before entering the manor walls. You will meet known enemies, all of whom come from classical works, and some allies. Control Alex, a tourist that ended up there after being tricked by the townsfolk. Explore the hallways and rooms and help them escape before it’s too late. The player must run, push and throw to reach its goal by completing the various riddles the manor is covered with. With fixed cameras and dynamic puzzles, escaping seems harder with every passing time; encountering enemies every step of the way might make Alex lose hope, but fear not! They’re not alone in this tale. A friendly NPC will help guide them with different dialogues and save points along several rooms. Hide through the levels, distract enemies and interact with the level scenery to solve the different puzzles in front of you. Shelley Manor is a linear free exploration game where the player can choose how to use their time. Key features: Single-player game 5 Unique enemies Three different zones Rich and immersive environment Start your adventure through the manor and find your way out before it’s too late.
row.short_description: Find your way through a puzzle filled manor while barely dodging human-eating monsters. You wake up in a dark room with one objective: escape those sharpened teeth. However, you should not worry; you will meet friends along the way.

row.name: Pixelitos - Spritle Royale
row.detailed_description: Enter the colorful world of Pixelitos! Your role as a Pixelito Trainer is to build teams of digital creatures, known as Pixelitos, to fight on your behalf. You only need to make the team, no need to tell them how to fight! After a round is up, you will go back to the shop and make your team stronger. Keep it up, make stronger and smarter teams, and soon enough you will be a Pixel Master! Climb the Online Global Ladder, challenge your friends in Online Versus, or take on the league in Story Mode. With over 130 Pixelitos to collect, the perfect Pixelito experience is waiting for you!
row.short_description: A creature-collecting teambuilding autobattler with over 130 unique elemental creatures to collect and battle with! Assemble a team of Pixelitos to face opponents in 6v6 auto battles. Face off in online asynchronous multiplayer, online versus with friends, or in the single-player campaign.

row.name: While Mom's Away
row.detailed_description: While Mom's Away is fast-paced First-Person Shooter where you kill players with toasters , pizza and satellite dishes ...? Yep, that's right. Forget photorealistic graphics, what players really want is GOOD GAMEPLAY , and this does in fact have it (Quality assurance conducted by my friend from 1st grade and a Fiverr guy). ▶ CHAOS 'With great power comes great responsibility' - Your mom Screw that lol, take the entire kitchen arsenal with you and dominate your opponents in all sorts of funky minigames. ▶ MINIGAMES If you thought this game was chaotic enough, just wait till you realize each round here is different 💀 You won't get bored. Still not impressed? Look at these super unbiased reviews left by professional critics:
row.short_description: A fast-paced First-Person Shooter with minigames where you kill players with toasters, pizza and satellite dishes... And also shoot with chips? What kind of goofy game is this?!

row.name: PWN!
row.detailed_description: The game play depicts the process of the virus penetrating into the server and taking control. Knowing that his company's life and death was on the line with the announcement of a new AI technology by an emerging company, CEO Mo commissioned a hacker to hack the server and poured everything into it to steal this technology. The hands of a competent hacker combine the ai technology of a large company to create a mutant virus with 'self'. Viruses have amazing physicality, such as using survival-specific skills or reviving more powerfully with data. In some cases, they work together to solve difficult puzzle gimmicks in a cool way. Choose four wonderful characters to create the visual virus you want. Create your own style of play by combining four different types of assault rifle, SMG, sniper rifle, and shotgun guns and multiple skills to clear the stage faster. Regular programs and vaccines inside the computer stage will keep your virus from trying to destroy the computer! But I believe you will take control of this computer with powerful guns and skills, and great gimmick pahaw capabilities. Become a virus right now and hack your servers!
row.short_description: PWN! is a third-person shooter with a cyberpunk setting. Become a virus invading a computer, defeat anti-virus monsters, and destroy security gimmicks to clear the stage. Four types of guns and several types of skills will make your play more diverse.

row.name: Cave Crawler 2
row.detailed_description: Overview Escape a series of winding caves full of strange creatures and treacherous platforming challenges. Gameplay Precise, responsive controls 4-directional shooting Linear side-scrolling level design Features New enemies, hazards, and boss fights 15 levels across 3 worlds Built-in level editor Built-In Level Editor Create your own levels using the built-in level editor. Import and export levels to share, play, and edit community-created content.
row.short_description: Cave Crawler 2 is a retro-inspired 2D side-scroller. Escape a series of winding caves full of strange creatures and treacherous platforming challenges.

row.name: Scrabbleman
row.detailed_description: A word puzzle game that combines elements of Hangman and Scrabble. The objective is to solve a series of word-guessing puzzles while strategically choosing uncommon letters. Players are awarded points based on their speed and ability to select low-value letters. Features: - Replayable word-based puzzles - Multiple unlockable backgrounds - Custom word creation - Leaderboard to top scores and times (for local machine)
row.short_description: A word puzzle game that combines elements of Hangman and Scrabble.

row.name: Funky Panic Attack
row.detailed_description: 'LUNA! You have to stop dozing off like that! We will NEVER reach the Halloween at this pace! Plus, you are going to get a concussion and slow us down!!' You babbled 'Halloween' in your sleep, so now you have to find whatever that is... Jump over annoying obstacles, but you can also freeze them! AND find some more funky things! Talk to some strange characters... Find charming and surreal places..... Jump around annoying obstacles......... Freeze those annoying obstacles............... Try toggling the Chili Pepper Mode................. Find whatever the 'Halloween' is............................... In this 3D platformer, Luna can freeze certain obstacles! Jumping off a frozen platform launches Luna even further! This strange adventure lets you play at your own pace. But there's a faster Chili Pepper Mode... Activate Chili Pepper Mode to become a lot faster, but also uncontrollably jumpy! It can make things more difficult, but also more exciting!  Luna's bound to meet some strange characters along the way - Everything should be fine with the help of Funky... Right?? The Digital Domain??? When did I accept that anyway?? That sounds awful… What even is Halloween?? Dive into this funky world for free!
row.short_description: Can Luna navigate this funky world to find Halloween? - Talk to strange and compelling characters! Freeze obstacles and activate the fast Chili Pepper Mode, but beware - it also makes you uncontrollably jumpy!

row.name: TRUTH TRAIL : exorcism of deception
row.detailed_description: One day when my parents were away, Ally, a sleeping doll, woke up! I need to find clues hidden throughout the house and re-seal Ally... What is true and what is false! 1. Find the things in the house! There are 10 clues hidden in the house that are needed to seal Ally. But to keep you out of the way, Ally hid a false cue and a curse that she triggered the moment she picked it up. 2. Special paper used to seal Ally in the past All the clues you acquire are recorded on this paper. You can check them anytime by pressing the [R] key. This paper has special powers, so you can decipher false clues and curses, except for true clues, by attaching them in your hand and interacting with candles in your house. 3. Make good use of the flashlight. The flashlight has special features. Switch the lights through the keys [1], [2], and [3] to make it useful for the game. [1] Light: Primary flashlight [2] Blue Light: You can find traces of Ally's passing inside the house. [3] Red Light: A powerful weapon that can disable Ally for a while. Look for acquisitions in the house and act to unlock that function. 4. Get rid of Ally! Collect 10 real clues and you'll find all the information to seal Ally. Find a trail of the truth and succeed in exorcising Ally by avoiding the deception of Ally!
row.short_description: One day when my parents were away, Ally, a sleeping doll, woke up! I need to find clues hidden throughout the house and re-seal Ally... What is true and what is false!

row.name: Make Your Country Great Again
row.detailed_description: Have you ever felt the injustice of the world order, thinking that your nation should be at the top of the food chain? Or that some countries are undeservedly high in the global hierarchy and it would be nice to bring them down? If these feelings resonate with you, then you have come to the right place. In our game, you can: Develop the countries you care about. Sink the ratings of disliked countries. Become stronger and have a greater impact on the world order. In our game: A truly unlimited number of players are honestly and simultaneously on the same server. The efforts of all players, potentially millions, are displayed in real-time. Our project offers you a fair way to compete with all the players on the planet for the ranking of countries in the global leaderboard. You will take part in a collective planetary battle and see the consequences of the collective actions of all players on the planet in real-time. You will realize your influence on countries and the world. How big or small that influence will be depends only on you. You just need to choose a country and launch your Energy Plant to increase the Might of the country: or to suppress it: The more Force you have, the stronger your 'Energy Plant': This seemingly simple tool will shine with new colors in the conditions of real-time competition with players from all over the world. We confidently declare that we have achieved an unprecedented level of massiveness for multiplayer games!
row.short_description: Here is a global multiplayer clicker/idle game where players from all over the world unite for a chance to restore global justice and make their country the greatest among all others. There has never been a game this global and massive!

row.name: Down the shaft
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the mines War, death, pestilence, and famine are words one can use to describe our world as it is now. While this is damning for us humans, something grows stronger in the shadows. Waiting, just waiting, for their opportunity to strike and be freed of their chains. For centuries, this place has been guarded from the peeping eye. Hidden in plain sight to protect everyone on the surface from what lies below. Now it's your turn to work the shift and face the horrors down the shaft . Your first shift Welcome to the mines, rookie. Let's hope you survive your first day. You knew when you signed. You kept repeating it to yourself: 'This is no normal mining operation'. You know your duty. You know why you are here: 'I'm here to protect everyone else outside this shaft from the Elder God.' You know what will happen. You know it all too well: 'I won't make it out. But they won't either.' Your job as an engineer is to keep the machines running. You will have to keep them on as long as you can. Fail to do this, and the god will get off its slumber in no time, prematurely ending your shift. Fix machines, get new upgrades, and defend yourself from the creatures that lurk in the mines. Your shift ends at 06:00 AM. That, of course, if you survive that long. The clock is ticking The machines are rumbling down there, but the noise of creaking metal and twisted flesh is not everything audible in the mine. With the recent tragedies out in the world, the Elder God is more active than ever , and so are their obedient minions . Don't let them wake up, or the whole world will be gone in mere seconds. Midnight is approaching. If the clock reaches it, doomsday is nigh. Your survival is pointless if you let the Elder God unchecked. Even surviving the shift might end up killing you and everything else. Keep all the machines working at all times, even if that means taking risks. Learn from your mistakes. Adapt to your enemies. Be a better worker in the shaft. Maybe, just maybe, your effort won't be as pointless as it might look.
row.short_description: Down the Shaft is a first person horror game where you take on the duty to keep an Elder God forever contain within the cave. In order to do that, you must keep the machines that maim them active. But beware, their minions are on the loose and they won't let you do your job so easy.
row.notes: Eerie flesh-like environments. A few gore scenographies.

row.name: MOMOCHIYO'S MONONOKETAIJI
row.detailed_description: Ninja 'Momochiyo' goes on a journey to exterminate Mononoke. Let's defeat the cute monster girls that appear one after another! ◆How to fight 1.When Momochiyo meets the Yokai Girl, a battle begins. 2.Knowing your enemy is very important. Touch the Yokai Girl and observe her attack power and characteristics! 3.Choose a card and use the trick! Cards are randomly selected from the constructed deck.SP (skill points) are required to use techniques. (SP will gradually recover as the turn progresses.) ※If you don't see the card you want to use, press the arrow button at the bottom right to select a new card. 4.If you understand the characteristics of the technique well, you are sure that the technique will hit the enemy! 5.Next is the monster girls' turn! The Yokai Girl notices that Momochiyo has come and turns around, and the Yokai Girl who has already turned around attacks. 6.The treasure chests you sometimes find along the way contain new cards! Get more powerful cards and prepare for the monster girls who are getting stronger and stronger! (At this time, you must discard one card you already have. Of course, you can also give up a new card.) 7.The game is over when Momochiyo's health reaches 0. At this time, the deck at that time will be displayed. In order to advance the battle efficiently and advantageously and eliminate many monster girls, it is important to understand the techniques and enemy characteristics well! Feel free to post live streaming, fan art, etc. I would be happy if you could spread this game widely!
row.short_description: Ninja Puzzle Battle

row.name: Manga RPG
row.detailed_description: Enter an amazing manga universe and live a great adventure! Create your own guild of the greatest warrior and defeat opponents in thrilling contests. In Manga RPG, you'll enjoy a real RPG with tons of great illustrations, adventures and fights. Explore a manga universe, recruit them to your team, grow your guild, and build up your hero to defeat other players in strategic battles! Key features An original story embedded with manga, comic books, video games, and pop culture! Discover the manga RGP adventure through the visual novel format with plenty of humor and hilarious references. Enjoy hundreds of original illustrations, accessible to all players for free. Exciting Events Every month there will be several events that will introduce you to new characters and will give you the chance to craft your perfect team with different strategies, stat management and be the leaderboard master. Character buildup Get the best equipment at the Market to raise your skills to the top! PvP & Leaderboard Increase your guild performance and defy players from all over the world to take the top spot on the international & national leaderboards! Challenge the Champions Show the prowess of your fighter in your Guild and impress the Champions: they will praise you by gifting you new characters and other awards. Join forces to win Start or join a Club together with other players to win amazing awards. Can you create the greatest guild of this manga world? Find out in Manga RPG!
row.short_description: An original story embedded with manga, comic books, video games, and pop culture! Discover manga RGP adventure through the visual novel format with plenty of humor and hilarious references. Enjoy hundreds of original illustrations, accessible to all players for free.

row.name: Coloring Game 5
row.detailed_description: Coloring Game 5 - coloring by numbers. Is a bright representative of anti-stress games. New in the game: Ability to upload custom pictures for free (limitation on image size, maximum 125x125 px.); 3D mode; The game is based on the Coloring Game: Studio core (improved performance relative to previous games in the series).
row.short_description: Coloring Game 5 - coloring by numbers. Is a bright representative of anti-stress games.

row.name: Rally Mechanic Simulator: Light Edition
row.detailed_description: Step into the world of automotive sports mechanics with the Rally Mechanic Simulator: Prologue . Test your skills and see if you have what it takes to manage the garage, handle parts and funds, and fix damaged rally cars. Tune them to perfection and take them to the rallies. Experience the challenges of bad weather, limited time, and fierce competition. Prove yourself and become the best rally mechanic. Are you ready for the challenge? Your journey begins with one car, two rallies, and a test track. See if you can handle the time pressure and turn a wreck into a winning rally car. Test your car on the track and compete for the best driving time using Steam Leaderboards. Start to build your career In the Rally Mechanic Simulator: Prologue, you will begin your journey towards becoming a top-tier rally mechanic. Experience the thrill of fixing and modifying cars while getting a taste of what's to come. This prologue is just the beginning, offering a glimpse into the exciting career that awaits you in the full version. Set the foundation for your future team, start negotiating your first sponsor deals, and manage the initial aspects of your career development. Get ready to step into a world of rally car mechanics and prepare for the full experience in Rally Mechanic Simulator. It's not just a car, it's a rally car Work with rally cars equipped with turbos, coilovers, proper tires, and performance transmissions. Keep an eye on the car's extra features and make it as good as possible to earn fans and money as part of a champion rally team. Prologue features: Prologue-exclusive: One car, two rallies, and a test track Compete for the best driving time using Steam Leaderboards Realistic rally car models with extensive interaction Work on car electronics Car damage and cleaning systems Ability to paint and customize your cars Equipped field workshop for on-the-go repairs Advanced vehicle development system Realistic graphics Advanced car appearance personalization system Timed repair segments Extensive tuning options Many achievements to unlock and much more in the full version of Rally Mechanic Simulator
row.short_description: Step into the world of rally car mechanics with Rally Mechanic Simulator: Prologue, a free introduction to the full game. Take your first steps as a rally mechanic, facing the challenges of fixing and tuning a rally car.

row.name: Wheel Of Fates
row.detailed_description: A lovingly created RPG from the ground up with cheerful characters and fun storytelling. Explore a vast set of worlds in a time of magic and wonder, find out about the species of Bi'in and their role in the grand scheme of things! Adventure around a colorful realm full of characters and secrets, from the playfully decorated overworld maps to the special sidequest areas with more intimate interactions! Customize and equip a roulette wheel with attacks and spells to customize your playing experience! Millions of combinations are possible! From powerful attacks and spells to hardy shields and healing potions! Spin your wheel loadout in battle and test out how well your build works! Beat the odds by making game-breaking builds and combos! - Over 50 Fetish Scenes with player interactivity! - Over 100+ different wedges to equip - Tons of enemies with their own fighting styles - A rich deep universe filled with fun characters! - Tons of sidequests and side-areas to explore!
row.short_description: A lovingly crafted RPG with a unique spin, with cheerful characters and fun storytelling.

There are depictions of the consumption of alcohol. There is depictions of cartooney violence with swords and knives in a medieval setting. There is an intimate dating scene.

row.detailed_description: Classic 15-block sliding puzzle game with a devious twist.. or two. Walls to block your progress, rotate your tiles, hide or reveal the numbers on your tiles, and more. Play 20 hand-crafted puzzle and track your best times. Play the daily puzzle and share your results with your friends, or share random puzzles you find or puzzles you make in the Puzzle Maker.
row.short_description: Classic 15-block sliding puzzle with a devious twist.

row.name: MORSOMNIA:0
row.detailed_description: MORSOMNIA:0 is a wonder fancy adventure game in which the player progresses through the story while performing the duties of a caretaker of the unidentified life form “Kuon”. Game Overview Interact with “Kuon”, a life form isolated underground. There is no difficult system, and the story progresses by reading the text. As a side trip, you can have a quick meal in the cafeteria and interact with the staff in the institute. You may receive a mysterious gift as a token of our exchange...? You can keep things running smoothly or take a break at a café. You are free to do whatever you want! In this institute. Soon, Kuon will swallow you to a different fate. story The main character “Kaiyou” who belongs to the small research institute “Rule Blue Integrated Life Science Laboratory” built on an island rich in marine resources, has been living an unflattering life, emotionally exhausted by sad events in his personal life and human troubles in the laboratory. In the midst of this, he is summoned by “Misumi” who has been secretly conducting research in an underground area, and asked to participate in a project involving the mysterious “Morsomnia” a different space, as a change of pace. “Morsomnia”is also related to “Arcana” an unidentified whale-like creature that I was previously involved in investigating. When I opened the blue door to the underground area, I found a life form with a will that called itself“Kuon” made of cells and pieces of meat taken from Arcana, waiting there.
row.short_description: Interacting with the unidentified life form “Kuon”, we move forward with the pain. A surreal, mysterious fancy adventure.

皇帝
row.detailed_description: 《皇帝》是一款王朝養成模擬遊戲。在遊戲中，你作為神州之主，可以厲兵秣馬，開疆拓土一統天下，也可以興學治世，德化天下福澤百姓。 你依舊可以選秀培養子女，管理自己的國家，處理與他國的關系。同時新增了戰鬥機製，使攻城略地更有趣，快來建立你的王國霸業吧。 玩家QQ群：978055774 小团队养家糊口之作，欢迎体验，不足之处还请谅解==

row.name: Galactic Striker
row.detailed_description: Galactic Striker: An Exciting Adventure in the Depths of Space Galactic Striker takes you on a high-paced top-down action adventure into the depths of space. As a space warrior, you will battle against enemy fleets, avoid obstacles, and complete missions to save the galaxy. With retro-style graphics and thrilling gameplay, Galactic Striker is perfect for both classic and modern gamers. Features Intense Space Battles: Fast-paced combat that tests your reflexes. Variety of Enemy Types: Enemy ships with unique abilities. Upgradeable Weapons and Power-ups: Enhance your ship with powerful weapons and special abilities. Epic Boss Fights: Challenging boss battles at the end of each level. Stunning Graphics and Sound Effects: Gorgeous retro graphics and atmospheric sound design. Leaderboards and Achievements: Compare your scores with friends and collect all achievements. Story In the depths of the universe, you are a space warrior tasked with maintaining peace. A mysterious enemy force has begun threatening the galaxy, and only you can stop this menace. Use your skills and strategy to defeat enemy fleets, gather valuable resources, and save the galaxy. Why Galactic Striker? Galactic Striker combines retro and modern game mechanics to provide you with a unique experience. With fast-paced action, strategic battles, and stunning graphics, this game will keep you glued to your screen for hours. Are you ready for the mission to defend the galaxy? This text is designed to introduce your game, capture the interest of potential players, and encourage them to try it out. You can adjust the text to better match the specific features and story of your game.
row.short_description: Galactic Striker is an action-packed top-down space shooter where you battle enemy fleets, upgrade your spaceship, and save the galaxy. Experience thrilling combat, epic boss fights, and retro-style graphics in this exciting space adventure.

row.name: Age Of Privateer
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the World of Exploration and Combat on the High Seas! Age Of Privateer is a real-time card battle, roguelike deck-building game. Combine various cards to create powerful decks and explore the vast oceans. Use your courage and wit to defeat pirates, uncover hidden secrets, and embark on a quest to find ancient treasures. Among the crowd, the herald of Emperor Albertross III reads a proclamation loudly: rewards of wealth and honor await those who find the legendary treasure. Hearing this, you decide to embark on an adventure to find the legendary treasure. Sail the vast seas, uncover hidden secrets, and claim ancient treasures. real-time Card Battles Age Of Privateer boasts a fast-paced and thrilling real-time card battle system. Make immediate strategic decisions and use powerful combos to defeat your enemies. battles With Various Sea Monsters As you navigate the vast oceans, you will encounter various sea monsters. Face enemies with unique abilities and patterns, and experience the thrill of battle. collecting Cards and Treasures During your voyage, collect various cards to strengthen your deck. Discover treasures and rare items to become an even more powerful warrior. Utilize diverse strategies to find the legendary treasure and claim the Emperor's rewards of wealth and honor.
row.short_description: Age of Privateer is a real-time card battle-based roguelike deck-building game. Combine various cards to create a powerful deck and explore the vast seas. Can you uncover the secrets hidden in the ocean and find the ancient treasure?

row.name: Lusófona Games Collection 2024
row.detailed_description: Lusófona Games Collection 2024 is a curated bundle showcasing the best student projects developed during the past academic year at Lusófona University. This collection highlights five games created in events and project classes within the Videogames bachelor’s degree program. Play the games and watch the developer commentary to take a behind-the-scenes look at our students' journey to becoming the next generation of videogame developers. Featured games: Inside Poetry Remastered - First Year Human Ltd. - Second Year Magical Intern - Second Year PodScape - Second Year Shades of Insanity - Third Year Please be mindful that these game experiences are small vertical slices that showcase the essential features and gameplay elements, but do not represent final products. Hope you enjoy them as much as we do!
row.short_description: Lusófona Games Collection 2024 is a curated bundle showcasing the best student projects developed during the past academic year at Lusófona University. Play the games and take a behind-the-scenes look at our students' journey to becoming the next generation of videogame developers.
row.notes: There are several games in the launcher but only one of them, "Shades of Insanity", is a horror game that delves into sensitive mental health themes. In this game, you play as a patient coping with a mental illness that induces visual and auditory hallucinations.

row.name: Civilización Caral Perú, la más antigua de América
row.detailed_description: Immersive virtual reality experience - VR inspired by the values ​​and social history of the Caral Civilization, the oldest in America, from the 'Ceremonial Hall of the Pututus' located on top of the Main Public Building, upper part of 'Peñico, City of Social Integration', during the Early Formative 1 (1800-1500 BC). Peñico is one of the 25 urban centers identified in the Supe Valley, 30 years ago, by the team of professionals led by the Peruvian archaeologist Dr. Ruth Shady, principal researcher of Caral. The team of specialists from the Caral Archaeological Zone makes available this immersive virtual reality experience - VR in which all cybernauts will be able to approach the main values ​​of the Caral Civilization.
row.short_description: VR experience of the 'Ceremonial Hall of the Pututus' in Peñico, one of the 25 urban centers of the Caral Civilization, the oldest in America. Discovered by Dr. Ruth Shady's team, it offers a virtual immersion in this ancient culture.

row.name: Droid Wars
row.detailed_description: Droid Wars is an exciting game featuring both local multiplayer deathmatch and single-player survival modes. In deathmatch, 1-4 players battle it out with customized bots. Each match lets players personalize their droid’s loadouts from a variety of weapons, each with unique strengths and weaknesses. Players must strategically manage their droid’s health, armor, and stamina to outlast their opponents. The goal is simple: be the last droid standing. Featuring both PvP (Player vs. Player) and PvE (Player vs. Environment) elements, Droid Wars offers intense player battles and opportunities to defeat NPCs for valuable bonuses. These advantages include items that boost damage, speed, armor, and access to unique weapons. The single-player survival mode challenges players to endure waves of increasingly difficult enemies, testing their skills and strategy.
row.short_description: Droid Wars is an action-packed game with local multiplayer deathmatch and single-player survival modes. Customize your droid’s loadout, manage health, armor, and stamina, and battle in PvP and PvE environments. Survive waves of enemies or be the last droid standing.

row.name: Runeflame
row.detailed_description: Is the mist playing with your eyes, or do you really see before you... a girl with a scorpion tail? Runeflame is a top-down adventure puzzle RPG featuring archery that places you in a world of riddle magic and tangled conflicts between people and spirits. Create a unique character from one of four fantasy races and begin to uncover the mysteries of this strange place. To make your way out of the fog, you must hone your skill with the bow and solve the puzzles that keep you trapped. And beyond the walls of your prison, what else will you discover? Each adventure is a standalone module that your character can explore, and new modules for individual purchase will continually be added to expand the world. There are no other items to purchase in the game, only secrets for you to unearth with curiosity and logic. Runeflame - a role-playing fantasy adventure game in the vein of old-school point-and-click adventures and computer RPGs.
row.short_description: Runeflame is a point-and-click fantasy adventure with an open world and an emphasis on puzzle-solving. Guide your custom character through the immersive world of Runeflame, where secrets and magic have minds of their own.

row.name: Trial of Sacrifice
row.detailed_description: A cult devoted to the evil god Chernobog has summoned a portal to the realm of the living. As the god of darkness, Chernobog spreads a corruption to the mortal world, that slowly destroys the surrounding lands and causing an illness to spread. In the many attempts to close the realm connecting Chernobog to the world, the leaders of nearby kingdoms have sacrificed all of their soldiers and are now running out of options. Our protagonist Viktor, a humble farmer; has been forced to be the next to enter the realm and attempt to defeat Chernobog. Viktor must succeed in this task, otherwise he will lose his life. Follow along in Viktor's story; fighting skeletons and completing unique challenges, such as time trial completions or using unique fighting style choices. Features A unique single player dungeon crawler that focuses on a slower paced third-person combat system A Linear dungeon design that increases in difficulty; designed for a one-shot adventure Local leaderboard system for speed run enthusiast Breakable resources scattered throughout the dungeon, used for upgrading gear. Armour and Weapon upgrade system, to further enhance the player's combat during their playthrough Skeleton enemies utilizing 3 different weapon styles, with varying damage and attack speeds. A final boss with multiple unique attack styles and two final endings possible to Viktor's story About 'Above Average Catfish' Above Average Catfish is a 9 person indie company consisting of recent college graduates with varying focuses in the gaming industry. We were tasked with creating a game from scratch with only 12 weeks to complete it! We decided to push ourselves to make something on a larger scale and we hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoyed working on it!
row.short_description: A cult, devoted to the dark god, Chernobog, has opened a rift between the mortal world and Chernobog's realm, where he has been imprisoned for centuries. From within the rift, darkness spreads out and threatens to envelope the entire world.

row.name: Monster Ops
row.detailed_description: NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim! Plucky Lieutenant Tide has been drafted into the Monster Ops: A military taskforce that hunts monsters who've escaped from a top-secret experiment. He joins the no-nonsense veteran soldier Wraith and the peaceful human-loving monster Balasque. This is an open-ended series with no ending planned. It's like a TV show that will continue until it's canceled. Tide's past screw-ups make him a questionable choice for the high-stakes black ops, but he's determined to prove himself to Wraith. He can't help but look up to their badass leader. Wraith seems rough around the edges, but he warms up to Tide quickly. When the nature of their missions turn sexual, romantic possibilities open up for the two that neither had considered. With increasingly dangerous missions and an unpredictable commander, Wraith and Tide know they must count on each other to survive. Will their bond as battle-brothers evolve into something more? An on-going visual novel series with new 1 to 2 hour stand-alone game episodes coming out monthly in 2025! Our season premieres will be free, and subsequent episodes paid.
row.short_description: NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim! With dangerous missions and an unpredictable commander, soldiers Wraith and Tide must count on each other to survive. Will their bond as battle-brothers evolve into something more? Monster Ops: Military Special Forces hunting rogue monsters! Episodes 1-12 OUT NOW!
row.reviews: “The story does grab you, especially with the relationship between Wraith and Tide. There's also some weird stuff going on in this military base where you really don't know who to trust. The more things unravel the more questions you have. The story is really addictive, and the animated CGs really add to it. I'm very excited to see where this game goes because I AM HOOKED!” PajamaKen
row.notes: Contains scenes of explicit sexual content and mild horror elements. References to non-consensual encounters and art that implies it. Sex with monsters.

row.name: Super Trailblazers
row.detailed_description: Get ready for a blast from the past with Super Trailblazers, a retro-inspired, local multiplayer arcade game! Up to 4 players face off on a neon grid, with the hopes of being the last driver standing. As you race around, you leave behind a neon trail of light - forcing you to weave and dodge through the constantly changing landscape. MULTIPLAYER ONLY Super Trailblazers requires at least two players to start the battle. This means one player can play using the keyboard, and controllers are required for any additional players. DYNAMIC GAMEPLAY Disrupt the competition with an array of exciting abilities. Dash forward to cut off your rivals, launch missiles to blast through walls or strike your foes down head on, lay down bombs to clear your path, and even go invisible to flank enemies or make a daring escape. The competition is fierce, the action is electric, so grab your controllers, fire up Super Trailblazers, and prepare for an unforgettable party experience!
row.short_description: A fast-paced, local multiplayer arcade game. Race around a neon grid with your friends, strategically weaving through the trails of light you leave behind. Use clever tactics and special abilities like missiles, bombs, and invisibility to be the last driver standing!

row.name: Naomi Clicker
row.detailed_description: Naomi Clicker is a simple illustration collecting game. Click on Naomi and collect & combine various items such as gem, valuables, gashapon, etc. to unlock Naomi’s illustration! Try your luck with a click 50+ Naomi's cute illustrations 50+ Achievements Continuous new event and update Free to Play!
row.short_description: Naomi Clicker is a simple illustration collecting game. Click on Naomi and collect & combine various items such as gem, valuables, gashapon, etc. to unlock Naomi’s illustration!
row.notes: Illustration with some exposure.

row.name: Rotosaurus Adventure
row.detailed_description: Rotosaurus Adventure is a puzzle game with a twist. Rotate the world to traverse obstacles and find a way into the goal. Manage boxes, avoid spikes, and use other tools in creative ways to overcome mind-twisting challenges! Explore different worlds with unique mechanics. Each world brings a fresh twist inspired by popular video game genres. Navigate through platformer-inspired environments, delve into shooter-themed levels ... Features More than 200 puzzles spread over 8 worlds Mechanics and themes based on popular video game genres
row.short_description: Rotosaurus Adventure is a puzzle game with a twist. Rotate the world to traverse obstacles and find a way into the goal. Manage boxes, avoid spikes, and use other tools in creative ways to overcome mind-twisting challenges!

row.name: Astro Wars
row.detailed_description: Astro Wars is a Free Multiplayer Space Strategy Game. You start at the edge of the galaxy where you can build up, colonize and take over planets in competition with players from all over the world! You can decide various strategies and take over new areas in the galaxy by building piece by piece. Astrowars wants to achieve: fair play. communication between players. social interaction between players. epic battles in the end. a game requiring strategic and diplomatic skills to win. easy to learn and interesting in the long run. Astrowars does not want to achieve: multis and cheaters. no communication. a big single player game where the only interaction is to compare points. all about the first player/alliance to win. a game where a single player with perfect build up skills can win with no contacts. difficult to learn and becomes boring.
row.short_description: Astro Wars is a Free Multiplayer Space Strategy Game. You start at the edge of the galaxy where you can build up, colonize and take over planets in competition with players from all over the world!

row.name: Virtual Presenter Room - Testversion
row.detailed_description: VPR - The Digital Studio For Interactive Streams Live streams , interactive shows , video conferences , and presentations in your own 3D studio - with webcam and capture card integration , on-screen controls and the simplest integration of digital presentation tools. Compatible with: Teams | Zoom | Skype | Youtube | Twitch | OBS Studio | Animaze & more 30 min. Trial Version of the Virtual Presenter Room (Full Version is also available on Steam) More features and expansions coming 2025! The Virtual Presenter Room serves as a media hub and control center for every conceivable video conference, recording or live stream. The integrated video functions allow the user to use the output of the Virtual Presenter Room as a virtual webcam and thus into all common video conferencing systems such as Teams, Zoom, Skype, Big Blue Button etc. or for the live stream directly to YouTube, Kick or to be able to broadcast on Twitch . In addition, the Virtual Presenter Room can also be connected to existing OBS or Streamlabs setups in input and output. New content, modules and rooms are constantly being developed and will be offered via updates and DLCs in the future. FEATURES All media sources and webcam or capture systems are captured at a full 60 frames per second and can be displayed simultaneously in the Virtual Presenter Room. Simple multi-screen sharing without the hassle of the typical low fps screen sharing functions! - 4 x simultaneous webcam and capture inputs (multi-camera) - 3 x simultaneous screen and window sharing - 3 x NDI inputs - 6 x different environments - 4K output resolution - Switch between 3D camera motion and hard cuts - 3D Sticky Notes feature - Web browser integration - Live video and media player integration - Integration of Power Point, PDF presentations, Miro Boards and much more. - Integration of Teams and Zoom - A professional chroma keyer and a quick key function for quickly keying users and guests are available via green screen .
row.short_description: The Virtual Studio For Digital PresentationsPresentations in your own 3D room - with webcam integration, on-screen controls and the simplest integration of digital presentation tools.Compatible with Teams | Zoom | Skype | Youtube | Twitch | OBS Studio and much more

row.name: GameLib
row.detailed_description: GameLib is an application that brings together several 3D multiplayer mini-games, such as Werewolves Online, Ludo, and Connect 4 (4 in a row). GameLib features an in-app voice chat function, so you can communicate with other players during the game, whether you're trying to discover a suspect, set the course of a game, or simply have a good time together. You can also add players as friends and communicate with them via an in-app messaging system to keep in touch. Werewolves Online: Up to 15 players can join this role-playing, strategy, and bluffing game. At the start of each game, you're given a card representing a unique role: villager, werewolf, or solo role. No matter which clan you belong to, the objective is the same for everyone: to win the game! Without revealing your role, by using strategy and the powers you've been given, you'll have to do everything you can for yourself or your team/pack to succeed and win. If you don't, you'll be devoured by werewolves, eliminated by the village using a voting system at sunrise, or face some other fate... Ludo: Play Ludo, a classic and friendly board game for 2 to 4 players. Roll the dice, move your pawns around the board, and be the first to reach the center of the board to win! But be careful, strategy is key: block your opponents and plan your movements to gain the advantage. Tactics and luck combine for fun and competitive games on GameLib! Connect 4: Immerse yourself in the strategic universe of Connect 4, a classic and timeless game. Compete against your friends or other online players. Line up 4 tokens of your color horizontally, vertically, or diagonally before your opponent. But be careful, every move counts, and a single mistake can cost you victory! Simplicity, reflection, and competition: take up the challenge and become the master of Connect 4 on GameLib! You'll have the choice of playing with close friends or joining public games with unknown players to add a little suspense to your games! Come and discover our application by downloading it, and show off your talents to other players!
row.short_description: GameLib is an application that brings together several 3D multiplayer mini-games, such as Werewolves Online, Ludo, and Connect 4 (4 in a row). GameLib features an in-app voice chat function, so you can communicate with other players during the game.

row.name: Board Wars - Trick Or Treat
row.detailed_description: Developer's Notes ***Welcome all players. We want to first thank you for visiting our page. Our biggest goal is that you have an enjoyable experience while trick-or-treating. We want you to feel you struck a deal with this game! This game started 3 years ago as a learning project and has developed into a full blown game along the way after realising how much fun we were having. Now that we reached our goal of publishing, we are now working on post release content and updates, there are still many suprises we want to bring to this game. You can help by taking time out to fill out this survey so that we know we are going in the right direction. Survey:   Thank you in advance -Category Zero*** About the Game Board Wars ToT is a couch-op, local multiplayer board game intended for family/friend game nights. Players will take turns rolling dice to RUN across the board and Trick-Or-Treat. Instead of allowing the dice determine how many tiles you move, you as the player will have a certain amount of time to travel across the board to your desired tile. Land at a house to Trick-Or-Treat or land on a Special tile to switch up the score board. But be careful, as long as you have candy in your pockets, it can be stolen from other players and even other greedy monsters trying to catch your spoils. As a monster on Hallow's eve, you have only one goal, DELIVER THE MOST CANDY TO BIG BOSS !!!
row.short_description: Board Wars ToT is a couch-op, local multiplayer board game intended for family/friend game nights. Take turns rolling dice to manually RUN across the board to Trick-Or-Treat and deliver more candy than the other players!

row.name: REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION（レッドネグオールスターズ　スイングバイエディション） Playtest
East Defense
row.detailed_description: East Defense Is a tower defense game that focuses on achieving a good balance between entertainment and challenge, being suitable for both hardcore and casual players who would love to either explore tower defense games style or challenge themselves against various waves of monsters by strategically placing and upgrading multiple towers to prevent the monsters from reaching the castle along the path! Core game mechanics Monsters will try to reach the castle, and you have to build and upgrade towers to prevent them from doing so. There are various types of monsters, which you can learn more about as you encounter them in the game. Each tower has a special skill to boost its power, which can be unlocked by upgrading the tower. Winning each level without allowing any monster to reach the castle grants you 3/3 stars, which can be later used to unlock special levels with unique gameplay mechanics! Towers There are 10 tower types to use in the game. Unlock towers' maximum potential by placing them in the optimum spot to make the most use of their power. Each tower can be upgraded five times and has its own special skill unlocked. Using a variety of towers is the key to defeating all types of monster waves.  Monsters Monsters aim to reach the castle in waves, each with its own speed and health. Killing monsters grants you gold, which can be used to build and upgrade towers. Each monster can have multiple traits to make it stronger and more dangerous. On the 10th wave and every 5 waves, bosses will appear! And they are harder to defeat and will cause high damage to the castle if they pass through your defenses! Don't wait anymore! Explore the wonderful world of East Defense and be the one to repeal all monster waves!
row.short_description: East DefenseYour duty is to protect the castle by strategically building & upgrading towers to stop monsters from coming their way!

row.name: Night Project
row.detailed_description: Night Project is an indie horror project that will introduce you to the history of the Degeons Intertainment corporations. As the game progresses, you will be able to find notes that will fully describe to you the entire deep history of the largest corporation in this game universe. The main antagonist is the unsuccessful experiment of the Degeons Laboratories companies, called the 'Kili project'. You play in the first person of an ordinary guy named Adrian. Your task is not only to find keys and notes, but also to simultaneously trick the AI, whose task is to scare you as much as possible. Explore the location, talk to people who may know something about this company... You also have to dig into your dreams, which are associated with very bad memories.. Explore the office at night, open all the doors and run away from the terrible creature Kili.. Take him next to you..
row.short_description: Indie project in the horror genre, the purpose of which is to solve the big plot of the game universe by searching for notes, talking to people, exploring locations, as well as dreams. The main villain, whose name is 'Kili', will interfere with you.

row.name: Senile Zombies
row.detailed_description: Senile Zombies is a magic-themed zombie survival shooter that can be played alone or in co-operative multiplayer. Shoot your way through multiple rounds of increasingly strong enemies, while upgrading your own powers to keep up. Senile Zombies offers many customization settings to tailor the game's difficulty and feeling to your taste and offer replayability and ever increasing challenges. Story When wizards become increasingly starved of mana, they completely lose their minds. Such 'Senile Zombies' roam the world and gather wherever mana crystals are to be found. These 'Senile Zombies' also hungrily attack any aspiring Wizard brimming with mana. On your search for mana, power, and knowledge, you have stumbled into ruins swarming with Senile Zombies. Fight them off or be devoured! Features Singleplayer Mode Multiplayer Mode 1 Map with five rooms. Rooms are unlocked as the game continues 2 enemy types, increasing in strength with every round 1 boss type enemy 3 upgrade stations (Health, Mana, Spell) 1 spell ability Sprint mechanic Revive mechanic to restore downed allies Lobby with extensive game settings customization In-game scoreboard Upcoming Powerups More enemy types More spells More maps
row.short_description: Senile Zombies is a magic-themed zombie survival shooter that can be played alone or in co-operative multiplayer. Shoot your way through multiple rounds of increasingly strong enemies, while upgrading your own powers to keep up.

row.name: Dysarmia
row.detailed_description: Welcome to DYSARMIA. In this RPG you play as Astrid and Phoenix, two lovebirds who are separated by a meteor throwing them both on to the opposite person’s home planet. Your goal is to find the scattered bridge pieces to help bring our lovers back together. You will fight monsters, pets, and unidentified life forms in order to connect the bridge between the two back together. features: Talk to people in order to unlock clues to where the bridge piece is. Dodge enemy attacks in an open world and fight back with your weapon. Original art and soundtrack brimming with personality. Character-rich cutscenes with a lot of personality. Created by a team of four. Escape. Cats. Talking Cats. Bats and Scorpions. Save your progress and come back later. Survive, run away if you have to.
row.short_description: An intergalactic RPG full of love and animals.
row.notes: There are mature parts of our game including profanity and a smoking cat. We do not intend to glorify use of profanity or drugs. It is simply part of the setting of the game.

row.name: Frostflame
row.detailed_description: Frostflame is a Brazilian Souls like developed by just one person. The game features third-person combat mechanics based on an action RPG system, where you have the possibility of facing enemies in rhythmic combat inspired by Feudal Japan, collecting their flame sparkles to become stronger by upgrading your character and preparing to face even greater challenges. Explore the village of Kakure and face great challenges ranging from the frozen, corrupted by the flame to the great Shokushu soldiers who dominate the icy flame like no one else. Meet the characters who can tell you a little more about the events of the lowlands, collect more powerful armor and weapons, explore the depths of the mines and the castle in the large square. Make way for the lowlands. About the game's lore: Frostflame will take place in the lowlands, a fantasy location, inspired by Feudal Japan, during a time of war between the five kingdoms of the lowlands, namely: the Golden Hills, the Land of Rain, the Water Gate, the Central Desert and , lastly Borda. Just like in real life, war occurs due to the search for power and control, but amidst the chaos, a clan called the Shokushu emerges and has been gaining strength using the mysterious power of the Frozen Flame, which gives power and immortality to the Shokushu soldiers, in addition to dominating and controlling those who survive the clan's attacks, transforming them into “frozen”, insane, aggressive and immortal creatures. In the game you will control Chihiro, disciple of the great Master Hori Masashi. Chihiro lives in the village of Kakure, a place founded by the great Master to shelter those who abandoned the terror of the Lowland wars. Unfortunately, the village is found, attacked by the Flame clan and Chihiro ends up being captured and taken to some mysterious place. The Shokushu dominate the lowlands and the world descends into chaos and Flame. Ten years after her disappearance, Chihiro returns as a frozen creature. Master Hori is now an elder who has spent all this time studying the flame and, upon seeing his disciple return, he sends her to open the way to the lowlands, restore peace and eliminate the power of the Frostlame once and for all.
row.short_description: Frostflame is a Brazilian Soulslike developed by a single person. In the game you control Chihiro, disciples of the great master Hori Masashi on a mission to advance to the lowlands and bring back peace, ending the war of the five kingdoms and eliminating the power of the Frstlame.
row.notes: Mid Violence against Fantasy or fictional Creatures and characters

row.name: Undergoes
row.detailed_description: Overview Undergoes is an intense survival crafting game that plunges players into the depths of the earth, where danger and discovery await at every turn. You take command of a powerful drill ship, navigating through a labyrinth of procedurally generated mines in search of valuable minerals and hidden treasures. Each mine offers a unique and unpredictable environment, ensuring no two expeditions are ever the same. In Undergoes , survival is paramount. You must gather resources, craft essential tools and weapons, and construct massive underground bases to withstand the horrors lurking in the darkness. With a wide variety of minerals to discover and enemies to confront, players must remain vigilant and strategic to thrive in this subterranean world. Key Features Procedurally Generated Mines: Each mine you explore is randomly generated, offering endless variety and new challenges with every expedition. Resource Gathering and Crafting: Mine a diverse array of minerals and craft tools, weapons, and crafting tables to aid in your survival. Base Building: Construct extensive underground bases using a multitude of blocks, creating a safe haven from the dangers that lurk in the mines. Survival Horror Elements: Face off against a multitude of enemies, each posing a unique threat. Stay alert and prepared as you delve deeper into the darkness. Exploration and Discovery: Pilot your drill ship from mine to mine, uncovering secrets and treasures hidden beneath the earth's surface. Gameplay In Undergoes, players must master the balance between exploration, resource management, and combat. Navigate your drill ship to new mining sites, extract valuable resources, and use them to craft essential gear and structures. The game's crafting system allows for the creation of various tools, from pickaxes to shotguns, enabling you to tailor your approach to the challenges you face. The procedurally generated nature of the mines ensures that each playthrough offers a fresh experience, with new layouts, resources, and threats. The horror elements add a layer of tension, as players must constantly be on the lookout for enemies that could strike at any moment. Graphics and Design Undergoes features a stylized, hand-drawn graphical style that brings the underground environment to life with a unique aesthetic. The detailed, artistic design of the mines, coupled with dynamic lighting and shadows, enhances the game's eerie atmosphere. The diverse range of enemies and the intricate details of your drill ship and constructions add depth and a distinctive visual charm to the experience.
