row.short_description: Descend into endless mines. Pilot your drill ship. Survive the unknown. Undergoes is a surreal survival crafting game where players navigate a machine through procedurally generated mines, gather resources, craft tools, and build bases while fending off dangerous enemies.

row.name: アパシー荒井昭二　～牧場奇譚～
row.detailed_description: あらすじ 『学校であった怖い話』の語り部、荒井昭二。 彼は一年の夏休み、友人の誘いを受けてとある牧場でアルバイトをする。 親戚が経営するという牧場を語る友人の怯え方に只ならぬ禍々しさを感じた荒井は、 満たされぬ慾を埋めるピースを求め、ほのかな期待を抱く。 しかしその牧場は、荒井の想いを嘲笑うように待ち構えていた。 このゲームについて クリックでシナリオを読み進めていくノベルゲームとなります。 エンディングは1種類です。 「学校であった怖い話」シリーズを遊んだことない方でもお楽しみいただけます。 登場人物紹介 【登場人物紹介①：荒井昭二】 物静かで、ぼそぼそと呟くように話す鳴神学園高等部の二年生。 表面的な感情の起伏に乏しいが、その内には黒いものを秘めている。 卓越した才能を持つ者に惹かれ、心の友と認めるのが信条。 【登場人物紹介②：中村晃久】 荒井昭二のクラスメイト。 人気者で誰からも慕われていると思っているが、別に誰も相手にしていない。 荒井の無二の親友を自負しているものの、ただの勘違い男として位置付けられている存在。 【登場人物紹介③：カズ】 荒井昭二がバイトをした牧場で働く年齢不詳の青年。 無口で不用なことは話さない。 ただ、荒井のことは何かと気を掛け面倒を見る。 時折、優しい一面を覗かせるが、本心は闇に包まれている。 【登場人物紹介④：茂爺】 荒井昭二がバイトをした牧場の主。 人当たりは良いが、社会の表も裏も渡り歩いてきた表情を覗かせることがある。 DLCについて DLCによって本編のエンディング数が19種類になります。 こちらのシナリオは2021年に発売された「アパシー荒井昭二」、2022年に発売された「アパシー鳴神学園七不思議」に収録されているものと同じ内容になります。 上記タイトルから一部の立ち絵やスチルが新しくなりました。 また、本編に加え、Steam版特典シナリオ「中村晃久のアルバイト斡旋奮闘記」が収録されています。 エンディング数は7種類です。 本編のエンディングを5種類以上解放すると、タイトル画面より特典シナリオを選択することができます。 攻略について DLCをご購入いただいた方のみ、PDFでフローチャートを同梱しています。 「プレイ」をクリック後、攻略チャート[PDFファイル]を選択してください。 又は、「管理」＞「ローカルファイルを閲覧」＞「Steam_arai_flow.pdf」からご覧ください。
row.short_description: 『学校であった怖い話』の語り部、荒井昭二。 彼は一年の夏休み、友人の誘いを受けてとある牧場でアルバイトをする。 全編、荒井昭二で染まる耽美且つ狂気の世界に貴方の心は息つく間もなく犯される。
row.notes: Warning: This game contains expressions including the following: ·murder ·violence ・Bullying ・Drugs ・self-harm ・suicide

row.name: PuzzleScriptMIS
row.detailed_description: PuzzleScriptMIS is a development tool for puzzle games that contains a level editor, a test mode, a solver and uniquely a transformer for PuzzleScript. The transformer functions as a new way for puzzle designers to find or refine levels for puzzle games. How the transformer works: Designers can specify transformation rules according to which a current level design is transformed. The transformation rules follow a similar syntax to PuzzleScript and should be very easy to pick up for anyone familiar with PuzzleScript. It extends the language by introducing the keyword choose. choose 1 [Player | No Obstacle] -> [|Player] This chooses, with equal probability, any match of [Player | No Obstacle] (provided there is one) and replaces it with [ | Player] according to the normal rules of PuzzleScript. Notice that this can lead to multiple possible subsequent transformations. For example, the following level could be transformed into two different choices: The final outcomes are then ranked according to their difficulty and presented to the designer. In this very simple example, the level where the player is moved to the right is considered slightly more difficult than the level where the player is moved to the right. The difficulty metric is based on the number of states the fastest solver requires in order to find the solution, and does not always match human judgement. The transformer works best if the ratio of interesting levels is high in the search space and the levels need a moderately low number of steps to be solved. The following are example use cases of using a transformer for designing Sokoban puzzle games, but the techniques apply to other puzzle games. Use case: Inspiration In the following example, the designer restricts the transformer to only create 4x4 Sokoban levels with 4 crates and targets and no walls. The transformer takes as an input an initially empty 4x4 level and transforms it according to the following rule. choose 1 [] -> [Player] choose 4 [No Crate][No Target] -> [Crate][Target] Use case: Make it solvable when stuck In the user study, most designers got stuck at some point when designing a level by introducing or removing an object which made the level unsolvable. Surprisingly, instead of figuring out a way to make the design solvable again, they posed this as a problem to the transformer. The transformer did generic operations on the level as follows: ( move players and crates around ) choose 20 [Player | No Obstacle] -> [ | Player] or [Crate | No Obstacle] -> [ | Crate] ( randomly remove or add 10 walls with prob. 0.4 ) choose 5 option 0.5 [Wall] -> [] choose 5 option 0.5 [No Obstacle] -> [Wall] ( remove one crate/target pair if it exists and add one ) choose 1 [Crate][Target] -> [][] choose 1 [No Wall No Player No Crate][No Wall No Player No Target] -> [Crate][Target] Use case: Polish The transformer can be used to polish certain things at the end, like finding the most difficult starting position of the player in a Sokoban level. Also, an often reoccurring problem is to know when to stop designing a level. The transformer can give you a level of confidence if it cannot find any simple transformations that would make the level significantly more interesting. choose 1 [Player][No Wall No Crate] -> [][Player] Use case: Backward design The idea is to start with a solved level and transform the level using only valid moves (in reverse). For Sokoban you would write transform rules that pull the boxes instead of pushing them. (add a placeholder to all crates) [Crate] -> [Crate Placeholder] (move the player around and let him push crates) choose 50 [Player | No Obstacle] -> [ | Player] or [Player | Crate | No Obstacle] -> [ | Player | Crate] (replace crates with targets and placeholders with crates) [Crate] -> [Target] [Placeholder] -> [Crate]
row.short_description: Tool for creating puzzles interactively.

row.name: Masterplan Tycoon: Foundations
row.detailed_description: BUY THE FULL GAME About the Game This is the free first chapter of Masterplan Tycoon, a minimalist resource management sim. It will guide you through the initial missions, teaching you to identify resources, build, and set up production lines. The whole world is connected, and in Masterplan Tycoon, you take control of these connections, turning the world into a perfectly functioning production line where nothing goes to waste Your task in this game is to manage the available space and connect everything correctly so the products get delivered to the intended destination. Masterplan Tycoon depicts all the elements schematically, which means you may focus on managing the flow of resources with nothing to distract you from this exciting process. The game doesn't penalize you. Mistakes don't lead to losses. The process of immersion and learning is easy and relaxed. With each new mission, the chains will become more complex and require more ingenuity. Conduct research to facilitate resource production and monitor the system you have constructed. Build a quarry next to the mountain, build a storage facility and create a link between them. Easy enough, right? Well, now you are ready to start your journey as a logistics master. It is time to expand your production chains to new areas! Discover the minimalistic world of resource management. Take time to think about how to build chains properly. Find new resources. Change your decisions, rinse and repeat. Master the game mechanics, which at first glance might look easy.
row.short_description: Foundations is a free version of Masterplan Tycoon, a minimalist resource management sim. The world is your playground: start with simple production lines for basic needs and evolve into a production powerhouse in an elegant and stress-free setting

row.name: PAPERHEAD EP.0
row.detailed_description: PAPERHEAD 'EP.0' is a mix of a fast-paced movement boomer shooter and an adventure horror game , featuring a unique soundtrack . In 'EP.0' (Episode 0), you wake up in a prison cell. A strange voice calls to you from the depths of dark corridors covered in runic symbols and blood. Reload your trusty shotgun and find out ... WHY WOULD CARDBOARD... BLEED? BRUTAL AND SWIFT COMBAT Toss enemies into the air, kick exploding barrels at them, or jump on their heads like an Italian plumber! Or simply blast them to smithereens with a shotgun! DRAW YOUR WAY OUT OF [REDACTED] The pencil - is not only your weapon but a tool to change the world around you. Sketch bombs to kick them at your enemies! Draw doors to kick down! Write ██████ words on walls – no reason needed! CUTE... BUT SCARY A charming and cute cardboard world with more meat than expected. Even paper can instill fear! PAPER CAN BE TOUGHER THAN METAL An industrial soundtrack that will pump high-octane cardboard through your veins. Go ahead and find out... WHY WOULD CARDBOARD... BLEED? P.S. And please don’t cut your fingers in the process! :-)
row.short_description: In this cute cardboard world, something went horribly wrong... You wake up in a prison cell. A strange voice calls to you from the depths of dark corridors covered in runic symbols and blood. Reload your trusty shotgun and find out... WHY WOULD CARDBOARD... BLEED?

row.name: Tree of Sacrifice
row.detailed_description: After the disaster fell, the world was full of birds and flowers, but the interior of one island became devastated, monsters were rampant, ordinary plants could no longer grow properly, and people had to obtain the necessary resources by optimizing older adventurers. It is said that the source of all disasters comes from a demon king. Now you will travel alone to the giant tree in the center of the island to find the root of everything and the solution, only to never return ...... Game Features. Continuously advancing inside the giant tree, carefully choosing items to match and exploring the causes and consequences of battles, stores, and events; Skills can be released through the WERT button, but the order of release is particularly important, players will need to reasonably match skills with the construction of unique item attributes to give full play to its unique charm; Game Mode. Adventure Journey: standard storyline mode, consisting of combat + storyline interpretation, each level will experience a challenging boss battle, after the enemy has been defeated the player can choose to learn about the past life of the enemy, the reason why it already exists here, and for this reason, the developers have given a meaning to the existence of each enemy that exists here; Speedpass mode: according to the information of each level of the enemy in advance with the appropriate items to fight with them, in the shortest possible time to reach the crown of the tree, after registering the parameters of the leaderboards to leave your big name; Endless Battle: Online 1V1 battles, using ever-changing item attributes to battle the same enemies through powerful on-the-spot responses, how long can you last? [In development...] In addition to experiencing the intense and exciting turn-based strategy battles in this game, the most important thing is to be able to immerse yourself in the significance of the existence of each individual you are battling against, and why they exist here, and why you exist here! Translated with (free version) 1, in the demo version players experience the tower climbing + turn-based strategy battle mode 2、End of the battle according to the player's choice can raise the difficulty of the battle / maintain the difficulty at the same time to understand the enemy you fight with the existence of the enemy, we give each enemy individually do a unique small clip animation display 3、At the same time added the leaderboards, achievement system and other content [steam as well as the game within the realization]. 4、Provide cloud data storage and asynchronous communication in the form of online message boards, players can browse the communication initiated by other players at different times in the same space through the game function module. 5、Players can save and submit their own data during the battle to the cloud, and then other players can download it through the game's internal module and play against them. [This work only supports Chinese] Instructions: Battle Scene - Inventory - Operation Buttons Battle Scene - Skill Bar - Operation Buttons Battle Scene - Tactics Bar - Operation Buttons Shortcut keys for game scenes
row.short_description: Tree of Sacrifice is a role-playing game in the Dota tower climbing genre. You will be selected to become an archer/mage/warrior in the giant tree to adventure, constantly update equipment and skills to defeat all enemies that stand in your way, climb to the top of the canopy to save the island.

row.name: Perfect World
row.detailed_description: Perfect World is Quake-coded grindset simulator . Extract profits from the environment by traversing open-ended levels using abilities like a grappling hook and jetpack. Finally become your own boss, buy a deluxe condo, and achieve the good life, at any cost. Features: Realistic mushroom-type gameplay. Accurate capitalism simulation. Money. Advertising. Environmental destruction. Multiple platforming abilities including a grappling hook, jetpack, and SLAM .
row.short_description: Perfect World is an anti-capitalist art platformer. It is an environmentalist parable that subverts player incentivization and proposes that a sustainable future exists if we declare “I have enough.” It is a hallucination, a dream, a nightmare.

row.name: Bump
row.detailed_description: MAJOR UPDATE: DEDICATED SERVERS (DEC 19) No excuses. Pure skill. We killed P2P host advantage so you can really show off your skills. Consistent connections. Fair hit registration. If you lose, you can only blame your skills (or lack thereof...). This update brings a massive polish pass to the entire game, delivering the smoothest, most responsive version of BUMP to date. About the Game GET GOOD... OR GET SPLATTERED. BUMP is a fast-paced third-person shooter where standing still is a death sentence (sorry campers) . Fight for dominance across the skyline of a futuristic city, where touching the ground puts a massive target on your back. EXPLOSIVE PHYSICS Forget chipping away at health bars. In BUMP , you don't just shoot enemies, you detonate them. Explosions on Impact: Your bullets carry massive kinetic energy and explode on contact. Don't aim at them; aim around them. Use the splash damage to control their trajectory. The Ring Out: The arena is open. Your goal is to force your enemies out of the map cube. Blast them off the edge, launch them into the skybox, or slam them sideways into the void. There are no invisible walls to save them. UNCAPPED MOVEMENT CEILING The physics engine is your playground. The movement system is built to be broken, chained, and mastered. Advanced Tech: Discover hidden mechanics like the Dash-Bullet-Time (DBT) . Lock your velocity vector to become a drift missile, allowing you to fly in one direction while shooting in another. Total Fluidity: The movement logic is deep. Chain wall runs, dashes, and hovers to traverse the entire map without ever touching the floor. Infinite Skill Gap: There is no speed limit here. If you have the mechanical skill to chain your inputs, you can turn the arena into a playground where you are untouchable. KING OF THE HILL The map is a weapon. Control the Skyline: High ground is power, but the edges are dangerous. You need to control the center power positions while constantly moving to avoid being targeted. No Safe Zones: There is nowhere to hide. If you aren't fighting for position, you are already dead. THE CITY IS WATCHING BUMP brings the arcade energy back. Neon-Soaked Chaos: Immerse yourself in a vibrant, cel-shaded cyberpunk metropolis. It is loud, bright, and fast—designed to keep the adrenaline spiking. Respect the Grind: This isn't a game you just play; it's a game you master. The skill ceiling is non-existent. There is always a faster line, a harder hit, and a cleaner kill.
row.short_description: Keep moving. Chain your hits. Punish EVERYTHING. BUMP is a fast-paced third-person shooter where standing still is a death sentence (sorry campers). Weaponize gravity and unleash physics-based brutality in a game where you either Get Good... or Get Splattered.

row.name: Dungeon Reborn
row.detailed_description: Dungeon Reborn: Delve into Darkness Embark on an epic journey into the heart of Dungeon Reborn, a captivating RPG dungeon crawler where danger lurks around every corner and untold treasures await the brave. A World Plunged into Chaos For a thousand years, monsters existed only in legend. Then a colossal tower erupted from the earth, spewing forth hordes of creatures that terrorized cities and villages across the land. In response, the Hunter Guild established an elite order of warriors to push back the darkness. Your Destiny Awaits Years have passed since the last hero fell within the tower's cursed halls. Now you have been chosen to take up their mantle—to ascend the treacherous floors, face the ancient evil that lurks in the boss chambers above, and keep the monster threat contained. But beware: even defeated foes will return stronger than before if left unchecked for too long. Will you become the hero the world desperately needs, or will you join the countless souls lost to the tower's depths? Features: 🗡️ Become a Legendary Hero Ascend the mysterious tower and unlock your true potential. As you climb higher, discover rare resources to craft powerful gear and enchant your abilities. Transform from a novice adventurer into an unstoppable force of legend. ⚒️ Craft Your Arsenal Master the intricate art of creation through scavenging and experimentation. Forge devastating weapons, craft resilient armor, and brew life-saving potions. Combine different materials and unlock secret recipes to create legendary equipment that will give you the edge in even the most brutal encounters. 🌙 Conquer Nightmare Dungeons Unlock access to twisted realms corrupted by dark forces as you progress through the tower. These special dungeons harbor unique resources and unimaginable horrors. Brave their cursed depths, vanquish the corrupted monsters within, and claim exclusive rewards found nowhere else. 🔍 Unravel the Mystery A malevolent force stirs within the tower's depths, corrupting the land and spawning endless hordes of monstrous creatures. Piece together fragments of a forgotten history as you delve deeper into the abyss. Meet intriguing characters, complete challenging quests, and uncover the dark secrets behind this growing evil. Prepare to face the ultimate test of skill and courage. Forge your destiny in Dungeon Reborn.
row.short_description: Prepare to descend into the depths of Dungeon Reborn, a thrilling RPG dungeon crawler that will test your courage and cunning. Explore treacherous dungeons, battle hordes of fearsome foes, and uncover powerful loot.

row.name: click to twelve
row.detailed_description: welcome to the worst game of all time in this game you click on the screen until the center window counts to the number 12. thats It. a spiritual successor to click to eleven. don’t expect much out of this besides a few cool visual effects. This was mainly a way to figure out how steam publishing works
row.short_description: THE WORST GAME OF ALL TIME :D In this game all you do is click until the center number becomes twelve, play this incredibly engaging experience for about 20 seconds then immediately forget about it’s existence

row.name: Roswell Ranch
row.detailed_description: Howdy, stranger! Hide from a vigilant UFO, find weapon components, and protect the farm from malevolent extraterrestrial threats. Can you save the farm? After an ominous 9-1-1 call, the police captain has sent you to investigate some strange sightings on a farm. The caller? Why, that's ol' Reed Redmond, the local conspiracy nut. At least, that's what the other residents of Roswell, New Mexico think. Little do they know, extraterrestrial threats are coming - and you can bet Reed is prepared. Unfortunately, Reed had to flee town before he could finish assembling his latest project. It's your job to find the components of BERTHA, the world's first anti-extraterrestrial firearm. Solve puzzles around the farm to find all the parts, and you might just stand a chance against those big-headed invaders! Oh, and be careful - a watchful UFO patrols the area, eager to abduct any humans it finds... Replayability Even after the game has been beaten, Roswell Ranch offers a varied experience with each playthrough. The keys needed to solve puzzles spawn in a controlled set of randomized locations. This is to ensure that items are continually difficult to find, but not so difficult that finding them is impossible (i.e., items that are required to beat the game do not spawn in the cornfield or other hard to reach areas). Additionally, upon completion, players are presented with a completion time that they can try to beat in their next playthrough. How fast can YOU save the farm? Collectibles Find all 10 UFO collectibles hidden around the map to earn an achievement and enable UFO Mode, a game mode in which BERTHA fires UFO projectiles. Alternatively, find the hidden cowboy hat to give the aliens some good ol' country style... but be warned, the cowboy hat spawns in a random location every game!
row.short_description: Howdy, stranger! Hide from a vigilant UFO, find weapon components, and protect the farm from malevolent extraterrestrial threats.

row.name: Rectangulong
row.detailed_description: Rectangulong is a game where two paddles hit a ball back and forth and is the first video game in history to do so. Anyway here's some features and stuff that are in the game I guess. - 12 different games modes with unique 'fun' mechanics like multi ball, bouncy fish, walls of explosives, and some other stuff. - Play against a CPU or a friend on all 12 levels! Wow! Amazing! - A full manual exploring the deep lore of Rectangulong's characters and world, as well as the complex gameplay mechanics. - Lots of silly little guys. - Easter eggs maybe.
row.short_description: A silly game about hitting a ball back and forth. Play against a friend or a computer in 12 levels awesome style.

row.name: Solridge
row.detailed_description: Overview Solridge is an educational video game aligned with third-grade Common Core competencies. As the player, you will obtain gold by helping the townsfolk with their problems. If you want to save the village from disaster, you must continue gathering gold and growing stronger! All of the townsfolk's questions are presented in a word problem format, teaching students the “real-world” applications of their classroom learnings. Concepts Covered: Finding perimeter and area of 2-D figures Solving 3 digit addition and subtraction problems Solving multiplication and division problems within 100 Partitioning a quantity into equal parts and naming those parts as fractions Recount details of the text Where, when, why and how key events occur Determine meaning of words and phrases Describe characters in a story Tense practice (present/past/future) Subject verb agreement Pronoun antecedent agreement Comparatives and superlatives Capitalization of words in titles Possessive nouns Commas and quotations marks in dialogue If you come across any bugs, please email me at fastbrother@me.com . In your email, please detail the bug and how to reproduce it. I will be starting school in July, but will try to fix the bug ASAP. Thank you!
row.short_description: Solridge is an educational video game aligned with third-grade Common Core competencies. As the player, you will obtain gold by helping the townsfolk with their problems. If you want to save the village from disaster, you must continue gathering gold and growing stronger!

row.name: Tales of Fearless
row.detailed_description: I present to you Tales of Fealess (ToFo) a 2D MMORPG. The game is based on a fantasy/medieval world, where you decide to leave your home island to help in the war against the demons that have returned to invade the continent after two millennia sealed in the Underworld. When creating the account you can choose one of several races, all with their unique classes, the races and classes are: Human Physical Affinity: Rogue (DPS Single Target / High Damage Late Game, Main Stats 'AGI') Physical Affinity: Gladiator (Tank/Control) Magical Affinity: Mysticist (Wizard/Group Control) Elf Physical Affinity: Ranger (Ranged DPS / High Damage Early game, Burst Late Game, base atk passes through target, Main Stats 'AGI') Physical Affinity: Protector (Tank Single Target / Full tank, with invulnerability skills, two Taunts, one in area and barrier, best for Raid Bosses) Magical Affinity: Spiritual (Healer / Buffer, Essential for all types of roles) Orc Physical Affinity: Brutal (High DPS Melee / Full burst, class with the highest Strength in the game, Difficulty in PvP High) Magic Affinity: Warlock (High DPS Single Target / Group Control, High DPS) Tidal Physical Affinity: Viper (High DPS Melee Single Target / Full Burst One of the best classes for PvP, Main Stats 'AGI') Magic Affinity: Shaman (High DPS Burst / Off Support / Heal MP and Debuffs Clenase, PvP Late Game) Maluk Physical Affinity: Feral (High DPS Melee Single Target/Full burst, no crowd control, strongest AA of all, Insane Late Game, High PvP Difficulty) Magical Affinity: Infernal (Ultra DPS Single Target / Full Burst, Anti Fighters, Ultra Massive Damage, Medium and Late Game Insane) Dracov Physical Affinity: Lancer (Medium DPS AOE / Easy Gameplay, multiple AOE skills) Physical Affinity: Draconic Paladin (Off Tank DPS / High DPS, has Taunt, focused on Attack) Physical Affinity: Draconic Warrior (High DPS Melee / Class with high difficulty in PvP, PvE has medium difficulty) Saralos Physical Affinity: Gloomstriker (High DPS bow user, Direction skills, Class for taunt the mobs, at mass PvP is a good class) Magic Affinity: Pyromancer (High DPS AoE, most skills are in areas, best class for group farming, but it is a glass cannon). The various in-game systems ensure that players don't have to be bored, some of them are: Life skills: Fishing, mining, harvesting, forging, cooking, alchemy and many others, Guild, Guild Boss, and GvAll Castle Siege Many quests, some of which are secret. Raid bosses with difficulty, not all of them are easy. Solo and group dungeons, all of which can be done once a day. Crafts, item enchantment (at the moment only the weapon) And much more, I ask for everyone's help with ideas, and as I say, criticism is welcome. The game is in beta, that is, everything is part of a large test, and one thing or another can be modified. Thank you in advance for everyone's attention. Follow the discord where you can download and the game channel on YouTube, there are videos of all classes. Join the game's Discord: Thank you in advance for everyone's attention.
row.short_description: Tales of Fearless Online is a 2D MMORPG. This old-style hardcore game has pixelated graphics that bring a nostalgic feel. With 17 unique classes and profession systems, it offers a rich and diverse gaming experience. Get ready to embark on an epic open-world adventure!

row.name: Crossbow Quest
row.detailed_description: In Cross Bow Quest, you will find yourself navigating through the intricately designed fantasy environments of a massive crossbow-focused simulation, each one demanding a unique set of skills and strategies. The game's highly detailed physics engine ensures that every shot you take is influenced by real-world factors like wind, gravity, and the tension of your bowstring. This attention to detail creates an unparalleled level of realism that will both challenge and reward you. But Cross Bow Quest is more than just a test of accuracy and reflexes. It incorporates elements of sonic-based therapeutic stimuli and task repetition hypnosis, designed to have a calming and stress-relieving effect on players. The game's ambient soundscapes and rhythmic tasks work together to create a meditative experience that helps reduce anxiety and promote relaxation. Key Features Realistic Crossbow Simulation: Experience the most accurate and detailed crossbow mechanics ever seen in a game, with physics-based interactions that require true skill and precision. Therapeutic Gameplay: Enjoy the unique combination of first-person shooter action and therapeutic elements designed to reduce stress and anxiety through sonic stimuli and repetitive tasks. Stunning Visuals: Built entirely in Unreal Engine 5, Cross Bow Quest features breathtaking graphics and immersive environments that draw you into its world. Engaging Challenges: Test your abilities in a variety of settings and scenarios, each presenting unique challenges that require strategic thinking and quick reflexes. Short and Satisfying: Perfect for quick play sessions, Cross Bow Quest offers a fulfilling experience that you can enjoy without a significant time investment.
row.short_description: Whether you're a seasoned gamer looking for a new challenge or someone seeking a relaxing yet engaging experience, Cross Bow Quest promises to deliver an unforgettable adventure. Sharpen your skills, find your zen, and take on the quest of a lifetime.

row.name: Grand Fantasia : ORIGIN
row.detailed_description: New engine, New gameplay, New adventure, the classic MMORPG 《Grand Fantasia：ORIGIN》technological innovation, bringing an unprecedented gaming experience. Players can explore, fight, and grow in a broader world. Embark on a new adventure journey with your Guardian Sprite. [Engine Fully Upgraded] From the land to the forest, Rivers to the ocean, Villages to towns, the game's graphics will be significantly enhanced! From small details like water ripples and ground plants to large elements like lighting, shadows, and building scenery, everything has been upgraded to be more magnificent and refined, allowing players to once again experience the fantastical and beautiful continent of Saphael. [Classic Class Gameplay Returns ] In recent years, Class adjustments have significantly changed the gameplay that players were accustomed to with their original class. In this Orgin, we will restore the previous gameplay basics, allowing players to reclaim their most powerful and proficient playstyles and return to adventuring in Grand Fantasia! [Optimizations and Remakes] Compared to previous versions, the Orgin version will feature more optimizations, including batch synthesis, quick split flow, reduced loading times, quick gear switching, and Archive system, allowing players to reminisce about past adventures while enjoying the various convenient operations common in modern games. [Multilingual Translation] In this global version, in addition to the existing Chinese language, it will also support 'English, Japanese,' and other languages, allowing more players worldwide to join our big family~ [Orgin Version Exclusive New Class] In Grand Fantasia, each Class has its unique gameplay. By combining Talent Cards and equipment, every player can create their own unique style. In the Orgin version, a mysterious new Class will join the World of Grand Fantasia. Let's look forward to it together!
row.short_description: New engine, New gameplay, New adventure, the classic MMORPG 《Grand Fantasia：ORIGIN》technological innovation, reigniting the heart of adventure, and composing a new chapter of the fantasy World with Sprites.

row.name: ウェアヒューマン Playtest
Fortress Fury
row.detailed_description: Roadmap About the Game Fortress Fury Multiplayer Tower Defense. Roguelite Chaos. Pure Survival. The monsters have arrived, and there is nowhere left to run. Build your tower, hold your ground, and outlast everyone else. When every other fortress has fallen, only yours will remain. Collect gold, upgrade your weapons, and crush rival players in quick, intense sessions that never play the same way twice. Key Features Dynamic Builds: Choose from more than 16 weapons and experiment with countless combinations. Every run is unique. Competitive Ranks: Prove your skill in live matches and climb the global leaderboards. Evolving Arsenal: Unlock new towers and upgrades as you refine your defenses. Fast, Addictive Sessions: Designed for 10 to 20 minute bursts of chaos. Easy to start, impossible to quit.
row.short_description: Fortress Fury is a survivor multiplayer tower defense roguelite. Endless hordes of enemies want to crush your tower! Buy weapons and upgrades to craft an array of overpowering builds. Will you be able to survive all waves and be the last tower?

row.name: Lamplight
row.detailed_description: Lamplight is a mind-bending 3D puzzle platformer that will challenge your sense of reality. Defy gravity and bend time as you navigate a labyrinthine world where walls become floors, ceilings transform into pathways, and the very fabric of space warps to your will. Master the Unstable: Physics Gone Wild: Think outside the box (or the room, rather) as you manipulate gravity and experiment with the environment to solve ingenious puzzles. Elusive Gameplay: Navigate a world where time itself becomes a tool. Unwind past actions, manipulate the present, and unlock the secrets hidden within this distorted reality. A World of Mystery: Unravel the Enigma: Lamplight's hauntingly beautiful environments hold hidden clues and secrets waiting to be discovered. Explore, experiment, and piece together the narrative woven throughout this surreal world. Embrace the Challenge: Can you master the warped physics and temporal paradoxes? Lamplight will test your wit, creativity, and ability to think laterally. Are you ready to step into a world where up is down, time is fluid, and the only limit is your imagination? Enter Lamplight and see the impossible become reality.
row.short_description: Lamplight is a 3D mind-bending puzzle platformer where you defy gravity and warp your perception. Navigate a labyrinth of rooms where walls become floors, ceilings become pathways, and time bends unexpectedly. Unravel the secrets hidden within this distorted world - are you ready to be challenged?

row.name: FaeTerra
row.detailed_description: In FaeTerra , team building is all about strategy and creativity. Players collect and evolve powerful creatures—each with unique elements and abilities. Create satisfying combos with unlimited team mashups and dynamic evolutions, crafting the perfect lineup feels like discovering your own battle style in a magical ecosystem. During the Battle phase Faes will auto-battle against one another until no Faes remain on the field resulting in a win or a loss. Every creature has distinct abilities and evolutions , letting you craft endless team combinations and counter your rivals in tactical auto-battles. Discover hidden synergies, master elemental matchups, and build your dream team in a vibrant world where every creature tells a story! FaeTerra is a fast-paced strategy game where you collect, evolve, and battle with over 121 unique creatures , each belonging to powerful elemental factions like Air, Earth, Water, and Fire types. Evolve your Faes to unlock powerful new forms—each evolution is unique, Enhancing their abilities, appearance, and strategy in battle. Auto battler:  Battle your friends in PvP, manage your team, evolve, or compete in ranked matches! Teambuilding:  Offers unique strategies and combos to create the most powerful team. Deckbuilding: Allows you to hand craft your very own unique packs. Creature collecting:  Master 121 unique Fae's with 13 elemental types.
row.short_description: A fast-paced PvP creature-collecting auto-battler! Build your team, evolve, and position units strategically to counter enemy elemental types!

row.name: 轩辕传奇：轮回之沙 Playtest
BREAKER: INITIATING
row.detailed_description: BREAKER: INITIATING is a short 3D game featuring platforming and puzzle-solving elements. You step into the role of El , a robot equipped with electrical discharge abilities. Navigate through a desolate world, using El's unique powers to overcome obstacles and explore mysterious environments. In a post-apocalyptic world, humans entered cryogenic facilities to hibernate, and the abandoned machines gradually evolved a new mechanical ecosystem. A robot that was sealed in a facility, was accidentally released. It then began to explore the outside world…
row.short_description: A post-apocalyptic 3D platformer combining puzzles with intense action. You play as El, a robot escaping from a dreadful facility and exploring the ruins of civilization.

row.name: Down Abyss
row.detailed_description: Play as Iron Block, a transforming robot, to protect alpha-1, a mysterious girl, in Down Abyss . To keep her alive, you will team up to collect resources, craft upgrades, and fight monsters around an abyss. To reveal the connection between alpha-1 and the abyss, you will transform into a climbing machine and descend to the bottom of the abyss.
row.short_description: Down Abyss is a two-phase adventure survival game where you play as a transforming robot who protects a little girl by collecting, climbing, and fighting.

row.name: BUG
row.detailed_description: JOIN UP NOW! Just click and smash those nasty bugs that limit your freedom and developers from making deep and interesting games instead of clickers. You've been trained to click on bananas, eggs, burgers, and all sorts of stuff. Now, use your skills to DO YOUR PART! Support your brothers and sisters in bug extermination NOW! Meet TACTOMANDS! Use special tactical commands of your battlecruiser to SMASH even more bugs! FEATURES Bugs that explode on click, No third-party account required. All countries are eligible to SMASH, DO YOUR PART into the global smash counter, Full keyboard, mouse and gamepad controllers support, Windows, Steam Deck, MacOS and even Linux support. Steam achievements, Leaderboards and Twitch integration, Tired at work? Just smash some bugs to be happy, It will prepare you for real life!
row.short_description: BUG is an action clicker game where you just smash pesky bugs and DO YOUR PART! Have you been taken out of action or not allowed to protect SuperDuperEarth? Welcome to the planet Drake, where you can destroy bugs from a remote drone turret FOR FREEdom!

row.name: Pralai Song of The Last Empire
row.detailed_description: In this game, you will embark on a journey that blends visual novel storytelling with rich cultural drama. You play as Korn Kachakon, a high school student whose ordinary visit to an art gallery turns extraordinary when he discovers a mysterious painting of an ancient emperor. After a fateful encounter with a guard that leaves him unconscious, Korn's spirit is transported to the mystical realm of 'Pralai.' Key Features: Engaging Storyline: Dive into a captivating narrative that takes you from modern-day life to an ancient kingdom filled with intrigue and adventure. Cultural Exploration: Immerse yourself in a story that weaves together elements of different cultures, providing a unique and enriching experience. Interactive Choices: Make critical decisions that will influence the outcome of the story and the fate of the ancient kingdom. Each choice you make can lead to different endings, encouraging multiple playthroughs. Rich Visuals: Enjoy beautifully crafted artwork that brings both modern and ancient worlds to life, with detailed character designs and vibrant backgrounds. Character Development: Experience deep character interactions and development as you build relationships and uncover hidden motives of the characters you meet in Pralai. Will Korn be able to change the fate of the ancient kingdom and find his way back home? The choices are yours to make. Experience the fusion of past and present in this intriguing visual novel adventure.
row.short_description: Korn Kachakon, a high school student, finds a painting of an ancient emperor at an art gallery. Unfortunately, a guard knocks him unconscious, and his spirit is whisked to the realm of 'Pralai,' where he's tasked with changing an ancient kingdom's fate.

row.name: Leglakh: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Leglakh Prologue is a single player tribute to Tom Proudfoots 1994 classic Nahlakh. Form your party of eight champions from knights, archers, mages, and clerics. Fight against hordes of various enemies to gather what is needed to defeat the prime demon Leglakh. Leglakh has awoken, and with the awakening the previously timid animals have become hostile, and some of them have started to bleed green blood. Tribes of kobolds, orcs and hobgoblins are on the warpath, and even dragons have been spotted circling the skies. The combat happens in real time via a programmable autobattler, where you customise the ai of your champions for offensive and defensive. Leglakh Prologue only contains one island and a simplified ai setup, but the full game will include more classes, an inventory system, character development and huge continents to discover and dungeons to raid.
row.short_description: Leglakh Prologue is a single player tribute to Tom Proudfoots 1994 classic Nahlakh. Form your party of eight champions from knights, archers, mages, and clerics. Fight against hordes of various enemies to gather what is needed to defeat the prime demon Leglakh.
row.notes: Blood & violence.

row.name: East Wood Carnival
row.detailed_description: EPISODE 1: EAST WOOD CARNIVAL (Remake Coming Soon)   A PlayStation One styled horror game made by a sixth grader. Your car runs out of gas on your way to an abandoned carnival now infested with danger at every corner. You have no friends, no hope, and are all alone in your endeavor for escape. This is a linear horror experience in which you will solve basic puzzles to escape the carnival, but don't forget that you are not alone. Keep a keen eye out for danger, it just might save your life. As you desperately try to escape you might just wonder why you wanted to come here in the first place. So are you up for the challenge? WATCH YOUR BACK At every corner there is danger, so be careful. SOLVE PUZZLES Flip levers to open doors and power up objects to progress.
row.short_description: A PSX retro horror game made by a sixth grader. Your car runs out of gas on your way to an abandoned carnival now infested with danger at every corner.

row.name: Project: ICARUS
row.detailed_description: The player controls scientist “Curias” aboard the ICARUS - a black hole research facility - who tries to balance the ship’s distance to the black hole while gathering data. They must fulfill research tasks, upload them to the DÆDALUS mothership and further their understanding of the strange events, developing new technology through their funding. All the while fixing and navigating the occurring problems that come with… existing at the edge of space and time. The goal of this game is to gather as much data about the black hole as you can. To do that you have to accept research missions and fulfill them by interacting with strange anomalies or with research stations on your ship. While doing your missions you have to keep the ship running by repairing broken stations and always remember to keep your space ship at a safe distance from the black hole. From completing missions you unlock abilities that allow you to manage your time more efficiently to do even more research missions, like quantum tunneling or Ariadne's String which give you time and space bending powers. When you eventually fall into the black hole your collected research data is converted into funding for further missions which can be spent on upgrades that will help you survive longer on your next mission.
row.short_description: Travel with Curias to the ancient greek future and go on a research mission about black holes. Explore the edge of space and time in this rogue-lite management game!

row.name: Romanizer
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in Roman history with this captivating management game where your mission is to make the Phrygian goddess Cybele accepted into the Roman pantheon. Influence public opinion, meet charismatic poets, and navigate through tumultuous historical events. But beware, a bad decision could easily condemn the goddess to be rejected by the Roman population! Can you convince the Romans to worship Cybele? Meet famous Roman poets Meet Martial, Juvenal, Lucretius, Virgil or Ovid, and try to convince them to sing the praises of the goddess Cybele. Other famous Romans will also cross your path, and you can even ask for help from the gods! Make strategic choices In Romanizer, each of your actions has consequences - positive for some poets, and negative for others. It's up to you to find the balance that will best satisfy all the parties and access the Pantheon of Roman gods! Live historical events Conflicts, revolts, assassinations... Many historical events, different from game to game, will disrupt your strategy and challenge your ability to adapt. Discover - or help discover - Roman history If Romanizer is first and foremost a video game, it is suitable for use in the classroom, under the supervision of a teacher, to introduce many concepts of Roman society: religion, acculturation, romanization, beliefs, poetry and poets, theater, etc. Credits Game Designer: Thibaut Sowa Programmers: Erwan Castioni, Antonin Lesoudier Graphic designer: maevb Sound Designer: Akarius Pedagogical consultant: William Brou / Les Clionautes Historical consultant: Elodie Bouhier Help: Thomas Brasdefer, Waël Hadj Mouldi This game was created at the Scientific Game Jam in Lyon in March 2021, where it won the Jury prize. Association Les Clionautes supported the post-game jam development. Association La Science Entre En Jeu helped to make release the game on Steam
row.short_description: Immerse yourself in Roman history with this management game! Gain acceptance of the goddess Cybele into the pantheon of Roman gods, influence public opinion, and go through many historical events. Will you be able to get Cybele adopted by the Romans?

row.name: Bananametr
row.detailed_description: About the Game Bananametr is a clicker game where you click on a banana! In Bananametr, you click on a banana to get a bigger banana and compare it with a friend's banana!! Features : Little bananas Big bananas Achievements Leaderboards Beautiful backgrounds Beautiful banana Drop every hour (2 drops with dlc)
row.short_description: Bananametr is a clicker game where you click on a banana! In Bananametr, you click on a banana to get a bigger banana and compare it with a friend's banana!!

row.name: Hunter's Arena: Revolution
row.detailed_description: Escape, Survive, and Extort Hunter’s Arena: Revolution is an exhilarating and adventurous action set in the Ancient East. Combine various skills, equipment, and tactics to survive and escape a world full of enemies. If you don’t, you may lose all your precious belongings. In In Ancient Asia Hunter’s Arena’s expansive map is filled with exquisite oriental beauty. At the same time, the solemness of the ruins of war exists. This is a place where all the resources are rare. Explore hidden locations to obtain these various resources. However, you must be careful at all times to ensure survival. Between the buildings and the forest, there are many others like yourself looking for resources. A a Strategic Battle with Various Weapons & Skills Fortunately, your character is a natural fighter and can fight with any weapon. Survive using weapons and skills that are appropriate for each situation. The Last Survivor Takes All Survivors have everything to gain. All loot and treasures acquired during battle are yours to keep. Now you can strengthen yourself in the safety of the lobby. Upgrade your Shop and combine your weapons and skills to make yourself stronger. However, remember this. The easiest way to become stronger is to skill and loot others.
row.short_description: “Hunter’s Arena Revolution” merges survival and escape elements of the extraction genre with thrilling combat action, offering an accessible yet immersive gaming experience.
row.notes: During the tutorial and multiplayer gameplay, players may engage in injuring, looting, or killing other players in order to win or escape. Blood effects may be visible during gameplay.

row.name: The Day Of Survival
row.detailed_description: 'The Day Of Survival' is an exciting action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. In this devastated scenario, players take on the role of survivors who fight to ensure their survival in the midst of a devastated environment full of dangers. The plot unfolds in a vast territory, where resources are scarce and threats are always present, from zombies to other survivors. The game combines elements of exploration, construction and combat, providing an immersive experience. Players must explore the environment in search of supplies, build shelters to protect themselves from dangers for their survival. The realistic graphics and immersive soundtrack help create a dark and intense atmosphere that keeps players constantly on their toes. Challenging gameplay requires careful strategy and quick decisions, making each day a continuous fight for survival. Whether facing hordes of enemies, exploring unexplored territories or building a secure base, 'The Day Of Survival' offers an exciting and challenging experience for fans of survival and action games. Get ready to test your skills and resilience in a world where every day could be your last.
row.short_description: The Day Of Survival Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world where every decision is crucial. 'The Day Of Survival' is a thrilling survival game that challenges players to explore a harsh, unforgiving landscape filled with zombies and enemy soldiers.

row.name: Would You Call Him a Bad Man?
row.detailed_description: Would You Call Him a Bad Man? is a playable music video filled with fast-paced TIN¥ GAMES , each lasting less than five seconds. Can you beat enough TIN¥ GAMES to unlock Ava's Happy Ending ? Play as Ava, a waitress at Big Pittie's Bar & Grill. After losing her job unfairly, she must navigate the dark underbelly of an uncaring world... Play fast-paced TIN¥ GAMES that will rely on your wits and reaction time Anime visual novel-style art punctuated with pixel graphics Clear enough TIN¥ GAMES to unlock Ava's Happy Ending and hear an extended guitar solo Ten (and no more) hidden secrets to discover Rhythm-based chorus boss battles TIN¥ GAMES last just a few seconds. Complete the task before the countdown reaches zero! Collect! Select! Drive! Aim! Text on each TIN¥ GAME will guide you in your task! This game is free because it is a short experimental music video by Ian Hinden. There are no microtransactions, and this game does not collect any data.
row.short_description: This game is the official music video for Ian Hinden's 'Would You Call Him a Bad Man?' It's a fast-paced indie musical minigame collection that is part pixel art, part anime visual novel. Are you skilled enough to unlock Ava's Happy Ending?
row.reviews: “Absolutely one of the most interesting games I've played all year.” The So Videogames Podcast
row.notes: May contain content not appropriate for all ages. Game contains Sexual Content, Implied Sexual Assault, Implied Nudity, Drug and Alcohol Use, Realistic Violence and Self-Harm.

row.name: Into the Wild
row.detailed_description: Lost and alone in a snow-smothered valley, surrounded by beauty yet mired in terrible danger; your story may be your own, but it will end like all the others. Into the Wild is a tense yet tranquil survival game where nature holds nothing back. Inspired by the Norwegian hinterlands, the haunting valley of Jegersdal offers a faithful survival experience. Witness the magnificent aurora, scavenge from the remains of those who came before and find whatever means you can to prolong the inevitable end. Learn to Survive Unprepared and unready, you must equip and arm yourself as fast as you can if you hope to endure the perils of Jegersdal. Find shelter and clothes to ward off the cold, food to sate ever-present hunger and tools to orient yourself in an unfamiliar environment. Reactive Music Immersion reaches new heights in the survival genre with music that listens to the player as much as the player listens to it. Certain actions will cause the music to react as it measures the player’s intention , not only the consequences of their choice. Furthermore, when the weather changes, so too does the symphony of the valley - and you would be wise to listen. Uncover Lost Mysteries Littered throughout the valley are messages, notes, journals and other documents, left by those who came before you. Sequestered away in ragged shelters, derelict shacks and dismal caves, the secret history of Jegersdal is just waiting to be discovered. But be warned - piecing together the harrowing tales of the valley’s inhabitants is no easy task, and you must employ every tool at your disposal if you wish to do so before your own story comes to its inexorable end. Surrendering to the Wild Death comes; it is only a matter of time. Starvation and freezing are reflected by real-world thresholds for an intuitive experience. Much like in real life, however, there are many ways to miscalculate your odds of survival, and every mistake could prove fatal. Survive for as long as you can to discover the full breadth of Jegersdal - and all of its grim tales from the survivors before you. On higher difficulties, death is permanent, and the consequences of your actions become even more extreme. Unwanted Visitor Jegersdal does not permit trespassers. Weather and temperature effects fluctuate frequently, and must be accounted for when setting out on your endeavors. Through understanding Mother Nature’s fickle whims and forfeiting yourself to them, you might just prolong your inevitable fate.
row.short_description: Into the Wild is a tense yet tranquil survival game where nature holds nothing back. Inspired by the Norwegian hinterlands, the haunting valley of Jegersdal offers a faithful survival experience. Witness the magnificent aurora and search for answers amid the ruins of yesterday.

row.name: Creepy Waves FM: Bugs Fixer
row.detailed_description: PLOT A young and promising boy goes for an interview at a major AAA game development company. He is offered a position with a probationary period on night shifts. While performing his tasks in the office, he becomes the subject of a series of events that could lead to no good. What would you do if you were in his place? Will your actions lead you to salvation, or will you become a tragic victim of someone hiding in the dark? GAMEPLAY This is a short, atmospheric psychological horror where you play as a 16-year-old boy applying for his first job at a big game development company. You can interact with different people, fix bugs in prototype games as part of your work routine, and follow some daily routines as the plot unfolds.
row.short_description: A young and promising boy applies for a job at a AAA game development company. As he starts working night shifts on probation, he experiences a series of events that could lead to no good. As the story unfolds, you will be able to choose what you would do in his place.

row.name: GameOver
row.detailed_description: GameOver is a character plot driven narrative visual novel/interactive that revolves around you meeting characters and getting into game-overs with them to progress time. Focuses on M/M interactions, romance, friendship, and relationships.                  ----------------------------------------------------------------- You've just woken up after entering a small little town during your travels, but what's this about the rumors about you and the way you came from being... Blocked by... Something? Are the rumors really about you? Or someone else? Yet when you go out to find out and end up getting too familiar with the locals, why do you wake up in your room? No one seems to remember anything ever happening, while you on the otherhand... All this seems to be playing out like in your dreams? But... Is it really a dream? Or something else? Explore the town and get familiar with the locals. But be mindful of your condition, you wouldn't want to wear yourself out or anything of the sort. Someone might take advantage of it. And you can't shake the feeling that something wrong is with this town... But what is it? ABit About How The Game Works Your Heath is drained whenever you have to do some form of work, or have to get in an altercation of some kind. Your Stamina is drained as you walk around the town and physically exhaust yourself. Your Lust increases as you find yourself in physical contact with others.[br][br]Be wary of your stats as people might or might not notice these things. Changing what they'd like you to do for them, or do with you. And when one reaches too low or high... It might just be A
row.short_description: GameOver is a text based rpg focused mainly on m/m content with character driven plot. In it, you explore and run into inhabitants of the world. Some friendly, some foe. Inspired by other text based games and some videos.
row.notes: tl;dr: Trigger warnings for the following: sexual harassment/sexual assault/non-consensual sex/dubious consent, consensual non-consent, BDSM, kink exploration, drug/alcohol abuse, male/male NSFW content. row.name: Last Heist
row.detailed_description: Core Gameplay Multiplayer Heists Every match, one player is the Killer. The others are Looters, working together to steal valuable items scattered across the map. The Looter Objective Explore the map to find valuable items on shelves or behind objects such as locked doors. These objectives may require cooperation to complete. Extraction & Teamwork Transport stolen goods to the escape trucks to reach your collective money goal and win. Use in-game voice chat to coordinate routes, call out danger. The Killer’s Arsenal The Killer isn’t just another monster; they’re one of you. Disguise yourself and strike when no one is looking. Set C4 traps on items, plant landmines , or take them down with a weapon. Features Dynamic Objectives Objectives change each match, with varying room layouts, item spawns, and events that force players to adapt, no two heists are the same. Stealth and Chaos Both Looters and the Killer must weigh stealth vs. speed. Make too much noise and risk giving away your position or bait others into a trap. Voice Chat with Proximity Audio Strategize or sabotage with your mic. Sound travels, and someone’s always listening.
row.short_description: Last Heist is a multiplayer horror-heist game. Looters must steal valuables and escape, but one player is secretly the Killer, sabotaging and eliminating the others to keep the loot for themselves.
row.notes: Many explosions and blood effects.

row.name: Brainwave Trials
row.detailed_description: Brainwave Trials is a single player game set in the 22nd century. The player takes control of a volunteer for the Garnet Research And Development Sector in their technological development trials. The research facility imbibes the volunteer with enhanced physical abilities and dimensional manipulation abilities in order to progress through the test chambers of the facility. The player will need to think 'outside of the box' to overcome the challenges and trials that await them, gaining access to all new abilities within each chamber. By using a combination of their innate physical ability, enhanced parkour traversal, and dimensional manipulation, players will be able to solve the puzzles that await them. As the player progresses, reality destabilizes around them, causing them to wonder what harm the advance of science might incur on reality.
row.short_description: Brainwave Trials presents itself as a first-person puzzle-platformer experience where the player takes the role of a volunteer within the Garnet Research And Development Sector. By utilizing parkour mechanics and dimensional manipulation, the player will be able to overcome the trials of science.

row.name: DeathJack
row.detailed_description: Blackjack with a twist Play Blackjack where your life is the wager. Each bust or lost will give you a free ticket of getting shot by a revolver. Hit or Bust 10-15+ mins of tense Blackjack gameplay. Play against the Host in an endless cycle of life or death.
row.short_description: Play Blackjack where the wager is your life. Do you have what it takes to beat the host? Let's find out...
row.notes: The game revolves around getting shot by a revolver closeup whenever the player or opponent loses. Since its part of the game's loop, it is quite frequent.

row.name: Knock
row.detailed_description: 'Knock is a Clicker game that challenges you to accumulate points by tapping on the lid of your coffin. Get ready to immerse yourself in the eerie yet captivating world of Knock!'
row.short_description: 'Knock is a Clicker game that challenges you to accumulate points by tapping on the lid of your coffin. Get ready to immerse yourself in the eerie yet captivating world of Knock!'

row.name: Fairy Massage: Lite
row.detailed_description: The game is a prologue to the game Fairy Massage. Fairy Massage Lite - simulator of fairy massage therapist. A good way to spend time in the company of 4 lovely fairies giving them a massage! Fairies who have been damaged come to you for help, in the hope that you will help them. Not being a professional, you take on difficult work, but what could go wrong? Features 4 unique fairies, ready to give themselves a massage 1 cunning old fairy atmospheric music possibility of pumping interactive gallery nice graphic style

Fairies who have been damaged come to you for help, in the hope that you will help them. Not being a professional, you take on difficult work.
row.notes: Nudity and Sexual Content. Not safe for work. All characters depicted are over the age of 18. Sexual Themes include: Skimpy revealing outfits; Open, friendly attitude towards promiscuous women; Fictional characters depicted in sexual situations. Drug not included;

row.name: Kando Realm
row.detailed_description: WELCOME =============== Journey into the world of Kando. Take on creatures, craft awesome weapons, help villagers and cut down tree's. Will you slay your way to the top? Or become a master craftsman. It's all down to you. SKILLS =============== Kando Realm focuses not only on the combat side of the game but has a separate skill levelling system inspired by that of Old School Runescape for it's crafting and gathering. Currently we have 4 crafting and 4 gathering skills unlocked but will be adding much more as the game develops. CLASS SYSTEM =============== In Kando Realm you start out as a villager and you learn the ropes about helping the people of the world of Kando. In return you level up and get stronger until level 10. At level 10 you can choose to study under a specific craft such as : -Warrior -Mage -Druid -Thief Each of these classes have special abilities and class specific pros and cons including class specific quest lines. WANT TO GET IN? =============== Simply join the discord:  to get information! CROSS PLATFORM ================ Play on mobile or PC and join in on a shared world and play with people from different platforms and regions! CUSTOMIZATION ============== Create and customize your characters with hundreds of items and equipment from sticks to snake heads. Themed areas and equipment allow you to be what you want. Want to be that plate armour wearing Warrior or the onesie lollipop Druid? It's up to you! OLD SCHOOL FEEL =============== 2D oldschool MMORPG mechanics allow you to put your stat points into what you want and build your class the way you want! COMMUNITY =========== Join the community today in game and on Discord to see the latest news and updates going into Kando Realm (2D mmorpg). LOOT AND DUNGEONS =================== With dungeons to do and lots of loot to collect for your class and character you won't be bored anytime soon! PROFESSIONS ============ Not interested in combat? Simply want to be a fisher, woodcutter or miner then grab your tools and come join us! CRAFTING ========= Do you have a mind for the creative? Then lets see how well you fair at crafting!
row.short_description: Journey into the world of Kando. Take on creatures, craft awesome weapons, help villagers and cut down tree's. Will you slay your way to the top? Or become a master craftsman. It's all down to you.

row.name: Crack it Up! - Prologue
row.detailed_description: This is the free Prologue of Crack it Up! In this version, you will be able to complete your first collection and experience the main mechanics of the game. Don't forget to add the complete game to your wishlist to get notified when the game is released! Use your computer to order different types of booster packs from an online store. Open one pack after another in this relaxing card collection game. Buy packs from different collections. Premium booster packs with high chance of exclusive rare variants. Booster boxes with a lot of packs for less money. Relaxing pack opening gameplay. As an avid card collector, you will end up with a big collection of cards, sell your duplicates and your rarest cards for profit in a webpage. Manage your economy and get the best deals in a changing trading card market. Use your retro computer to sell cards in an online store. A dynamic card market, the price of the cards change over time, sell at the right time to maximize your profit. Manage your economy, ¿Will you sell that rare card for a lot of money or will you keep it for your collection? As a card collecting enthusiast you will have different collections to complete, each one with hundreds of cards and rare variants with high value. Complete up to 5 different card collections. Hundreds of cards with rare variants. Scroll through your collection albums and inspect your precious trading cards.
row.short_description: This is the free Prologue of Crack it Up!, a trading card collecting game. Order booster packs from your 90s computer, crack them up, sell your duplicates and rarest cards for profit and complete your collections!

row.name: METRIA
row.detailed_description: Wishlist Campaign Rewards from the Wishlist Registration Campaign! About the Game “METRIA” is an action RPG where you traverse the stage of the story, the “Continent of Ronatis”, which is composed of 9 countries, with unique characters. As you overcome formidable enemies that stand in your way, you aim for the truth of the world. Immerse yourself in the world of 'METRIA', brimming with diverse elements of adventure. Experience a fantasy RPG brought to life with stunning 3D graphics, a battle system that comes alive with dazzling actions and dramatic cut-in performances. Get lost in exploration elements that tempt you to stray off the beaten path, and enjoy multiplayer content online with friends. All these and more await you in 'METRIA'. - An Epic Fantasy Journey Across 9 Countries with Unique Characters - You will be controlling unique characters including the apprentice knight 'Rio Calquinos', the demi-human girl 'Aru', the Astra knight 'Lucas Nizam', and etc. to explore 'Ronatis', the continent where the story takes place. You will have to defeat formidable enemies that get in your way and aim to discover the truth about the world. - Fun Battle with a Team of 3! It Gets More Exciting with Flashy Effects and Animatios! - The occasional battles during the story are real-time action battles fought with a team of 3. Experience speedy combats while using various actions such as dodge, jump, and skills. Each character possesses powerful unique skills (special moves) with flashy animations that add more excitement to the battle! - Felling trees, mining ores, and many more things to explore and craft to make your journey colorful! - There are many activities you can do such as felling trees, mining ores, fishing, picking plants, and many more things that make you wanna stop by and explore! You can create various items and gear by taking the materials you have collected to the base. ――You woke up to find yourself standing on an unknown land. Through various meetings and farewells, you will find the hidden truth of this world.
row.short_description: The starlight is our hope, an RPG where hope and sin collide.

row.name: Egg Surprise
row.detailed_description: A fun clicker with economic simulation in the penguin kingdom. Obtain rare collections, venture into dangerous dungeons, and build your own civilization! What awaits you in this game: Click to get items Collect valuable collections Explore current economic trends What awaits you in this game: Balanced economic model Ability to play in the background Built-in protection against hacking and cheats Events with an active storyline
row.short_description: A fun clicker with economic simulation in the penguin kingdom. Obtain rare collections, venture into dangerous dungeons, and build your own civilization!

row.name: A cat's way home
row.detailed_description: 'A Cat's Way Home' is a unique casual simulation management game that allows players to experience a heartwarming interactive journey with cats. Presented in a cute and healing art style, the game enables players to explore the vast mountains and rivers of China from the perspective of a cat. The cat will occasionally write letters to the player, sharing its observations and experiences. Utilizing advanced large language model technology, the game enables the cat to respond to the letters in a personalized way, allowing players to feel the cat's sincere emotions and personalized interactions. In this fast-paced modern society, let us slow down together and enjoy the tranquility and beauty of the journey with the cat.
row.short_description: 《A Cat's Way Home》 is a relaxing cat simulation game. Explore China as a cat with cute graphics. Receive personalized letters from the cat and respond using advanced language technology. Enjoy the journey with your virtual cat friend in this busy world.

row.name: Dirty League 🔞
row.detailed_description: Hundreds of beautiful girls are captured by horrible monsters, who exploit them to extract magical energy. You'll embark on adventures in dungeons, aboard pirate ships, and through forgotten temples to rescue these hostages from their vile captors. Defeat the guards and decide the fate of the prisoners. Remember, each girl’s release grants you new magical powers and skills, which you can use to compete in the Pleasure Tower, where the best heroes vie for the Stud Throne! Immerse yourself in captivating match-3 battle gameplay where you align elemental gems to unleash magical techniques and triumph in combat. Craft ingenious strategies by combining hundreds of abilities and effects, tailoring your approach to each unique opponent. Dynamic Role System: Each girl you collect enhances your team's capabilities, making every acquisition meaningful and impactful. Vast Character Roster: Amass a diverse collection of hundreds of characters, each brought to life with stunning high-resolution animations and compelling backstories. Strategic Progression: Utilize special items to amplify your team's abilities and fuel your adventures. Engaging Weekly Events: Dive into riveting storylines that offer opportunities to recruit new characters, acquire valuable items, and gather resources to bolster your team's strength.
row.short_description: Assemble a team of 5 daring girls and compete against other heroes in captivating match-3 team battles. Discover the best combination among hundreds of abilities and effects that will help you rise to the top of the Pleasure Tower and claim the throne of the universe’s greatest champion!
row.notes: This game has adult themes, language, depicting non conventional kinks, explored in healthy ways, and fictional characters depicted in sexual situations. All characters depicted are over the age of 18.

row.name: Slice Of Ages
row.detailed_description: Slice and dice your way through enemies in this top-down action roguelike. Take advantage of special relics to reach the magical macguffin: the Slice of Ages. The Slice of Ages is heavily guarded by the evil forces of Dastardly Duck deep within his dungeon. While descending his dungeon, the hero, Duck Knight, will encounter a lot of opposition; even others trying to retrieve the Slice of Ages. Relics will help you on your descent. Some greatly increase your attack speed while others will cause you to explode at random. And just try not to lose Duck Knight's head while trying to get the Slice of Ages.
row.short_description: A top down action rpg with rougelike elements. You'll encounter plenty of opposition trying to make your way to the Slice of Ages. Slice your way through hordes of enemies with unique relics in order to stop Dastardly Duck.

row.name: Argus
row.detailed_description: Argus is 3D animation software which uses 3D hardware and game technology to create animations in lightning fast time. Like a game, you can move and control objects (Actors) in real-time as easily as objects in a computer game. You make Actors move in exact ways using modulators attached to any axis of movement (or angle, or scale, or alpha transparency). Or you can place objects in exact places on exact frames, or, uniquely, you can use the mouse to move and record the movement of an object in real-time. Argus is a way to control every object in a film; characters, actors, the lights, and the camera; and their movement exactly in an efficient way, trying to give you maximum control over a scene without spending hours or days tailoring the movement of every item. Argus was created in 2020, and has since been used to create hundreds of short films. It can works fantastically for simple looping movements; infinite tunnels, fields of snowflakes, or timing events exactly, like making an object appear for ever note in a piano tune. Argus is perfect for creating Spotify Canvas videos, or short loops and video graphics of all sorts. When you know how to use the program, Argus gives you the power to create videos in lightning fast time.
row.short_description: Argus is 3D animation software which uses 3D hardware and game technology to allow you to create animations in lightning fast time.

row.name: Hyper Tag
row.detailed_description: Tag, you're it! Challenge your friends to a game of tag in this fast paced game. Play online or offline across four official maps or a plethora of custom workshop maps. The game includes a level editor where you can make your very own levels.
row.short_description: A multiplayer 3D platformer game of tag.

row.name: Catacombs
row.detailed_description: Seize control of ancient Egyptian enemies while on a journey to the afterlife in Catacombs, a purr -ific action-strategy game! Orange Cat Energy! In  Catacombs , you play as Tabby, an orange street cat on his way to visit a recently-passed friend in the afterlife. Unfortunately, Osiris himself forbade your entry to the underworld and ordered his minions to patrol its entrance. Don’t let that stop you; venture deep into the catacombs, pouncing on and assuming control over supernatural minions, all while foiling the will of the gods with pure orange cat energy! Plan... Scout out your unsuspecting enemies before attacking and concoct a perfectly chaotic plan for annihilation. Dodge... Weave in and out of enemy sightlines and dodge projectiles. Careful-- one hit and Tabby is knocked out! Pounce! Pounce on enemies' heads to take control over them , and use their own abilities to defeat your other foes and conquer the underworld! The keen, precise jackal throws bones at staggering speeds! The divine, spiritual falcon summons pillars of light to vaporize anything in its path! The bulky, menacing mummy tanks multiple hits to pummel its enemies with nothing but its fists ! All of these powers are under your control with nothing but orange cat energy. How will you enact chaos on the Egyptian underworld?
row.short_description: In Catacombs, you control Tabby, a street cat on his way to visit a friend in the afterlife. Unfortunately, Osiris himself forbade your entry and ordered his minions to stop you. Venture deep into the catacombs, pouncing to assume control over his minions, all to foil the will of the gods!

row.name: Terra Inferno
row.detailed_description: Disclaimer This game was a student project worked on by 10 seniors at Drexel University. Those who worked on it, and their roles, can be found in the credits page in the game. Gameplay In Terra Inferno, play as Florians as you defend your planet from invading humans who want to take over the planet for it's valuable resources. The player has the power of the planet to fight back. Use Terramancy, or natural calamaties, to defend with abilities such as: Toranado Volcanic Debris Tsunami Rain and more! But the Humans will not go down easy! You will fight three distinct characters: Lil Human, Mega Mech, and the Tank! Use the Florians such as the Kraken and Lava worm to fight against their invasion!
row.short_description: Humans are ruining the lush world of Terra Inferno! Embody nature's wrath in this Turn-Based Tactics meets Resource Management Game, evoke natural calamities to devastate the human onslaught!
