row.name: Fishing Grind
row.detailed_description: Fishing is not a hobby, it's a mindset. It is only reserved for the most dedicated among us. The extensive knowledge and experience required to be a full-time fisherman weeds out the weak and discourages even the strong. This job is not an easy one, but if you think you are up to it then... Who is stopping you? Hop on the Fishing Grind. Fishing Grind is a Coop/Singleplayer experience where you and up to five friends can fish in the various environments of the North American wilderness. Most of the locations you visit are relatively safe, but some places have threats. Bears, sharks, and even other humans that will test the limits of your strength. How far will you go to get just one more catch? GAMEPLAY Partake in riveting and innovative fishing gameplay. Start your journey with almost nothing and steadily build up your collection of rods, lures, and hooks! Realism can be fun in some games, but when working on Fishing Grind our team found that a less 'realistic' approach turned out to be more fun. This creative choice also allowed for us to simplify some mechanics; these decisions will hopefully make the game easier to pick up for new players while still keeping veteran players invested! CO-OP Fishing by yourself can get pretty lonely, so Fishing Grind supports six player lobbies! What are you waiting for? Download Fishing Grind and start playing! DISCORD Join our Discord server to get involved with the community, report bugs, and request features!
row.short_description: Fishing Grind is a first person 1-6 player co-op fishing game with a twist. The place you are fishing may not always be safe...
row.notes: Murder, killing, gore, violence, blood, depictions of suicide, alcohol and tabaco consumption, and sometimes graphic death animations. Gore and blood can be turned off in the "Settings" menu.

row.name: Platformer Paradise
row.detailed_description: In the current state of the game there are: 2 Unique Playable Levels to explore and conquer. In this game called Platformer Paradise , a man on a mission, going through an obstacle course. Be careful this is not a walk in the park. Avoid Obstacles to complete levels, use anything to your advantage, hiding behind walls, glass, even staying out of the view of Cannons will suffice towards your survival.
row.short_description: Avoid Obstacles to complete levels, use anything to your advantage, hiding behind walls, glass, even staying out of the view of Cannons will suffice towards your survival.

row.name: Eden Survivors
row.detailed_description: Ever wanted to save the galaxy and fall in love? Now’s your chance. A wild mix of rogue-like action, Visual Novel storytelling, and unapologetic adult content. Step into the boots of ACE – engineer by day, vigilante by night. Lead a team of badass heroines, build a killer mech, and fight to save the galaxy from total destruction. Flirt, seduce, and get tangled up in unforgettable romances with the galaxy’s hottest babes. Whether you’re facing off against deadly enemies or navigating the thrill of forbidden love, Eden Survivors delivers an adventure that’s as intense as it is seductive. 80,000 Words of Narrative Feast : Romance, mystery, and intergalactic chaos—it’s like your favorite space opera but with more steamy moments. Romance and Relationships : Every heroine brings her own unique skills and story to the table. Flirt, chat, and gift your way into their hearts. (or at least their good side) When you're not fighting monsters, you’re managing the galaxy’s coolest hangout. The Eden Bar : Your home base for adventure, intrigue, and some seriously questionable decisions. Strategize Like a Pro : Attract patrons, rake in profits, and unlock more heroines. Every choice matters—no pressure. Make It Personal : Flirt with your squad, uncover their secrets, and unlock special events. Suit up, Commander. Things are about to get hot! Mech Customization : Assign your heroines, stack over 500+ upgrades in different builds, and create combos so OP they’ll make the devs blush. 140 Monsters, 30 Levels, 40 Bosses : From space bugs to galaxy-crushing titans, every chapter is a new challenge. Clash Mode : Take on epic bosses in ranked multiplayer. Start in Iron and grind your way to the Master division. Dynamic Game Modes : Got stuck on the main story? Plenty more action to be had: trial mode, skill trees, unique daily and weekly events. So, what kind of player are you? The tactician , meticulously crafting the perfect mech? The storyteller , unraveling romances and galactic intrigue? Or maybe the stud , here to conquer hearts as well as the galaxy? Or maybe all three? Whatever your style, Eden Survivors has you covered. Suit up, Commander!
row.short_description: Fight. Flirt. Save the galaxy. Eden Survivors combines rogue-like action, mech-building, and steamy Visual Novel storytelling. Recruit gorgeous heroines, battle through 30 epic levels and explore a universe where love and danger collide. Your adventure, your story, your desires.
row.notes: This game features mature content, including explicit sexual acts, provocative outfits, nudity, sexual animations, and scenes of masturbation. These elements are not key to the storyline. Enabling SFW mode in [Settings] ensures the game can be played without being exposed to any mature content outside of the tutorial.

row.name: Toilet Zone
row.detailed_description: Can you escape the void and make it back home? You were just sitting on your toilet, minding your own business, when a portal opened in front of you. Not only that, but your toilet just suddenly blasted off on its own, with you on it! Now you'll have to use the water-powered flight of your toilet to navigate different worlds and return home. But be careful around the walls; your toilet is a bit fragile. Controls Fly with W, Rotate with A and D Gameplay Fly through the level without touching walls or enemies. Extra Features Supports Xbox Controllers Speedrun Timer
row.short_description: Pilot a flying toilet and avoid hitting the walls and enemies. Can you make it to the end?

row.name: TouchNothing
row.detailed_description: This is a simple and challenging indie level game that tests your patience. The controls in this game are very simple and intuitive. To keep you focused, the background music of this game is very simple. By using the ticking of the clock to make your attention more focused, you can successfully complete the level in less time. You can easily see the time spent in the game. You can keep challenging yourself to get better results. You can also compete with your friends to beat the level faster. If you're bored and tired of playing some complex games, try this simple simple simple mini-game. In a word It's fun, it's not complicated. How to play: Move metal ring from start to finish Don‘t touch anything Pay attention to the time it takes About control commands： There are instructions in the lower left corner of the game scene.
row.short_description: 3D view, first person but no person，challenge yourself，several levels，A torture game.

row.name: KNOCKturne
row.detailed_description: KNOCKturne is an RPG game that tells the story of the protagonist's adventure to free a boss with many emotions in her dreams and escape from there. The main character, Peppy, is an ordinary adult. The story begins one day when she falls asleep with a dreamcatcher, a gift from a childhood friend. What dreams will she be invited to and how will she wake up from her deep sleep? There are no weapons to defeat the bosses, only skills to manipulate their emotions. KNOCKturne is a dream world created from the emotions of your memories. No weapons exist in KNOCKturne, and you can't try to fight them. All you can do is read your opponent's mind and respond accordingly. You can extend a hand of reconciliation, or you can see their cries of regret. The protagonist's world is made up of finely crafted graphics and sound. Graphics and illustrations reminiscent of gruesome fairy tales in a beautiful world created in Unreal 5. An atmospheric soundtrack that encompasses the story. Interact with mysterious NPCs and take a look inside yourself. Turn-based battles that combine strategic skill use with bullet games. The boss's emotions are trying to harm you. Dodge their attacks and collect Emotional Energy. You can use the collected Emotional Energy to continue the conversation.
row.short_description: KNOCKturne is an RPG game that tells the story of the protagonist's adventure to free a boss with many emotions in his dreams and escape from there.

row.name: Night Of The Abattoir Man
row.detailed_description: STORY: The story of Michael D'Amato, a young 23-year-old man who flies to New York with the intention of starring in his uncle's new horror movie. However, he finds himself in a real-life horror scenario as he becomes the target of a 10-foot-tall maniac known as the Abattoir Man. Gameplay: In the game, players can choose to play either as Michael D'Amato, the victim, or as Trevor Hartman, the Abattoir Man himself. If playing as Michael, the goal is to run, hide, set traps, solve puzzles, and collect four keys needed to escape. The game is designed to be tense and scary while also incorporating humor, creating a unique experience that doesn't take itself too seriously but still aims to instill a sense of dread and terror. Features: - The game allows you to play as two characters: Michael D'Amato, the victim, or Trevor Hartman, the Abattoir Man. - The graphics are inspired by anime and the look of old 80s MS-DOS and Commodore 64 games, giving it a nice retro style charm. - The game features multiple endings, encouraging replayability.
row.short_description: The story of Michael D'Amato, a young 23-year-old man who flies to New York with the intention of starring in his uncle's new horror movie. However, he finds himself in a real-life horror scenario as he becomes the target of a 10-foot-tall maniac known as the Abattoir Man.
row.notes: Mature Themes are taken seriously, but for the most part the game is not meant to be taken seriously. Mostly campy like 80's / early 90's. Some things people might have issue with is: - One point Trevor mentions throwing a little girl off a building. - First victim of Trevor's was a pedophile.

row.name: GastroRun
row.detailed_description: Gastro Run is a fast-paced educational adventure game full of obstacles, boss fights, races, with lessons placed throughout the game. You play as Gastro, a witty nano-bot whose goal is to help patients with enzyme deficiency break down food as it travels through the digestive system. Enter the human’s GI tract and shoot enzymes as you observe how food breaks down in different organs. Race Nutrient stealing “leechers” in the winding twists and turns of the small intestine. Defend the stomach walls from attacking germs to finally cure the patient. This game will test your flying and shooting accuracy while teaching you about the human digestive system. FEATURES: ● Shoot enzymes to break down food and defeat germs ● Collect booster bubbles and fly past nutrient stealing leechers! ● Collect stars at the end of each level and unlock rewards and upgrades! ● Avoid obstacles like incoming food and fly through intestinal blockages! ● Watch out for clues and hints during popup videos! ● A Unique combination of fun & learning.
row.short_description: Gastro Run is a fast-paced educational adventure game full of obstacles, boss fights, races, withlessons placed throughout the game. You play as Gastro, a witty nano-bot whose goal is to help patients with enzyme deficiency break down food as it travels through the digestive system.

row.name: YeGung
row.detailed_description: This game is a bow action RPG game, so you can advance without developing your character, and you can easily defeat enemies as you strengthen your character. Features include main quests, daily quests, field hunting grounds, reinforcement, and stores. In the final days of Garam, a period of great turmoil, monsters appeared. They stirred fear and chaos among the people, disrupting the nation. Among them, the most powerful monster defeated even the great warrior Yugun, the last hope sustaining Garam. After their victory, the monsters vanished, and the remnants of Garam's forces founded a new nation named 'The Sea'. Yugun's daughter, Yudahi, inherited her father's weapon, 'Yegung', and after being defeated by the monsters, she spent years in secluded training to strengthen herself. Having completed her training, Yudahi learned that a monster had reappeared in her village. Grasping Yegung, she resolved to fight. Now, Yudahi faces a choice in the midst of new conflicts and the resurgence of monsters. What path will she take?
row.short_description: This game is a bow action RPG game, so you can advance without developing your character, and you can easily defeat enemies as you strengthen your character. Features include main quests, daily quests, field hunting grounds, reinforcement, and stores.
row.notes: It's not particularly provocative or explicit, but there is such a thing as the death of a monster.

row.name: Starborne: Frontiers
row.detailed_description: 400 years from now, Earth has perished, and humanity has made its home among the stars. The struggle for a place in space has left a lasting legacy of internal conflicts and brutal faction wars. The galaxy is divided among 10 warring factions, each with its own agenda. Factions like the Children of the Everliving seek eternal life at any cost, while MPL aims for profit, and Tianchao combats corruption with vast spy networks. The Abyss The Abyss appeared without warning, causing chaos in the Frontier. As a commander, your ultimate goal is to discover the secrets of the Abyss and prevent it from consuming everything in its path. This exploration-rich game mode lets you choose your path and make crucial command decisions that determine your rewards. Game Modes and Challenges PvE Content: Enjoy a story-rich campaign and tackle challenging bounties. PvP Arena: Test your skills against other players in strategic space battles. The Vault: Join an alliance and raid the vault for valuable resources. The Abyss: Uncover secrets and make pivotal decisions in this exploration-focused mode. Recruit Unique Pilots Collect over 100 ships, each with unique abilities and backstories. Upgrade your fleet and pilots with powerful enhancements to dominate space. Deep Customization Customize your ships with a variety of weapons, shields, and software. Utilize up to 6 gear slots and collect powerful implants for limitless possibilities. Tailor your fleet to your strategic needs and battle preferences. Master Your Tactics Use strategic tactics to defeat powerful enemies and progress towards becoming a legendary commander. Plan your moves carefully to create the perfect fleet combination, and choose formations based on your ships’ unique targeting patterns to maximize your battle effectiveness. Limited-Time Events Engage in exciting events and themed holiday bounties. Participate in community-wide challenges and step into the commander's arcade with mini-games like Gelecek Survivor. Explore the Galaxy In Starborne: Frontiers, the vast galaxy is your battleground. Use strategy and tactics to navigate through the sci-fi universe, conquering challenges and building your legacy among the stars. Experience the thrill of strategic space battles as you command your fleet in this sci-fi adventure. Master the art of strategy and immerse yourself in a sci-fi epic where your choices shape the fate of the galaxy. Engage in strategic planning and sci-fi battles to become the ultimate commander in Starborne: Frontiers. Strategy is essential in every aspect of this sci-fi universe, and your tactical decisions will determine your success.
row.short_description: Starborne: Frontiers is a free-to-play tactical autobattler with hundreds of unique ships. Form your fleet, customize it with a variety of equipment, and use strategy to create the perfect battlefield formation. Take on bounties, engage in the PvP arena, and bring order to the Frontier.
row.notes: Our game features rich and immersive storytelling, which includes mature themes within the backstories of certain units. These narratives may contain depictions of violence, trauma, and other sensitive topics. Specifically, some character histories explore difficult subjects such as: Violence: References to physical confrontations and battles are present within the context of the units' past experiences. Trauma and Psychological Struggles: Characters may have endured various hardships, including the psychological aftermath of war and personal loss. It is important to note that these mature themes are woven into the fabric of the characters' backgrounds to provide depth and realism to their stories. They are not depicted graphically within the gameplay itself. However, players who may have sensitivities to these topics are advised to consider this information before engaging with the game. We believe that these elements contribute to a more compelling and nuanced narrative experience, adding layers of complexity to our characters and their journeys.
